8301258f.title: Senior Technical Consultant (Technical Architect), Core Business Workflows
8301258f.description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Team**
 The Customer Excellence Group (CEG) is ServiceNow’s internal professional services organisation. The CEG team at ServiceNow works with customers to help them achieve their business outcomes by providing proven practice guidance and technical expertise. As part of the CEG Expert Services Delivery team, you will work with our customers to drive consumption, adoption, and customer satisfaction and ultimately help our customers grow their business on the ServiceNow platform by getting them to realise the value of their ServiceNow investment, while making ServiceNow the best buying decision they’ve ever made.
   

  

**The Role**
 This Senior Technical Consultant (Core Business Workflow) role leads the design and implementation of ServiceNow solutions to accelerate customer adoption and drive business outcomes. The role partners with customers to address key challenges, design and configure best\-practice solutions, and drive delivery excellence. The ideal candidate is experienced in Core Business Workflows domains (e.g. HRSD, WSD, LSD and/or FSC) and leads both design and build across diverse stakeholders including customers, partners and junior team members.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
* Manage technical delivery streams within large ServiceNow engagements, across diverse matrixed and cross\-functional teams
* Facilitate process re\-engineering and optimisation workshops and guide customers to maximise the value of ServiceNow technologies.
* Act as a domain expert in Core Business Workflows, consulting effectively and navigating strategically across specialised areas (e.g. Human Resources, Legal, and Workplace Services)
* Architect scalable, best\-practice solutions and present technical concepts effectively to varied business and technical stakeholders
* Create detailed user stories, test strategies, solution design documents and customer hand\-over deliverables
* Configure and develop automation workflows and domain specific solutions aligning to ServiceNow standards
* Ensure consistent quality through technical oversight and testing
* Support pre\-sales by leading scoping, solutioning, and estimation discussions
* Contribute innovation, best practices, and thought leadership to global CEG and product teams.
* Mentor colleagues, guide on customers, and partners on technical excellence and delivery quality


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in configuring and developing ServiceNow or equivalent solutions within related service domains (e.g. Human Resources, Legal, or Workplace).
* Familiar with leading ServiceNow implementations.
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving.
* Skilled at engaging both technical and business stakeholders to gather requirements and design end\-to\-end solutions
* Strong ability to simplify and present complex concepts through visual models, workflows, and wireframes
* Deep customer focus with a passion for delivering excellence
* Combines creativity with analytical thinking and effective problem\-solving
* Naturally curious, proactive, and self\-driven in adopting new technologies
* Thrives in fast\-moving environment with concurrent assignments
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated success as both a team contributor and leader
* Experienced in Agile delivery methodologies and collaborative project execution
* Technically proficient in web technologies (XML, HTML, JavaScript, Web Services, CSS, middleware, LDAP, SSO, OAUTH, etc.) and working experience with SaaS technologies
* Strong grasp of data management, database design, and related concepts
* ServiceNow Certifications (required or must achieve within the first 90 days):
* Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) \- \- Human Resources / Workplace Service Delivery / Legal Service Delivery
* Desired ServiceNow Certifications (required or must achieve within the first year):
* Completion of Architecture Excellence (ArchX) program
* Must be able to travel up to 30% annually, where required
* Must be able to accommodate adjusted working hours to support customers across APAC region


 FD21
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

a2db96a4.title: Senior System Architect
a2db96a4.description:
**Meet Our Team**
 Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high\-quality, outcome\-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team, you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology. Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high\-quality, outcome\-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team, you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands\-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision making across the cloud platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Mentor and train our clients in Pega technology
* Leveraging your Thought Leadership skills, you’ll engage, educate and enable your clients’ resources on Industry and Pega Best Practices
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations
* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


**What You've Accomplished**
 You are a highly technical hands\-on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
   

  

* Minimum 6 years of Pega experience and CSSA certification (Pega certified Senior System Architect) and experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Driving and configuring GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team\-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologies.


**Pega Offers You**
* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive ofpay \+ bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

a634d22f.title: Application Architect-Oracle Cloud Applications
a634d22f.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Architect for Oracle Cloud Applications, you will design and implement technical solutions that meet functional requirements. You will utilize your in\-depth knowledge of Oracle Applications to create technical designs that can run on multiple platforms and be composed of multiple software packages.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Design Technical Solutions: Create technical designs that meet functional requirements and can run on multiple platforms, ensuring solutions adhere to quality, performance, availability, and security standards.
* Implement Solutions: Implement technical solutions, utilizing strong consulting and implementation skills to work independently and directly with clients.
* Ensure Quality Standards: Verify that solutions meet quality, performance, availability, and security standards, ensuring high\-quality delivery to clients.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored technical solutions that meet their requirements.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* In\-Depth Oracle Knowledge: Experience with Oracle Applications, including creating technical designs that can run on multiple platforms and be composed of multiple software packages.
* Multi\-Platform Design: Experience designing technical solutions that meet functional requirements and can be implemented on various platforms.
* Consulting and Implementation: Experience working independently and directly with clients, utilizing strong consulting and implementation skills to deliver technical solutions.
* Quality and Security Standards: Experience ensuring solutions adhere to quality, performance, availability, and security standards, verifying high\-quality delivery to clients.
* Technical Solution Implementation: Experience implementing technical solutions that meet client requirements, with a focus on quality, performance, and security.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Oracle Cloud Expertise: Experience with Oracle Cloud Applications, including designing and implementing technical solutions that meet functional requirements and can run on multiple platforms.
* Multi\-Platform Solution Design: Experience creating technical designs that can be composed of multiple software packages and implemented on various platforms, ensuring solutions adhere to quality, performance, availability, and security standards.
* Independent Consulting: Experience working independently and directly with clients, utilizing strong consulting and implementation skills to deliver technical solutions that meet client requirements.

add45747.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
add45747.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Maharashtra

ec543ddd.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non\-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 AWS Mainframe Modernization
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education

 As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud\-based and traditional infrastructure components. The role includes testing and deploying these solutions to ensure they meet performance and security standards. Additionally, the engineer develops and validates architectural proofs to assess the feasibility and robustness of the proposed cloud environments, contributing to the overall stability and efficiency of the platform.

* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth integration of cloud and non\-cloud systems.
* Monitor and optimize deployed cloud environments to maintain high availability and performance.
* Document architectural designs and deployment processes to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
* Assist junior team members in understanding cloud platform concepts and deployment strategies.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS Mainframe Modernization.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure deployment and management.
* Strong understanding of cloud security principles and best practices.
* Ability to design and validate cloud architecture proofs for performance and security.
* Familiarity with automation tools for infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Knowledge of integrating legacy systems with modern cloud platforms.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in AWS Mainframe Modernization.
* This position is based at our BDC11 \- SEZ office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

40e4a65b.title: Enterprise Architect

 AWS Core Infrastructure

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS Core Infrastructure.
* Experience with cloud architecture design and deployment in large\-scale environments.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code and automation tools.
* Ability to design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions.
* Familiarity with network architecture, security protocols, and compliance standards.
* Expertise in integrating cloud services with existing enterprise systems.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in AWS Core Infrastructure.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
* Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology\-driven delivery models


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
* Experience building trusted relationships with senior customer executives (VP\+) to influence strategic and operational decisions and managing escalation paths across complex stakeholder landscapes
* Experience in software development and proficiency in AI\-DLC or equivalent AI\-accelerated development methodologies at the governance and program leadership level, including experience adapting estimation, milestone tracking, and quality assurance frameworks for AI\-native delivery models

**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to join the Value\-Added Services PMO, leading delivery within the Customer Journey portfolio. This role is responsible for driving complex enterprise application initiatives across platforms including Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Configure Price Quote (CPQ), Lead Management, customer engagement solutions, AI\-powered automation, integrations, data platforms, analytics, and sales technologies.


The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of technical expertise, project delivery leadership, enterprise systems knowledge, and stakeholder management skills. This individual will partner closely with product, engineering, architecture, data, security, and operations teams to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve customer experiences, business processes, and operational effectiveness.


Success in this role requires experience managing complex technology projects spanning enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, cloud technologies, AI\-enabled solutions, and Agile software delivery teams within a global, matrixed environment.


Essential Functions:


Technical Project Leadership:

* Lead the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technology projects supporting the Customer Journey portfolio.
* Manage cross\-functional initiatives spanning enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, automation solutions, AI capabilities, and customer\-facing technologies.
* Drive end\-to\-end technology delivery from concept and architecture through development, testing, deployment, adoption, and operational transition.


Enterprise Applications \& Technology Delivery:

* Lead projects supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, CLM, CPQ, Lead Management, sales operations, customer engagement platforms, and related business applications.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define technical roadmaps, solution strategies, system dependencies, and implementation approaches.

* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security controls, privacy requirements, and data governance policies.


AI, Automation \& Innovation:

* Lead implementation of AI\-enabled capabilities, Copilot solutions, agentic workflows, automation platforms, and intelligent business process technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to improve delivery efficiency, customer insights, productivity, and operational performance.
* Partner with technology teams to evaluate technical feasibility, integration requirements, scalability, and adoption strategies.


Project Governance \& Delivery Management:

* Define and manage scope, schedules, releases, milestones, budgets, resource plans, dependencies, risks, issues, and delivery outcomes.
* Establish project governance frameworks, executive reporting, delivery metrics, and implementation readiness plans.
* Coordinate complex cross\-team releases while ensuring quality, supportability, operational readiness, and business continuity.


Stakeholder \& Technical Leadership:

* Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, architects, data teams, security teams, operations teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Lead executive\-level communications, technical decision forums, stakeholder alignment sessions, and delivery reviews.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree, OR 2\+ years of relevant work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), OR 0 years of experience with a PhD.


Preferred Qualifications:


Technical Experience:

* 6\+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise applications, digital transformation, or technology modernization projects.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience considered.
* Understanding of enterprise application architecture, cloud technologies, system integrations, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and data platforms.

* Experience delivering projects involving APIs, middleware, data migration, master data management, reporting platforms, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release management, testing strategies, QA coordination, environment management, and production support transitions.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, Copilot solutions, agentic systems, machine learning\-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation platforms.


Project \& Leadership Experience:

* Proven ability to lead large\-scale, cross\-functional technology projects involving engineering, architecture, product, security, and business teams.
* Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, resource planning, risk mitigation, and executive governance processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven decisions in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into executive\-ready business messaging.

* Demonstrated success delivering results within fast\-paced, global, matrixed organizations.

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.

 Mentorship and Career Growth

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. f807c219.title: Principal Software Architect-AI
f807c219.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Unified Communication team at Motorola Solutions is seeking an accomplished and visionary Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead our Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and Strategic Project initiatives. This pivotal role involves leading a high\-performing engineering team focused on designing, developing, and deploying cutting\-edge AI\-driven solutions that enhance our unified communication products and services. The ideal candidate possesses a deep technical background in software engineering, a proven track record of managing and mentoring technical teams, and extensive experience in bringing AI/ML models from research, prototypes to production\-ready enterprise systems.
**Job Description**
-------------------

Leadership and Management


* Lead the software engineers, machine learning engineers, and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Define team priorities, allocate resources, manage project timelines, and ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery of AI/ML\-powered features.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support the career development of team members.
* Collaborate with product management and cross\-functional teams to translate business needs and product requirements into technical specifications and a clear AI/ML roadmap.

**Technical Strategy and Execution**

* Define the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for integrating AI and ML capabilities across the Unified Communication product portfolio (e.g., natural language processing for translation, transcription and summarization, predictive analytics, intelligent routing, conversational AI).
* Oversee the entire AI/ML lifecycle, from data collection and model training to MLOps, deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Ensure the engineering team adheres to best practices in software development, including code review, unit testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and secure coding standards.
* Drive the selection and implementation of appropriate technologies, frameworks, and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) to support scalable and robust AI infrastructure.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with AI Engineering organization, Research \& Developments teams to identify emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and assess their potential for application within the Unified Communications product line.
* Work with Data Governance and Legal teams to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and ethical AI principles
* Communicate complex technical concepts and project status effectively to executive leadership and non\-technical stakeholders.

----------------------

* + Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or management role directly overseeing AI/ML or data\-intensive engineering teams.
	+ Deep practical experience with the full lifecycle of building, deploying, and maintaining production\-grade machine learning models (MLOps).
	+ Strong programming skills in languages such as Python and Java/C\+\+, and familiarity with common ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
	+ Proven experience designing and implementing scalable cloud\-native architectures for AI applications on major platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP).Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience in Crafting precise, effective prompts to guide AI models for specific outputs (e.g., text, code, images) and iterative refinement.
* Extensive experience in building custom, reusable, proactive, "context\-aware" AI assistants that understand specific, recurring contexts like situational factors and technical states that consistently shape how an end user interacts with an application.
* Extensive experience in Utilizing AI to structure, clean, and analyze unstructured data for actionable insights and visualization.

No

 :

7dd4f27c.title: Principal Data Platform Architect
7dd4f27c.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Principal Data Platform Architect
Overview  

Mastercard is seeking a highly influential Principal Data Platform Architect to help define and deliver the next generation of enterprise data capabilities.  

  

This role will lead the design and evolution of strategic platforms that simplify how external data is securely exchanged with Mastercard and enable product teams, consultants, and analysts to more easily discover, access, and leverage enterprise data. The successful candidate will help transform complex, fragmented data processes into scalable, self\-service experiences that accelerate innovation and unlock greater value from Mastercard's data assets.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Define Enterprise Data Platform Strategy  

  

Drive the technical vision and architecture for enterprise data onboarding, exchange, discovery, and consumption capabilities.  

Develop roadmaps that balance immediate business needs with long\-term platform scalability and reuse.  

Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring data workflows across Mastercard.  

Enable Frictionless Data Exchange  

  

Design capabilities that streamline the secure onboarding, sharing, and management of external data.  

Establish reusable patterns for data integration, governance, observability, lineage, and compliance.  

Reduce reliance on bespoke solutions through automation and self\-service capabilities.  

Democratize Access to Data  

  

Create intuitive ways for product teams, consultants, analysts, and AI\-powered solutions to discover and utilize trusted enterprise data.  

Enable self\-service analytics and rapid solution development without requiring deep technical expertise.  

Partner with governance and security teams to balance accessibility with appropriate controls.  

Provide Technical Leadership  

  

Serve as a technical authority across multiple engineering organizations.  

Influence architecture and technology decisions without direct authority.  

Establish engineering standards, best practices, and reference architectures.  

Mentor engineers and architects across the organization.  

Partner Across the Business  

  

Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Security, and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.  

Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.  

Build alignment around platform investments and strategic priorities.  

  

All About You  

Extensive experience architecting and building large\-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integration solutions across both on\-premises and cloud environments, leveraging technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, NiFi, Hadoop/Cloudera, Databricks, and modern cloud\-native data services.  

Deep expertise in data engineering, data architecture, data integration, and cloud\-native platforms.  

Experience building reusable platforms that serve multiple products, teams, or business domains.  

Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, metadata, and data quality practices.  

Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizations.  

Exceptional communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  

Proven track record of translating ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions.  

Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data ecosystems (Oracle, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.).**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
   

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function**
* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services.
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes**
**Essential:**
* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands\-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desirable:**
* 5\+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

9a4a15b1.title: Global Senior Domain Solution Architect – IT Infrastructure
9a4a15b1.description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Global Senior Domain Solution Architect – IT Infrastructure is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise infrastructure architecture landscape across cloud, on\-premises hosting, workplace, network connectivity, and related infrastructure services. The role ensures that infrastructure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, cost\-efficient, and aligned with Sandoz enterprise architecture principles, standards and business strategy.
   

  

 The architect serves as the primary technology authority for infrastructure architecture within global programs and projects, providing architectural guidance, technology roadmaps, standards, and governance while collaborating with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Operations, and external partners. The role is accountable for ensuring that infrastructure investments support operational excellence, service resilience, regulatory compliance, and future business growth.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Define and govern target\-state infrastructure architecture across cloud, data centre, network, and workplace services.
* Develop architecture standards, principles, roadmaps, and reference architectures aligned with enterprise strategy.
* Provide architectural leadership and guidance for infrastructure transformation and strategic programmes.
* Evaluate solution options and support architectural decision\-making based on business outcomes, risks, and costs.
* Drive cloud adoption, hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies, infrastructure automation, and platform standardisation.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet security, compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Assess emerging technologies and vendor offerings to support future business needs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, operations teams, and vendors to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 5\+ years of IT experience, including 2\+ years in Solution, Domain, or Infrastructure Architecture roles.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale infrastructure solutions within complex global environments.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly Azure and/or AWS.
* Expertise in infrastructure architecture, including hosting, networking, workplace technologies, IAM, security, monitoring, and data protection.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent.
* Understanding of security, risk management, governance, and regulated environments (e.g., GxP, GDPR, SOX).
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into practical technology solutions and influence senior stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and vendor management skills.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

fe2b48b0.title: Senior Program Manager - FinOps, FinOps PMO
fe2b48b0.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalise new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure\-to\-pay, order\- to\-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance.  

  

  

  

As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Senior Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the APAC region. This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast\-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement.  

  

  

  

As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead cross\-functional teams to deliver large\-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make
  

smart trade\-offs between competing priorities. You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle, not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress\-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post\-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI\-augmented program delivery.  

  

  

  

You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results, understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.  

  

  

  

  

Who Are We Looking For?
  

The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large\-scale, highly complex business program implementations in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.  

  

  

  

  

You will demonstrate:
  

  

* Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle: from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post\-launch analysis. We do not want someone who knows about AI; we want someone who delivers programs differently because of it.

  

  

* The ability to work backwards from the problem: challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.

  

  

* High\-judgment decision\-making: distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.

  

  

* A metrics\-driven approach that goes beyond tracking numbers to designing measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction), while knowing when to trust judgment over data.

  

  

* The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to VPs.

  

  

* A track record of force multiplication: creating mechanisms, frameworks, and reusable approaches that deliver value beyond a single program.

  

  

* Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross\-functional decision making without authority.

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Your responsibilities will span seven core dimensions:  

  

* Stakeholder \& Customer Understanding: Engage systematically with stakeholders across FinOps and partner organisations to understand business problems, constraints, and scaling factors. Gather requirements from diverse personas, distinguish representative signal from isolated requests, and drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions and aligned outcomes.

  

  

Systems \& Technical Awareness: Understand the systems landscape deeply — automation limitations, integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress\-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing coordination, producing launch readiness assessments, and synthesising post\-launch data into actionable recommendations.  

  

  

  

* Strategic Thinking \& Decision\-Making: Work backwards from the problem — questioning proposals and testing assumptions rather than perpetuating approaches because "that is how it has always been done."

  

Distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, develop clear program tenets that guide prioritisation, and make smart trade\-offs between time, effort, and deliverables with measurable success criteria.  

  

  

  

* Solution Design \& Process Architecture: Design scalable program mechanisms that create predictable process paths and ensure long\-term success. Streamline or eliminate excess process, steer teams away from classic failure modes, and continually strengthen FinOps PMO effectiveness by delivering innovative, think\-big improvement opportunities.

  

  

  

* Metrics \& Judgment: Design measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics from outcome metrics. Identify the highest\-leverage input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross\-team status inputs and identify leading indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete — using judgment calibrated by experience.

  

  

* Execution \& Results Delivery: Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large\-scale programs from initiation through to delivery, on time and with quality. Take calculated risks where bold programmatic moves could deliver disproportionate impact, use AI to amplify personal capacity across the delivery lifecycle, and learn systematically from outcomes.

  

  

* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Effectively communicate with and influence senior, VP\-level stakeholders across multiple parts of the organisation. Write effective narratives, influence without authority across organisations with different priorities, and actively mentor and develop others.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of program or project management experience
* 6\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 6\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle, not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 6\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience managing programs in finance operations, procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash, or payroll domains
* Experience designing and embedding AI\-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis, AI\-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
* Track record of creating reusable mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond a single program

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

c5f99d2b.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
c5f99d2b.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
* Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology\-driven delivery models


**Preferred Qualifications**
