1e3b97ac.title: Senior Platform Architect-1
1e3b97ac.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Platform Architect\-1
Overview  

Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.  

Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.  

Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.  

This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.  

This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.  

Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?  

Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?  

Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?  

Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?  

  

Role  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

  

All About You  

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro\-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

  

Skills/Abilities:
  

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on\-the\-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross\-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

737728b9.title: AI Solutiuons Architect
737728b9.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**About The Role**
 At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high\-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI) through fit\-for\-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering \& Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, genAI agents and agentic foundations.
   

  

 In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands\-on AI Software Architect to design and help implement end\-to\-end GenAI and non\-Gen AI applications, with a particular focus on agentic systems. You will not simply be drawing diagrams; you will be expected to remain deeply entrenched in the code, acting as a full\-stack technical anchor whose workload for rigorous code review and architecture enforcement is critical to our high\-velocity teams.
   

  

****Core Tech Stack \& Scope****
 This role will involve working deeply with multimodal foundation models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, advanced agentic workflows, vector, graph and traditional databases, APIs, MCPs, A2A, MLOps subsystems, new emerging technologies and other solution components. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) to develop scalable and robust AI solutions. Beyond AI components, the architect must ensure that the entire system's software ecosystem \- from frontend and backend services to data pipelines, integrations, authentication, observability, and infrastructure \- is well\-designed, scalable, and maintainable.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 End\-to\-End System Architecture \& Hands\-On Engineering:
   

  

* Define and design AI (with focus on genAI and agentic) and non\-AI components of software systems, ensuring modularity, scalability, and security
* Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems while ensuring seamless interoperability with backend services, APIs, MCPs, databases, and user interfaces
* Ensure adherence to cloud\-native best practices across AWS and multicloud deployments, including containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code
* Evaluate the best fit for purpose technologies
* Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of particular RDT and Business functions, and that they strictly follow architectural patterns and standards used across RDT


****Agentic AI Model Integration \& Optimization:****
* Define robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal models, and RAG, agentic systems and other emerging AI technologies
* Design efficient model\-serving pipelines, integrating AI capabilities into existing business workflows


****Full\-Stack Enterprise Engineering \& Code Quality:****
* Ensure that AI applications follow software engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD, MLOps, automated testing, and code quality assurance
* Conduct rigorous code reviews for agent\-assisted and human\-generated code to maintain high enterprise standards
* Architect secure and scalable integrations to facilitate seamless communication between AI models, databases, and user interfaces
* Design data pipelines that efficiently handle structured and unstructured data, ensuring AI models receive high\-quality input data
* Integrate identity management and authentication mechanisms to ensure secure access to AI applications
* Be ready to jump into the code to be a hands\-on partner within solutions development teams


****Observability, Performance \& Security:****
* Define monitoring and logging strategies for AI\-driven applications to ensure model performance, API/MCP health, and data integrity
* Implement AI observability practices, ensuring visibility into application behaviors and anomaly identification
* Design architectures that adhere to data governance, security, compliance, and ethical AI guidelines


****Collaboration \& Governance:****
* Work closely with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Owners and other members of Agile development teams to translate business requirements into AI\-driven architectures
* Provide technical leadership in AI architecture reviews, design discussions, and solution validation
* Collaborate with Agile teams and key stakeholders across the organization to consult on, design and implement AI systems that meet Roche's architectural standards and adhere to AI governance guidelines


**Practical Skills Required**
****Experience:****
* 7\+ years of experience in software architecture and engineering, including at least 3 years in AI\-related projects
* Proven track record of designing and deploying large\-scale, cloud\-based AI and non\-AI systems
* Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents to accelerate full\-stack development cycles


**Skills**
****Must\-have:****
* Architecting production\-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end\-users, integrations, etc., but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs
* AI Expertise: Deep understanding of various ML algorithms, model training techniques, and evaluation metrics, foundational models utilization and integration, agentic systems design and engineering
* Cloud Platforms: Expertise in AWS and multicloud services, serverless computing, and other cloud services required to build AI applications end\-to\-end, from IaC with Terraform to exposing securely production\-level applications over the network, understanding of hardware and software infrastructure needed to support AI workloads
* Databases: Strong architectural knowledge of vector databases (e.g. AWS OpenSearch, Azure AI search), Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, event\-driven and graph architectures
* Building resilient, highly available and secure IT systems
* Security \& Compliance: Strong understanding of software solutions security and compliance requirements
* Stakeholder management and communication: Influence your colleagues, but also non\-technical Senior Stakeholders on designs you create
* Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python with strong experience in backend development, coupled with a strong command of modern frontend ecosystems
* Software Engineering Best Practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code and microservices design


****Should\-have****
* Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage \- to have a common language with the full\-stack Software Engineers


****Could\-have:****
* Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries


****Capabilities:****
* Problem\-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle complex architectural and engineering challenges, integrate new technologies, and improve existing processes
* Business Acumen: Understanding of how AI can be leveraged to drive business value and achieve strategic objectives
* Leadership: Abilities to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary
* Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems
* Ethics: Familiarity with biases, fairness, and responsible use of AI


**Qualifications**
 The successful candidate should:

253d025c.title: Senior Technical Architect – Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems
253d025c.description:
**Position: Senior Technical Architect Scalable Multi\-Tenant Systems**
**Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time**
**Experience: 10\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a skilled Senior Technical Architect to own the architecture of a scalable, secure, multi\-tenant SaaS platform. The role will drive system design, distributed systems, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, security, and integrations while setting technical standards across engineering. The ideal candidate is a principal\-level architect with proven experience scaling production SaaS systems and strong technical leadership skills.**
**Key Responsibilities** 
**Multi\-Tenant Architecture**
* Design the platform's multi\-tenancy model, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, per\-tenant configuration, and noisy\-neighbor mitigation.
* Architect reliable tenant provisioning, onboarding, scaling, and decommissioning.
* Ensure tenant data isolation and security across all system layers.


**Scalability \& Distributed Systems**
* Design systems capable of handling large data volumes and concurrent migration workloads.
* Architect async/event\-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, backpressure, retries, and idempotency.
* Define the overall data architecture, including storage, partitioning, streaming, batch processing, and data pipelines.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns while avoiding unnecessary complexity and over\-engineering.


**Reliability \& Security**
* Establish high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and SLA strategies.
* Build security and compliance into the architecture, including encryption, access control, secrets management, auditing, and tenant isolation.
* Define the observability strategy for monitoring, tracing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.


**Integration \& Platform Architecture**
* Architect a scalable connector and integration framework supporting systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, databases, and object stores.
* Design scalable APIs and platform abstractions that support multiple use cases without repeated architectural redesign.
* Partner with DevOps/Infrastructure teams on cloud and multi\-cloud architecture across AWS, GCP, and Azure.


**Technical Leadership**
* Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Make key build\-vs\-buy and technology decisions.
* Lead architecture and design reviews and mentor senior engineers.
* Translate business and product requirements into a clear technical strategy and execution plan.
* Influence engineering teams through technical judgment, expertise, and results.


**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with several years in an Architect, Principal, or Staff\+ role owning system architecture at scale.
* Proven hands\-on experience designing and scaling multi\-tenant SaaS systems in production, including tenant isolation, partitioning, and scaling strategies.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, including event\-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, consistency, fault tolerance, and high\-throughput workloads.
* Strong data architecture experience covering data modeling, partitioning, batch/streaming pipelines, and data\-intensive systems.
* Strong cloud\-native architecture expertise with AWS, GCP, or Azure and the ability to reason across cloud providers.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and frameworks such as SOC 2/GDPR.
* Strong software engineering and coding skills, with the ability to prototype and work directly with complex parts of the codebase.
* Proven technical leadership and influence, with experience setting architecture direction and earning trust across engineering teams.
* Experience with data migration, ETL/integration, iPaaS, or large\-scale connector frameworks is preferred.
* Experience with CRM platforms and APIs, particularly Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho, is a plus.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, Terraform/IaC, and modern CI/CD.
* Experience working with high\-compliance or regulated\-data environments is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, communication, and architectural judgment skills.
* Highly self\-directed and pragmatic, with the ability to balance long\-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
* Experience as a founding architect or early senior technical leader is a plus.


**Education**
**Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.**
**Candidates must attend Phone/video calls and in\-person interviews. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience.**
**Please email your resume to varshitham@petadata.ai**
**After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.**

8b5e1bc4.title: Cloud Engineer
8b5e1bc4.description:
**About The Company**
 Dogma Group is a leading technology consulting firm dedicated to delivering innovative digital transformation solutions for clients across various industries. With a strong emphasis on cloud computing, data engineering, and DevSecOps practices, Dogma Group prides itself on fostering a collaborative environment that drives technological excellence. Our team of experts works closely with organizations to design, implement, and optimize scalable and secure cloud architectures, enabling them to achieve their strategic objectives efficiently. Committed to continuous learning and development, Dogma Group stays at the forefront of emerging technologies to provide our clients with cutting\-edge solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to join a dedicated client project team. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture, data platforms, and DevSecOps practices, with a strong focus on designing scalable, secure, and efficient cloud solutions.
   

  

 You will play a key role in architecting Azure Landing Zones, enabling data governance with Purview, implementing Databricks solutions, and driving CI/CD automation using Azure DevOps, while supporting cross\-cloud migration initiatives.
   

  

 This is a remote position, offering flexibility and the opportunity to work with a dynamic team on complex cloud projects that impact enterprise\-level clients.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in Microsoft Azure cloud platform with proven experience in designing and implementing large\-scale cloud solutions. Relevant certifications such as AZ\-104, AZ\-305, DP\-203, or AZ\-400 are highly desirable. Candidates should have hands\-on expertise in Azure Landing Zones, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Purview, and Azure DevOps. A solid understanding of multi\-cloud migration strategies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep, and networking/security frameworks is essential. Additionally, experience with DevSecOps practices, containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, and familiarity with data engineering ecosystems will be advantageous.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Cloud Architecture \& Engineering:**
* Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Build and manage scalable, secure, and highly available Azure infrastructure solutions.
* Define governance, identity, and security models across subscriptions and tenants.


**Data Platform Engineering**
* Develop and maintain solutions using Azure Databricks for large\-scale data processing and analytics.
* Implement data governance, cataloging, and compliance using Microsoft Purview.
* Collaborate with data teams to optimize pipelines and performance.


**CI/CD \& DevOps**
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep.
* Drive DevOps best practices for efficient and reliable deployments.


**Cloud Migration**
* Lead and support cross\-cloud migration initiatives (AWS/GCP to Azure).
* Perform assessment, planning, and execution of migration strategies.
* Optimize workloads post\-migration for performance and cost efficiency.


**DevSecOps \& Security**
* Integrate security practices into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps).
* Implement vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and security controls.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security standards.


**Monitoring \& Optimization**
* Configure monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Troubleshoot issues and optimize cost and performance.
* Implement high availability and disaster recovery solutions.


**Benefits**
 Joining Dogma Group as an Azure Cloud Engineer offers a competitive benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well\-being. You will have access to flexible remote working arrangements, enabling a healthy work\-life balance. The company provides opportunities for continuous learning through certifications, training programs, and industry conferences. Additionally, employees enjoy comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and performance\-based incentives. We foster a collaborative and innovative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Working at Dogma Group means being part of a forward\-thinking organization committed to technological excellence and impactful client solutions.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Dogma Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience, ensuring a fair and equitable recruitment process. We believe that diverse teams foster innovation and drive better outcomes for our clients and our organization.

7a543587.title: Senior Program Manager - FinOps, FinOps PMO
7a543587.description:
**Description**
 At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalise new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure\-to\-pay, order\- to\-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance.
   

  

 As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Senior Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the APAC region. This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast\-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead cross\-functional teams to deliver large\-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make
   

  

 smart trade\-offs between competing priorities. You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle, not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress\-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post\-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI\-augmented program delivery.
   

  

 You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results, understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.
   

  

 Who Are We Looking For?
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross\-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large\-scale, highly complex business program implementations in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.
   

  

**You Will Demonstrate**
* Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle: from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post\-launch analysis. We do not want someone who knows about AI; we want someone who delivers programs differently because of it.
* The ability to work backwards from the problem: challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.
* High\-judgment decision\-making: distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.
* A metrics\-driven approach that goes beyond tracking numbers to designing measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction), while knowing when to trust judgment over data.
* The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to VPs.
* A track record of force multiplication: creating mechanisms, frameworks, and reusable approaches that deliver value beyond a single program.
* Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross\-functional decision making without authority.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Span Seven Core Dimensions**
* Stakeholder \& Customer Understanding: Engage systematically with stakeholders across FinOps and partner organisations to understand business problems, constraints, and scaling factors. Gather requirements from diverse personas, distinguish representative signal from isolated requests, and drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions and aligned outcomes.


 Systems \& Technical Awareness: Understand the systems landscape deeply — automation limitations, integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress\-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing coordination, producing launch readiness assessments, and synthesising post\-launch data into actionable recommendations.
   

  

* Strategic Thinking \& Decision\-Making: Work backwards from the problem — questioning proposals and testing assumptions rather than perpetuating approaches because "that is how it has always been done."


 Distinguish between one\-way and two\-way door decisions, develop clear program tenets that guide prioritisation, and make smart trade\-offs between time, effort, and deliverables with measurable success criteria.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Process Architecture: Design scalable program mechanisms that create predictable process paths and ensure long\-term success. Streamline or eliminate excess process, steer teams away from classic failure modes, and continually strengthen FinOps PMO effectiveness by delivering innovative, think\-big improvement opportunities.
* Metrics \& Judgment: Design measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics from outcome metrics. Identify the highest\-leverage input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross\-team status inputs and identify leading indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete — using judgment calibrated by experience.
* Execution \& Results Delivery: Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large\-scale programs from initiation through to delivery, on time and with quality. Take calculated risks where bold programmatic moves could deliver disproportionate impact, use AI to amplify personal capacity across the delivery lifecycle, and learn systematically from outcomes.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Effectively communicate with and influence senior, VP\-level stakeholders across multiple parts of the organisation. Write effective narratives, influence without authority across organisations with different priorities, and actively mentor and develop others.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of program or project management experience
* 6\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 6\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle, not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience managing programs in finance operations, procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash, or payroll domains
* Experience designing and embedding AI\-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis, AI\-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
* Track record of creating reusable mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond a single program

**About Globals**
 Globals ITES Pvt Ltd is a cybersecurity company building AI\-first security products for enterprise customers — spanning AI/LLM security and benchmarking, AI\-assisted penetration testing, GRC automation, threat intelligence, and defensive cyber operations. We work with security and IT leadership at commercial organisations to help them find, understand, and close security gaps faster than traditional tooling allows.

 We're hiring a Pre\-Sales Consultant to own the technical relationship with enterprise cybersecurity prospects. You'll run technical discovery, build and deliver proofs\-of\-concept, and lead solutioning across our AI security/LLM benchmarking, AI\-based VAPT, GRC automation offerings — turning security and compliance requirements into demonstrable value that CISOs and IT leaders can act on.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with the sales team on enterprise cybersecurity accounts to scope customer needs, threat exposure, and compliance obligations.
* Run technical discovery calls and demo Globals' capabilities across AI/LLM security and red\-teaming, AI\-assisted VAPT, GRC automation.
* Design and deliver proofs\-of\-concept mapping AI security findings (OWASP LLM Top 10\), GRC automation (ISO 27001, STQC certification, CERT\-In), and threat intel feeds to a prospect's actual environment.
* Own technical RFP/RFI responses and solution proposals for enterprise deals, in partnership with the technical writing team.
* Develop pricing\-aligned solution architectures and competitive battle cards for the sales team.
* Represent Globals at industry conferences and webinars, and contribute to technical content — whitepapers, case studies, benchmark reports — with marketing.
* Feed customer and market technical requirements back into the product and R\&D roadmap.


**Requirements**
 What We're Looking For:
   

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in cybersecurity pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or a SOC/security\-consulting background transitioning into pre\-sales.
* Working knowledge of two or more of: penetration testing / VAPT (OWASP, Burp Suite, Metasploit), AI/LLM security concepts (red\-teaming, adversarial ML, prompt injection), GRC and compliance (ISO 27001, STQC certification, CERT\-In guidelines), threat intelligence (MITRE ATT\&CK, OpenCTI/MISP), or SIEM/EDR and defensive operations.
* Ability to translate technical security concepts clearly for CISOs, IT leadership, and technical evaluators alike.

We build the integration and intelligence infrastructure that grid, DER, and energy market software runs on — working with utilities, DER hardware makers, DERMS/VPP platforms, and energy service companies across the US and Europe. You'll join discovery calls, run live product demos, help scope engagements, and translate a prospect's grid or energy\-market problem into the right solution — without needing to be the one who builds it. Our engineering team handles delivery; you own the conversation. This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role reporting directly to the CEO, with real autonomy in how you run discovery, shape proposals, and represent us at industry events.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

 • Lead and co\-lead discovery calls with prospects — understand their grid, DER, or energy market operations problem and map it to what we can build

 • Write or co\-write technical sections of proposals and RFP responses

 • Represent the company at industry conferences and trade shows (DistribuTECH, RE\+, SEPA, and similar) — running booth demos and technical breakout conversations
   

 • Feed real customer language, objections, and competitive intel back into our product and positioning
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

 Must Have:
   

 • 5–8 years in software/systems engineering or technical delivery, with genuine exposure to the power/utility/energy sector — SCADA, AMI, grid operations, renewable integration, or energy analytics. You don't need to have built a DERMS platform, but you need to understand how one fits into a utility's world.
   

 • Prior experience in a customer\-facing or cross\-functional technical role — presales, solutions engineering, technical account management, or a delivery role that regularly required explaining technical work to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

 • Comfortable reading and discussing system architecture and integration/data\-flow concepts, without needing to build them yourself.
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be writing proposals and presenting to customers regularly.
   

  

 Nice\-to\-have:
   

 • Familiarity with grid/energy protocols and standards: OpenADR, IEEE 2030\.5, DNP3, IEC 61850, SunSpec, OCPP, or CIM/CGMES.
   

 • Exposure to DERMS/VPP platforms, ISO/energy\-market operations, or utility demand response programme delivery.
   

 • Prior experience representing a company at industry conferences or trade shows.
   

  

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 What We Offer
   

 • A high\-autonomy, high\-visibility role with direct exposure to real customer relationships from day one
   

 • The chance to shape how a growing power\-systems software company tells its story in the market
   

 • Competitive compensation in line with the seniority and scope of this role

 We’re partnering with a rapidly growing international SaaS company that is transforming how businesses operate through automation, artificial intelligence, and workflow optimization.
   

  

 The organization serves thousands of business users across North America and is investing heavily in AI\-powered products, intelligent automation, and next\-generation customer experiences.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, AI, Product, and Customer Success, making it an excellent opportunity for engineers who want to move beyond traditional development work and have direct impact on customers, product strategy, and innovation.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work directly with customers and internal teams to identify operational challenges, design solutions, build AI\-powered applications, deploy them into production, and help scale successful implementations across the broader platform.
   

  

 Unlike conventional software engineering roles that revolve around predefined tickets, you’ll take ownership from problem discovery through solution delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a highly entrepreneurial role where you’ll have the freedom to solve real\-world business problems using modern software engineering and AI technologies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer\-Facing Problem Solving
   

  

 Engage directly with customers to understand workflows, challenges, and automation opportunities.
   

  

 Analyze business processes and identify areas where technology can drive efficiency.
   

  

 Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

 AI \& Automation Development
   

  

 Design and build AI\-powered workflows, agents, copilots, and automation solutions.
   

  

 Work with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, tool integrations, and structured AI outputs.
   

  

 Rapidly prototype new ideas and validate them with customers.
   

  

 Software Engineering
   

  

 Build backend services, integrations, and internal tools.
   

  

 Integrate with third\-party APIs and external platforms.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve complex customer\-specific technical issues.
   

  

 Develop scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple customers.
   

  

 Product Collaboration
   

  

 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
   

  

 Identify recurring customer needs and help convert custom solutions into platform capabilities.
   

  

 Contribute to product innovation and roadmap discussions.
   

  

 Ownership \& Delivery
   

  

 Drive projects end\-to\-end from discovery and design to deployment and iteration.
   

  

 Support onboarding and implementation for strategic customers.
   

  

 Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
   

  

 Prior hands\-on software development experience.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and software engineering fundamentals.
   

  

 Experience with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
   

  

 Understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases, and modern web applications.
   

  

 Familiarity with AI/LLM technologies and enthusiasm for building AI\-powered products.
   

  

 Ability to independently break down business problems and build practical technical solutions.
   

  

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Comfortable interacting directly with customers and stakeholders.
   

  

 Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership startup environment.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience with any of the following technologies would be advantageous:
   

  

 Python
   

  

 FastAPI
   

  

 JavaScript / TypeScript
   

  

 React.js
   

  

 Next.js
   

  

 React Native
   

  

 PostgreSQL
   

  

 Supabase
   

  

 AWS
   

  

 REST APIs
   

  

 LLM APIs
   

  

 AI Agents
   

  

 Workflow Automation Platforms
   

  

 B2B SaaS Products
   

  

 Who Will Succeed Here?
   

  

**This Opportunity Is Ideal For Engineers Who**
 Want exposure beyond traditional software development.
   

  

 Enjoy solving real customer problems.
   

  

 Are excited by AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
   

  

 Like working directly with users and understanding business operations.
   

  

 Prefer ownership and impact over narrowly defined responsibilities.
   

  

 Want to influence product direction while continuing to build software.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a role where you can combine engineering, AI, product thinking, and customer interaction, this position offers exceptional growth, responsibility, and visibility.
   

  

 What You’ll Gain
   

  

 Direct exposure to cutting\-edge AI and LLM technologies.
   

  

 Opportunity to work on customer\-facing, business\-critical problems.
   

  

 High ownership and visibility within a growing global SaaS business.
   

  

 Fast learning environment with significant career growth potential.
   

  

 Exposure to product strategy, customer success, and software engineering in a single role.
   

  

 Chance to build solutions that create measurable impact for real customers.

62a9a6a2.description:
### **Job Summary**



As a Medallia Architect, you will be responsible for leading the implementation, configuration, support and continuous improvement of the Medallia Experience Management platform. The role will oversee platform administration, survey programs, integrations, reporting, case management, user enablement and operational governance to ensure reliable delivery of customer and employee experience insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, CX teams, IT teams, data teams, vendors and regional users to translate business requirements into scalable Medallia solutions and ensure high\-quality platform operations across global or regional deployments.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead the Medallia platform team responsible for configuration, administration, support, enhancement delivery and operational governance of Medallia programs.
* Translate business requirements into Medallia solution designs covering surveys, forms, feedback channels, dashboards, reports, alerts, workflows, case management and role\-based access.
* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of Medallia enhancements, including requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare and handover to operations.
* Coordinate integrations between Medallia and enterprise systems such as CRM, contact center platforms, data warehouses, identity management, ticketing tools and reporting platforms.
* Provide functional and technical guidance to team members on Medallia configuration standards, data structures, survey logic, reporting design, workflows and platform best practices.
* Monitor platform performance, data quality, user adoption, issue trends and operational KPIs to ensure stable and effective Medallia service delivery.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex Medallia incidents, integration issues, reporting defects, access concerns and business\-critical platform queries.
* Maintain solution documentation, configuration standards, release notes, operating procedures, support playbooks and continuous improvement backlog for Medallia capabilities.


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in Medallia Experience Management platform administration, configuration, program setup and operational support.
* Good understanding of Medallia capabilities including survey design, invitations, feedback collection, reporting, dashboards, role\-based access, alerts, workflows and case management.
* Experience managing customer experience, employee experience, contact center feedback, transactional surveys or relationship survey programs.
* Knowledge of data management concepts, data feeds, integrations, SSO, user provisioning, hierarchy management, file\-based interfaces, APIs and reporting data structures.
* Hands\-on experience with data lake platforms such as Snowflake, including data ingestion, transformation, integration patterns and operational data management for enterprise applications.
* Practical experience setting up integrations with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, CRM platforms and other business applications using APIs, middleware, file\-based interfaces or data connectors.
* Strong SQL and database management skills, with experience in SQL Server and MySQL, including data querying, analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting to support business and operational requirements.
* Experience working with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define use cases, document process flows and convert feedback program needs into platform configuration.
* Ability to lead a small technical or functional team, assign work, review deliverables, manage priorities, create roadmap and ensure timely resolution of incidents and enhancement requests.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret feedback data, reporting issues, integration errors and platform behavior to support business decision\-making.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with business, IT, vendors and regional teams in a global delivery environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* 8\-10 years of overall IT, customer experience, analytics, digital platform or enterprise application experience.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of practical experience with Medallia platform implementation, integration, configuration, administration, support or program management.
* Medallia certifications or formal Medallia product training in platform administration, reporting, integration or experience management are preferred.
* Experience with CX metrics such as NPS, CSAT, CES, closed\-loop feedback, journey analytics, text analytics or contact center experience programs is an advantage.
* Experience working in global transformation programs, multi\-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.

2846a9fd.description:
### **Job Summary**



As a Genesys Technical Architect, you will be responsible for defining, designing and governing the technical architecture of the global Genesys Cloud contact center platform. The role will translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable Genesys Cloud solutions across Universal UI, voice, digital channels, routing, IVR, integrations, reporting and automation capabilities. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, service owners, integration teams, vendors and delivery teams to ensure architecture quality, platform standardization, solution consistency and successful implementation of Genesys capabilities across regions.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Define the end\-to\-end technical architecture for Genesys Cloud contact center solutions, ensuring alignment with global platform standards, business requirements and enterprise architecture principles.
* Design scalable Genesys Cloud solutions across IVR, call flows, queues, routing strategies, skills, data tables, callbacks, voicemail, digital channels, workforce management, analytics and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Lead technical solution design for integrations between Genesys Cloud and enterprise systems such as CRM, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft Teams, identity management, reporting platforms and middleware solutions.
* Translate business processes, customer journeys and operational needs into technical designs, architecture documents, configuration blueprints and implementation guidelines.
* Provide technical leadership to delivery teams during configuration, development, testing, deployment and transition to operations for new Genesys features and enhancements.
* Review and validate solution designs, integration patterns, security controls, data flows, API usage and configuration changes to ensure stability, performance, maintainability and compliance.
* Missing Telco Architecture capability – Technical knowledge \& setup, Global geo capability of legal laws/regulation
* Internal SHS Infra setup – know\-how \& understanding
* Integration Architecture – Data Lake / DB (Snowflake/SQL/Azure), Pipeline (Snaplogic) \& other middleware with source
* Support complex technical issue resolution by analyzing platform behavior, integration failures, routing logic, call flow defects, performance concerns and configuration dependencies.
* Maintain technical architecture documentation, reusable design patterns, standards, decision logs and roadmap inputs for continuous platform evolution.


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in Genesys Cloud architecture, configuration and implementation for enterprise contact center environments.
* Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud capabilities including Architect call flows, IVR, ACD routing, skill\-based routing, bullseye routing, queues, users, roles, divisions, scripts, wrap\-up codes and reporting.
* Experience designing omnichannel contact center solutions across voice, email, chat, messaging, SMS, callbacks, voicemail and digital engagement channels.
* Strong knowledge of Genesys Cloud APIs, integration patterns, event\-driven architecture, authentication, SCIM/user provisioning, data actions and middleware\-based integrations.
* Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with CRM, ITSM, ERP, Microsoft Teams, identity platforms, data lake, analytics or reporting solutions.
* Good understanding of cloud architecture, security, network connectivity, telephony concepts, SIP, SBC, BYOC/Cloud Voice concepts and enterprise identity management.
* Ability to create technical architecture documents, solution designs, sequence flows, integration specifications, test support documentation and operational handover materials.
* Strong communication and stakeholder \& project management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade\-offs to business, IT and vendor stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications or a related technical discipline.
* 8\-10 years of overall IT experience, including significant experience in contact center technology, cloud platform architecture or enterprise communications solutions.
* Minimum 4\-5 years of practical experience with Genesys Cloud or Genesys PureCloud implementation, configuration, architecture or technical leadership.
* Genesys Cloud certifications such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional, Architect or Developer are preferred.
* Experience with integration platforms and cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snaplogic, REST APIs, JSON, JavaScript or similar technologies is an advantage.
* Experience working in global transformation programs, multi\-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.
* Experience working with managed service providers, platform vendors and distributed support teams across multiple countries and time zones.

9cac629b.title: Technical Architect
9cac629b.description:
At Viamagus, every engineer works with AI every day \- not as a side experiment, but as the core of how we build. We're looking for a
 **Technical Architect** 
 who has shipped real systems, led real teams, and already treats AI tools as first\-class instruments of engineering. You'll own architecture across all client engagements, mentor a team of 15–20 engineers, and shape how an AI\-native consultancy delivers at scale.
 



  




* Direct access to client CTOs \- architecture decisions that actually ship, not slide decks
* Work inside an org where Claude Code, Cursor, and LLM\-native workflows are the default, not the exception
* Lead technical direction on diverse engagements: cloud modernisation, AI product builds, enterprise integrations
* Shape Viamagus's engineering standards, internal tooling, and AI practices from the ground up



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design scalable, secure architectures for client engagements and lead technical due diligence on proposals
* Drive production readiness: incident management, observability, release processes
* Mentor backend, mobile, and cloud engineers \- through architecture reviews, code reviews, and retrospectives
* Be the technical face to client CTOs: translate business objectives into architecture decisions and escalate risks with proposed mitigations
* Enforce security\-first design including threat modelling, data classification, and AI\-specific risks (prompt injection, PII leakage)
* Ensure compliance readiness for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and HIPAA where applicable



  





**What you bring** 




**Engineering foundation** 



* 8\+ years of software development, 3\+ years in an architect or lead role; degree in CS/Engineering (Master's preferred)
* Built and owned systems from scratch to production \- full lifecycle, not slices
* Multiple integration experiences: third\-party APIs, enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, ERP), messaging buses, legacy modernisation
* Built reusable platforms, SDKs, and internal tooling adopted across teams
* Technology\-agnostic: strong in at least one modern backend stack, one frontend framework, and one cloud platform
* AWS or Azure architecture: VPC design, IAM, container orchestration, cost optimisation
* DevOps fluency: Docker, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Terraform or CDK
* Performance tuning, distributed tracing, APM tools (Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent)
* AppSec fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, VAPT remediation, secrets management; ISO/SOC 2/HIPAA exposure a plus



  





**AI\-era fluency (working knowledge of most of these required)** 



* Daily use of AI coding tools \- Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent \- and the ability to articulate where they help and where they fall short
* LLM integration patterns: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models; streaming, function calling, structured outputs
* RAG fundamentals: vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant), embeddings, chunking, retrieval tradeoffs
* Agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step agents, LangGraph or CrewAI
* Prompt engineering: versioning, structured outputs, guardrails, handling hallucinations
* AI evaluation and cost awareness: measuring quality, latency, and cost of LLM\-powered features
* MCP (Model Context Protocol): awareness of what it is and where it fits



  





**Nice to have** 



* Open\-source contributions or published AI tooling
* Real\-time sync experience: CRDTs, Realm, Ditto, or offline\-first architectures
* Technical writing \- blogs, conference talks, or public GitHub work
* Google, AWS, or Azure certifications (a bonus, not a substitute for depth)

25b69eb0.title: Data Architect
25b69eb0.description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Data Architect** 




*Client\-facing \| Solutioning \& Platform Design \| Gurgaon* 




**Role:** 
 Data Architect
 



**Current Delivery Stack:** 
 Microsoft Fabric (with broader Azure \& modern data ecosystem)
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon — On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 Up to 14 years (maximum)
 



**Employment Type** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports to** 
 Director — Capability
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are hiring a Data Architect,not a senior data engineer. This role is about designing data platforms and solutions, not building pipelines day\-to\-day. You will spend a significant part of your time in front of clients: understanding their business, framing the problem, shaping the target architecture, and guiding the delivery team that builds it.
 



 Our current delivery stack is Microsoft Fabric, and you should be fluent enough in it to make credible architecture and design decisions. But the role is stack\-agnostic at its core. We are looking for architects who have designed data solutions across multiple platforms over their career, and who can evaluate trade\-offs between tools rather than defaulting to one. Fabric is what we deliver on today; tomorrow's engagement may demand a different choice, and we want architects who think that way.
 



 The architecture craft we are hiring for is a clear progression from business pain to conceptual model to usable analytics: starting with a precise problem statement, resting on a well\-reasoned data model with clear transformation logic and built\-in data quality, and ending with analytics\-ready outputs that decision\-makers can actually use.
 



  





**A candidate whose CV is primarily a list of pipelines built on a single stack, however senior, is likely a strong data engineer, not the architect we are hiring.** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
 


* **Engage directly with client stakeholders** 
 Engage directly with client business and technology stakeholders to understand their domain, operating model, pain points, and strategic goals.
* **Translate ambiguous business problems** 
 Translate ambiguous business problems into clear architecture requirements, success metrics, and phased delivery plans.
* **Run discovery workshops** 
 Run discovery workshops, present architecture proposals, and defend design choices in front of both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Act as the trusted data advisor** 
 Act as the trusted data advisor across the engagement lifecycle — pre\-sales, solutioning, delivery oversight, and post\-go\-live optimisation.



 Architecture \& Data Modelling
 


* **Own the target\-state architecture** 
 Own the target\-state architecture: conceptual, logical, and physical designs for data platforms, including integration patterns and consumption layers.
* **Design data models** 
 Design data models appropriate to the problem — dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, or domain\-driven — and justify the choice.
* **Define reference architectures** 
 Define reference architectures and architecture decision records (ADRs); establish patterns that multiple delivery teams can reuse.
* **Evaluate tooling and platform trade\-offs** 
 Evaluate tooling and platform trade\-offs; recommend the right fit for the client's maturity, scale, and budget rather than defaulting to a single stack.



 Delivery on Microsoft Fabric
 


* **Shape solutions on Microsoft Fabric** 
 Shape solutions on Microsoft Fabric — OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, Real\-Time Intelligence, and Power BI semantic models — at a design and oversight level.
* **Define the medallion architecture** 
 Define the medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold), data contracts, and Delta Lake / partitioning strategies for each engagement.
* **Guide the delivery team** 
 Guide the delivery team on capacity sizing (F\-SKUs), workload isolation, and cost / performance optimisation. You will review and direct, not write every pipeline.



 Governance, Security \& Quality
 


* **Architect secure, governed platforms** 
 Architect secure, governed platforms using Microsoft Purview, workspace roles, row\-level and object\-level security, sensitivity labels, and lineage.
* **Define data quality frameworks** 
 Define data quality frameworks, testing strategies, and observability approaches that scale across domains.
* **Ensure compliance** 
 Ensure compliance with relevant standards (GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, or industry\-specific) as part of every design.



 Capability Building
 


* **Mentor data engineers, analysts, and junior architects** 
 Mentor data engineers, analysts, and junior architects; raise the design quality of the broader practice.
* **Contribute to internal accelerators** 
 Contribute to internal accelerators, reference architectures, and practice\-level IP.
* **Support pre\-sales** 
 Support pre\-sales — RFP responses, solution estimates, and PoCs — as part of the Capability function.



 Required Qualifications
 


* **Up to 14 years of total experience** 
 Up to 14 years of total experience, with the last several years spent in an architecture or lead\-solutioning capacity — not purely in hands\-on engineering.
* **Track record across more than one platform** 
 Demonstrable track record of designing end\-to\-end data solutions across more than one platform over your career (for example, combinations of Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Teradata, or on\-prem warehouses).
* **Working proficiency in Microsoft Fabric** 
 Working proficiency in Microsoft Fabric at an architecture and design level. Strong Azure data stack experience (Synapse, ADF, Databricks, Power BI) with active Fabric adoption is acceptable.
* **Strong data modelling credentials** 
 Strong data modelling credentials — able to defend dimensional, Data Vault, and normalised designs and pick the right one for the context.
* **Fluent in SQL and comfortable reading PySpark / Python** 
 Fluent in SQL and comfortable reading PySpark / Python; you will review and challenge code, even if you are not the primary author on most engagements.
* **Strong grounding in data governance** 
 Strong grounding in data governance, security, lineage, and compliance.
* **Excellent client\-facing communication** 
 Excellent client\-facing communication — able to lead workshops, present to CXOs, and produce crisp architecture documents in English.
* **Willingness to work on\-site** 
 Willingness to work on\-site from our Gurgaon office and travel to client locations as required.



 Good to Have
 


* Microsoft certifications: DP\-600, DP\-700, or broader architecture certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, TOGAF, DAMA\-CDMP).
* Experience with dbt, Delta Lake internals, and open table formats (Iceberg, Hudi).

* Exposure to open\-source or community\-driven data models and standards relevant to your domain (for example, OMOP or FHIR in healthcare).
* Pre\-sales experience — responding to RFPs, building PoCs, and estimating data programmes.



  





 What We Value
 



 We value architects who think in business outcomes first and technology second. The best data solutions start with a precise problem statement, rest on a well\-reasoned data model, and end with analytics that change how decisions get made. If that is how you think about data — and you want to do it in front of clients, with a strong delivery team behind you we would like to talk.

cc46121d.title: Program Manager, Demand Generation
cc46121d.description:
* Full\-time
* Department: Marketing
* Work Type: In\-Office

**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sectigo** is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud\-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest\-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500\. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.  

  

**Simplicity at Scale.**  

  

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as \#OneSectigo by living out our core values \- Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We're setting up a Demand Generation Operations Support function in Chennai to serve as the execution engine behind our pods. As Program Manager, Demand Generation, you own the operational workflow that turns campaign plays into deployed, monitored outbound. Think of it as a supply chain: a pod and marketing leader calls the plays, the onshore demand center assembles the campaign, and you operationalize it — building the sequences, loading the target lists, dropping the cadences to the right reps on schedule, and tracking execution end to end.


Above all, this is an AI\-first role. You are an AI\-native demand expert who uses advanced AI tools to stitch together multiple threads — intent signals, account data, content, and sequencing — into one clean, efficient engine, and who is relentless about maximizing speed and efficiency. You're the reason precision outbound happens consistently: a disciplined, repeatable, fully visible workflow rather than a set of good intentions. This is a build\-and\-run role for someone who loves turning strategy into scalable operational rhythm.


Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Operationalize the demand workflow. Take campaign plans and target lists from pod leaders and the onshore demand center and build them into ready\-to\-run Sales Loft sequences for rep execution.
* Run the engine AI\-first. Use advanced AI tools to stitch together multiple threads — intent signals, account and content data, and sequencing — automating and streamlining the workflow to maximize efficiency and speed at every step.
* Own list loading and task setup in Sales Loft and Salesforce. Build and load target account/contact lists and deploy tasks so AEs, SDRs, and renewal reps have their plays queued and ready — no chasing, no guesswork.
* Deploy cadences across pods on schedule. Coordinate the “drop” so each pod's reps receive their sequences on the planned launch date, tied to the quarterly campaign calendar.
* Monitor execution and drive compliance. Track whether reps are starting and completing their sequences (all steps), surface reps who are behind, and produce the reporting that keeps outbound disciplined.
* Build activity and coverage reporting. Turn Sales Loft activity data into clear reporting on engagement, dials and conversations, account coverage, and white\-space opportunity.
* Free up the onshore team. Absorb high\-volume operational build work so onshore marketers can focus on campaign strategy, content, and pod planning.
* Maintain the operational backbone. Keep the workflow, documentation, and process standards clean so the engine stays scalable and repeatable as we add pods and segments.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.


How your success will be measured:

* Sequences built and deployed on schedule against the campaign calendar.
* Efficiency and speed gains delivered through AI\-enabled workflow automation.
* Rep adoption and compliance — sequence starts and completions across pods.
* Onshore team capacity freed up as measured by operational work absorbed.
* Data quality and coverage visibility, including account white\-space insight.
* Contribution to predictable, scalable outbound pipeline.


More information about this role:

* This is a full\-time and in\-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week, working in the 3PM IST schedule unless otherwise notified.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Director of Account Based Marketing.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 8,00,000 and INR 11,00,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field is strongly recommended.

**Experience:**

* AI\-first demand expert (must\-have). You are AI\-native and have personally deployed multiple workflows using advanced AI tools — stitching together multiple threads and systems to maximize efficiency — with proven, measurable results doing exactly this in a fast\-paced B2B technology environment.
* Proven project management. A track record of running complex, multi\-workstream programs end to end and on schedule, coordinating across distributed teams and time zones.
* 3–5 years in demand generation operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or campaign/sequence execution — ideally in B2B technology or SaaS.
* Hands\-on sequence\-building experience. Direct experience building and deploying cadences in Sales Loft (or a comparable tool such as Outreach), plus working knowledge of Salesforce and HubSpot.
* Program discipline. You can run tooling “like a program” — build it, deploy it, track adoption, and hold the line on execution and compliance.
* Service\-oriented and structured. You bring structured processes and a genuine service mindset to your internal stakeholders — pod leaders and reps — and make their execution easier.
* Comfort with list building, segmentation, and data hygiene in Salesforce.
* Strong reporting and analytics instincts — able to translate activity data into clear compliance and coverage reporting for leaders.
* Clear communicator across time zones. Excellent written English and proactive, reliable communication with an onshore team and pod leaders.
* Highly organized and able to run multiple pods' workflows in parallel against fixed drop schedules.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Exposure to intent\-data platforms (Intentsify) and ABM programs.
* Familiarity with a pod / segment\-based go\-to\-market model.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**


At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.


Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:**


To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**  

  

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

0d8f7764.title: Customer Engagement Manager
0d8f7764.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Engagement Manager based in India.**
 This is a data\-driven, customer\-facing opportunity focused on improving engagement, product adoption, and customer retention across SaaS solutions. You’ll investigate customer behavior and product usage to identify strategic and at\-risk accounts. The role combines customer relationship management, analytics, product knowledge, and structured problem\-solving. You’ll collaborate closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams to resolve issues and improve the customer experience. You’ll also engage directly with U.S.\-based customers, helping understand their needs and translating insights into actionable solutions. This remote role offers the opportunity to influence both customer outcomes and product development while working regularly across U.S. business hours.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Partner with Customer Success teams to identify strategic and at\-risk customers, assess engagement and adoption levels, and help develop actions that improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Monitor customer and product usage data, dashboards, and engagement signals to identify declining adoption or potential churn risks.
* Investigate individual customer behavior, account history, product usage, and other relevant data to determine root causes and develop clear recommendations.
* Maintain a reliable, data\-informed view of customers requiring attention and track whether interventions are improving engagement and reducing risk.
* Participate in customer meetings, product discussions, presentations, and business reviews to understand customer goals, challenges, and concerns.
* Bring recurring customer issues, feedback, enhancement requests, and product opportunities to Product Management and help validate potential solutions.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering teams to troubleshoot customer\-reported product, integration, and data issues and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where required, ensuring issues are followed through to resolution.
* Communicate customer findings and technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to product improvements by validating new features and workflows with customers and sharing actionable feedback with internal teams.


**Requirements**
* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a comparable customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Proven experience working directly with U.S.\-based customers, including leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting strategic or at\-risk accounts, with an understanding of customer engagement, adoption, retention, and churn indicators.
* Strong analytical and investigative capabilities, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, understand behavior, and guide decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer\-facing web applications, APIs, data integrations, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues alongside technical teams.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and experience working with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously.
* Ability to learn new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly and take ownership in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Experience with K\-12 education technology, enterprise or strategic accounts, student information systems, rostering, assessment platforms, or education data is a plus.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting or BI platforms, CRM systems, Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau, or Power BI is advantageous.
* Willingness and ability to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation.
* Health, accident, and life insurance.
* Retirement savings plan.
* Paid annual leave and paid holidays.
* Paid parental leave and paid leave for qualifying life events.
* Paid year\-end holiday break.
* Work\-from\-home support and related funds.
* Wellness checks and additional wellbeing resources.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Fully remote work environment with collaboration across global teams.
* Varied and challenging work with the opportunity to influence customer experience and product development.
* Supportive, collaborative colleagues and a mission\-driven working environment.

 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company.  We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
