f3f34f3a.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer (AWS / Kubernetes / Terraform / CI/CD)
f3f34f3a.description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Work From Office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
 



**Posted on behalf of our client.** 




  





**Design the leanest, most resilient cloud that scales from ten restaurants to ten thousand without a re\-write — and keep the 2 AM page from ever coming.** 




 Our client — a fast\-growing restaurant\-analytics and consulting startup in Kolkata, founded by leaders from top e\-commerce companies and premier institutes — is hiring a battle\-tested DevOps \& Cloud Engineer: part infrastructure architect, part reliability engineer, part cost optimiser. This is a blank\-slate role for someone who has run real production across more than one cloud and can be trusted to design it right.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 You will own the platform's infrastructure and delivery lifecycle end\-to\-end: architect and provision the AWS footprint (EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, ECR, Route 53\), containerise and orchestrate services with Docker and Kubernetes, and run the data\-and\-messaging backbone (PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka). You'll build the CI/CD pipelines that ship a Node / React / Python stack safely, tame the runtime and web tier (NVM, Pyenv, nginx / Apache, Caddy / Traefik, Certbot), and keep every environment — Dev, QA, Staging, Production — fast, observable, and cheap to run. Above all, you'll bring seasoned, opinionated judgement from multiple cloud ecosystems to recommend the most cost\-effective, seamlessly\-scalable path for every decision.
 



  





**The AI\-Augmented Edge** 
 Here, AI is your primary workforce. You'll use Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini to draft IaC, generate pipeline configs, review infra diffs, and reason about failure modes — targeting a 3x\-5x efficiency gain. You'll practise Cross\-LLM Validation: one model proposes the architecture, another stress\-tests it for cost, blast\-radius, and scaling limits. Your value is measured by uptime, unit economics, and how gracefully the platform scales — not tickets closed.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Cloud Architecture \& IaC:** 
 Design, provision, and harden EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), S3, ECR, and Route 53 as reproducible infrastructure. Own the estate in Terraform / CloudFormation (or Pulumi / CDK) with modular, reviewed, version\-controlled definitions and least\-privilege IAM.
* **Cloud\-Agnostic, Cost\-Effective Judgement:** 
 Bring real experience from more than one provider (AWS plus GCP / Azure / DigitalOcean) to pick the right primitive and avoid lock\-in; right\-size compute, exploit spot / reserved / savings plans, and treat the cloud invoice as a product metric.
* **Containers \& Orchestration:** 
 Containerise every service and run it on Kubernetes (EKS or self\-managed) with sane resource limits, autoscaling, health checks, and zero\-downtime rollouts.
* **Data \& Messaging Backbone:** 
 Operate PostgreSQL (replication, backups, PITR, tuning), Redis (cache / queues), and Kafka (event streaming) as first\-class, monitored, recoverable services. Manage Node (NVM) and Python (Pyenv) runtimes; front the platform with nginx / Apache and Caddy / Traefik with automated TLS via Certbot / ACME.
* **CI/CD \& Automation:** 
 Co\-own GitHub Actions (build, test, scan, deploy) with reproducible builds, artifact versioning in ECR, and blue\-green / canary rollouts. Standardise git\-based, push\-button deploys with fast, auditable rollbacks; manage secrets and config safely (SSM / Secrets Manager / Vault) with no credentials in git.
* **Reliability \& SRE:** 
 Stand up metrics, logs, and traces (CloudWatch, Prometheus / Grafana, ELK, PagerDuty) with actionable alarms; define and defend SLOs, RTO / RPO targets, backups, and rehearsed DR / failover; be first responder for incidents and run blameless post\-mortems.
* **Advisory \& Leadership:** 
 Bring cost / scaling / reliability trade\-off proposals to the CTO; maintain infrastructure runbooks, deployment standards, and on\-call playbooks; mentor engineers on deployment, containers, and operational best practice; partner with the Security Lead on hardening, IAM, network segmentation, and audit\-friendly logging.



  





**Must\-Have** 



* 6\-10 years running production infrastructure for a SaaS / cloud\-native product end\-to\-end.
* AWS depth: hands\-on EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, ECR, Route 53, IAM, and VPC networking in real production.
* Genuine multi\-cloud exposure (AWS plus GCP / Azure / DO) — able to compare and choose, not just operate one.
* Strong Docker and Kubernetes (EKS or self\-managed): autoscaling, rollouts, resource management.
* IaC \& CI/CD: Terraform / CloudFormation and pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions or equivalent) with rollback\-safe deploys.
* Data \& runtime ops: PostgreSQL (backup / replication / tuning), Redis, and the web / runtime tier (nginx / Apache, Caddy / Traefik, Certbot, NVM, Pyenv).
* A track record of cutting cloud spend and scaling systems smoothly — with the numbers to prove it.



  





**Should\-Have** 



* Kafka (or equivalent) for high\-throughput, ordered event pipelines.
* Observability \& SRE: CloudWatch / Prometheus / Grafana / ELK / PagerDuty, SLOs, RTO / RPO, rehearsed DR / failover.
* Solid networking \& TLS: DNS, load balancing, reverse proxies, certificate automation.
* Scripting in Bash plus Python / Node to automate anything that repeats.
* Comfortable in Agile / Scrum and working closely with engineering, product, and leadership.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Degree from a premier institute (IITs / NITs / BITS / IIITs) and/or AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / CKA / CKAD certification.
* Security\-adjacent ops: IAM hardening, secrets management, compliance\-friendly logging.
* AI\-augmented tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini) for IaC drafting, config review, and incident reasoning.
* Prior ownership of infrastructure through rapid growth on a lean budget.

4b8e88ab.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
4b8e88ab.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long\-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer\-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer\-to\-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise\-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.


**Who You Are**
* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.


**What Success Looks Like**
* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well\-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. **Job Description**
**Role Summary**

* Support onboarding, enablement, and adoption initiatives to maximise platform utilisation and customer success.

88da0dee.title: Technical Delivery Manager
88da0dee.description:
**Company Profile**
 Yabx, a FinTech undertaking, aims at simplifying financial access to over two billion un\-banked people in the emerging markets of Africa, Asia, and Latin America using the mobile phone device. With an ambition to democratize such access, Yabx aspires to provide financial services to the under\-served. We, at Yabx use technology and analytics to reduce the cost of delivering financial services, thereby bringing banking to the un\-banked. We do this with the help of our partners who are leading banks, MFIs, credit bureaus, Mobile Financial Providers, MNOs, and handset manufacturers. Incubated by Mahindra Comviva, a global leader in Mobile Financial Services, Yabx is a part of USD 20 Billion Mahindra Group. Led by a team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who have a global experience in managing telecom operators and mobile wallet providers, coupled with strong capabilities in behavioral analytics and risk management, Yabx has an unparalleled edge to provide solutions that help achieve its core purpose of financial inclusion. Nurtured with an aim to provide tailor\-made financial services by leveraging the digital footprints of an individual, Yabx’s mission is to create world\-class innovative products to improve the lives of people who do not have access to regular financial services. Yabx currently operates out of The Hague, New Delhi, Capetown and Nairobi.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Technical Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the successful delivery of projects, ensuring that they are completed on time, minimizing cost over\-runs and meet the established quality standards.
   

  

 This role involves work with internal cross\-functional teams (Comviva and Yabx) and with the partner ecosystem of Telcos and banks, understanding business requirements, identifying risks, and implementing effective strategies to ensure successful project delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital lending software delivery management:** 
 Own the end to end software delivery lifecycle for the Digital Lending platform across Development, QA and rollout in dev, UAT and production environments. Plan and execute software releases by collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps teams; ensuring release readiness through testing, compliance and approvals. Be responsible for the technical architecture, design and delivery of the solutions.
   

  

**Stakeholder Communication and Management:** 
 Establish and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including partners, internal teams, and third\-party suppliers (Datacenter providers, integration partners, etc). Act as a point of contact for project\-related communications, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues. Ensure effective and transparent communication to manage expectations and ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
   

  

**Risk Assessment and Mitigation:** 
 Identify project risks and develop strategies to mitigate them, ensuring a proactive approach to risk management. Implement risk assessment and mitigation plans to minimize project disruptions and maintain progress towards project goals.
   

  

**Resource Management:** 
 Work with the internal departments (Engineering, Data Science, Devops) to allocate and manage project resources effectively. Manage and resolve resource conflicts, ensuring a smooth workflow and project delivery.
   

  

**Quality Assurance and Compliance:** 
 Monitor project deliverables to ensure compliance with established quality standards and requirements. Implement quality assurance processes and methodologies to guarantee the delivery of high\-quality solutions to clients. Work closely with the QA team to conduct thorough testing and validation of project deliverables.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement:** 
 Analyse project performance and gather feedback for process improvement and optimization of project management methodologies. Stay updated with industry best practices, tools, and techniques to enhance project delivery capabilities within the organization.
   

  

**Qualifications And Skills**
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field; advanced degrees or certifications in project management are a plus.
   

  

 Between 6 and 8 years of relevant working experience in an IT product organisation Experience in delivering projects for Financial institutions /Banks.
   

  

 Exposure to lending will be a plus.
   

  

 Proven experience in technical project management and delivery.
   

  

 Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall). Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Technical Program Manager – AI\-Enabled Engineering Pods
   

  

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands\-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud\-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**

a5b270ed.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
a5b270ed.description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery


 You will act as:
   

  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities


 Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
   

  

**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


 Lastly, what we are not looking for
 **,** 
 we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

51a00d17.title: School Engagement Manager / CRM
51a00d17.description:
**Job Description \- Customer Relationships Manager** 




  





**Introduction:** 




 About TagHive Inc.
 



 TagHive Inc., incorporated on April 25, 2017, is a Samsung funded education technology
 



 company with headquarters in South Korea and an office in India. The company’s offerings
 



 include clicker\-based classroom response systems and AI\-powered self\-assessment solutions.
 



 The company offers its solutions under the “Class Saathi” brand in India and under the “Class
 



 Key” brand elsewhere.
 



 TagHive has 24 registered patents and trademarks and 11 others are pending. The company’s
 



 solutions are used in over 10,000\+ class rooms and over 500,000 students have downloaded
 



 the Class Saathi self\-assessment solution.
 



 www.tag\-hive.com
 



  





 About Class Saathi
 



 Class Saathi is a clicker based smart classroom solution that makes formative assessment
 



 easy and fast.
 



 Class Saathi is a combination of a clicker device for each student and a mobile application for
 



 teachers, parents, and the administrators. After teaching a concept in a class, the teacher can
 



 ask a few questions using Class Saathi to gauge the understanding level of each and every
 



 student. The administrators and the parents can also see the learning data on their respective
 



 apps. Class Saathi has over 10,00,000 questions on Maths, Science, Social Studies, and English
 



 for students of Class 1 to Class 10, for CBSE, ICSE and 20\+ state board curriculum.
 



 Class Saathi is aligned with New Education Policy’s objectives of micro\-learning and continuous
 



 assessments. “Data First” approach ensures greater accountability at all levels. Class Saathi is
 



 affordable and does not require schools to upgrade their infrastructure ("no internet" and "no
 



 electricity" are no more the limiting factors in making classrooms smart)
 



  





**Summary:** 




 The Customer Relationships Manager will be responsible for engaging users of the Class Saathi
 



 platform by building and maintaining trusting relationships. They will play a key role in defining
 



 customer engagement strategies and streamlining processes for the end to end deployment
 



 lifecycle of Class Saathi across Governments and Private Schools.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 ● Build and maintain relationships with all users, through strategies and processes, as well
 



 as direct interaction
 



 ● Lead the design and implementation of customer engagement strategies and processes
 



 at scale
 



 ● Create and maintain documentation on deployment status, support status, issues and
 



 resolutions
 



 ● Design and implement mechanisms to collect qualitative and quantitative feedback from
 



 users
 



 ● Coordinate and support any outreach and/or communications
 



  





**Requisite Skills and Experience:** 




 ● At least 2 years of experience working in relationship management, customer relations,
 



 customer support or similar roles
 



 ● Outstanding written and oral communication skills, proficiency in languages other than
 



 English and Hindi preferred
 



 ● An understanding of the education ecosystem, including the Government ecosystem,
 



 and a basic understanding of education policy preferred
 



 ● Experience with creating, implementing and following up on organization wide
 



 processes

802fd7d8.title: Program Manager
802fd7d8.description:
PROGRAM MANAGER

Department: Operations

Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare BPO

Reporting To: Centre Manager

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 5–6 Years

Role Summary

The Program Manager will report to the Centre Manager and work closely with the Patient Care Executive (PCE) and Patient Navigator (PN) operational teams to ensure seamless program delivery and operational excellence.

The role is responsible for program governance, performance monitoring, cross\-functional coordination, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Program Manager will provide end\-to\-end oversight of PCE and PN operations, ensuring adherence to quality standards, achievement of program KPIs, and delivery of exceptional patient support services.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership, people management, stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with demonstrated experience in healthcare operations or healthcare BPO environments.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Program Governance \& Performance Management

\- Ensure effective governance of program operations through regular monitoring, reporting, and review of key performance indicators (KPIs).

\- Track operational performance against defined KRAs, KPIs, quality metrics, productivity targets, and program objectives.

\- Develop and present periodic performance reports, dashboards, and actionable insights to the Centre Manager and Leadership Team.

\- Identify performance gaps and implement appropriate corrective and preventive action plans (CAPA).

\- Drive accountability across operational teams to ensure achievement of program objectives.

2\. Patient Care Executive (PCE) Management

\- Oversee all operational activities related to the PCE team in alignment with the PCE Manager.

\- Ensure adequate staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and effective resource utilization.

\- Monitor PCE productivity, quality adherence, patient engagement, and service delivery metrics.

\- Support coaching, mentoring, and performance improvement initiatives for PCE team members.

\- Ensure compliance with established SOPs, quality standards, and audit requirements.

\- Identify operational challenges impacting PCE performance and drive timely resolution.

3\. Patient Navigator (PN) Management

\- Monitor Patient Navigator performance against defined productivity, quality, and patient experience metrics.

\- Ensure effective patient management through timely coordination, communication, and follow\-up.

\- Guide PNs in resolving operational challenges while maintaining high service and patient support standards.

\- Drive continuous development and performance enhancement within the PN team.

\- Ensure adherence to program processes, SOPs, and defined service standards.

4\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

\- Collaborate closely with the Centre Manager, PCE Manager, PN Team Leads, Quality \& Training Team, and IT to ensure smooth program execution.

\- Facilitate effective communication between operational and support functions.

\- Escalate operational issues appropriately and drive timely resolution.

\- Coordinate with relevant stakeholders for implementation of process changes and operational initiatives.

\- Ensure alignment between business requirements and day\-to\-day program operations.

5\. Operational Excellence

\- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, workflow effectiveness, and resource utilization.

\- Lead process optimization initiatives to enhance productivity, operational effectiveness, and patient experience.

\- Analyze operational trends and identify opportunities for improvement.

\- Support the implementation of new processes, technologies, and operational improvements.

\- Drive a culture of continuous improvement across PCE and PN operations.

6\. Quality \& Compliance

\- Monitor service quality through regular audits, reviews, performance assessments, and feedback mechanisms.

\- Ensure consistent adherence to organizational policies, SOPs, compliance requirements, and quality standards.

\- Identify quality gaps and drive appropriate corrective actions.

\- Review customer/patient feedback and implement improvements based on identified trends.

\- Ensure operational teams maintain required documentation and compliance standards.

Qualifications \& Experience

\- 5–6 years of experience in healthcare operations, healthcare BPO, patient support programs, call centre operations, or program management.

\- Minimum 3 years of experience managing teams in support services or customer engagement programs, preferably within the healthcare industry.

\- Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience.

\- Proven experience in team leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and multi\-level program execution.

\- Strong experience in performance monitoring, KPI management, reporting, and operational improvement.

\- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and operational teams.

\- English \& Hindi proficiency is mandatory, with superior communication proficiency in both languages.

\- Bilingual/multilingual capabilities will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

\- Program \& Operations Management

\- Team Leadership \& People Management

\- Performance Management

\- Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration

\- Stakeholder Management

\- KPI \& KRA Management

\- Strong Communication \& Interpersonal Skills

\- Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking

\- Decision\-Making \& Analytical Skills

\- Quality \& Compliance Management

\- Coaching \& Team Development

Technical Proficiency

The candidate should have good working knowledge of:

\- MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

\- CRM platforms

\- Telephony / Call Centre Management Systems

\- Email Management Software

\- Performance dashboards and reporting tools

\- Basic data analysis and operational reporting

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a results\-oriented healthcare operations professional who can effectively manage PCE and PN operations, drive team performance, monitor program KPIs, and work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced healthcare environment, possess strong leadership and communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to identify operational challenges, implement solutions, and continuously improve program performance and patient experience.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹650,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**About** **Everseen**
======================


Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience.

Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily.

Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world \- including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths \- we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain.

We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.  



Our Culture



Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer\-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions.
We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact.  



Our Values

We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses.

We ARE CUSTOMER\-FIRST. They guide our decisions.

We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit.

We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality.

We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.

**Our Commitment**
------------------


Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion.

Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. Everseen will not tolerate prejudice or discrimination of any kind including without limitation, where based on aspects such as, race, colour, sex, gender, religion, age, family status, disability of any kind, sexual orientation.

Why UKG:


At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.


We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  

  

About the Team
  

The TPM team, is responsible for driving portfolio priority programs that feed into an enterprise SaaS product, with the goal of accelerating the delivery of value to customers. The team is composed of highly skilled practitioners who have expertise in their respective areas and work collaboratively to ensure that value streams are delivering maximum value. The team is committed to driving innovation, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction, and is focused on accelerating better outcomes for our people and our customers.
  

  

About the Role
  

We are seeking a highly motivated Lead Technical Program Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in orchestrating and delivering complex programs that drive strategic outcomes for the organization. Leveraging your exceptional communication skills, technical expertise, and leadership abilities, you will lead cross\-functional teams in executing large\-scale projects while ensuring alignment with business objectives and priorities.
  

  

Responsibilities
  

* Lead and inspire cross\-functional teams through excellent communication and negotiation skills, effectively collaborating with executives and stakeholders to drive consensus and alignment on objectives, scope, and deliverables, consistently advocating for the best interests of the organization while maintaining positive relationships.
* Provide strategic guidance and insight to support decision\-making through data\-driven analysis and your knowledge of industry trends, organizational priorities and technology and architecture trends.
* Drive program management excellence by leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex programs by managing cross\-functional teams, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards, while ensuring programs are aligned with business objectives.
* Foster an outcome\-based strategy and culture by demonstrating strong leadership skills, promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, and championing best practices in program management and execution.
* Exhibit exceptional organizational skills by effectively balancing multiple priorities and dependencies and managing risks and mitigating issues.
* Manage resources effectively, optimizing resource allocation across programs to ensure the efficient and effective use of resources while delivering maximum value to the organization.
* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills by identifying and resolving critical issues, leveraging your professional and technical expertise to implement innovative solutions.

  

About You
  

  

Basic Qualifications
  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years experience as a Technical Program Manager or similar role, with a track record of successfully delivering complex software projects in a SaaS\-based environment.
* Strong understanding of Agile practices, including SAFe, Scrum, LPM, and DevOps.
* Demonstrated expertise in strategic thinking and decision\-making abilities.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate cross\-functional teams.

**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.
   

  

 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe.  Accountable for customer and management for the project

* Weekly report

**Preferred**

**Key Behaviors**
* Transparent for customer and management
* Quick finding issue and escalation
* Frugal and efficiency mindset

**Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. e8d87dfd.title: Solution Architect (Presales) - AI Security
e8d87dfd.description:
Solution Architect (Presales) – AI Security
 



**About Fortinet** 




 Fortinet is a global leader in cybersecurity, delivering broad, integrated, and automated security solutions across networks, applications, cloud, and endpoints. As organizations rapidly adopt AI\-driven technologies, Fortinet continues to innovate and help customers secure modern AI\-powered environments.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Fortinet is looking for a highly skilled Solution Architect (Presales) – AI Security to support enterprise customers in designing and securing AI\-driven environments. This role will work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Customers to position Fortinet’s AI Security portfolio and help organizations address emerging threats related to AI/ML workloads, GenAI adoption, cloud security, and application protection.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* AI data Center security design: Architect zero\-trust segmentation, east\-west traffic inspection, and perimeter defence for AI/GPU cluster environments using Fortinet Solutions
* LLM \& AI workload protection: Implement security controls for LLM inference pipelines, model serving APIs, and AI orchestration layers — including prompt injection defense and model output filtering.
* GPU server hardening
* Threat detection \& SOC integration: Deploy Fortinet solutions to ingest telemetry from AI infrastructure, build AI\-specific detection rules, and automate incident response playbooks.
* 5Network fabric \& SD\-WAN: Design secure inter\-DC connectivity for distributed AI training clusters
* Pre\-sales \& advisory: Lead proof\-of\-concept engagements, deliver technical presentations, and serve as a trusted advisor to Enterprise, Commercial, and Strategic



 customers build and secure AI infrastructure.
 


* Support RFP/RFI responses and technical solution design
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on customer requirements and AI security use cases
* Stay updated on trends related to GenAI, LLM Security, Adversarial AI, and AI governance



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–15 years of experience in Presales / Solution Architecture within Cybersecurity
* Strong understanding of Network Security, Cloud Security, SASE, ZTNA, and Application Security.
* Experience working with AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, APIs, and AI application environments.
* Experience managing enterprise and strategic customer engagements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with AI Security, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, or DevSecOps technologies.
* Understanding of LLM risks and secure AI adoption.
* Relevant certifications such as NSE, AWS/Azure, CISSP, or CCSP.
* Experience with cybersecurity vendors or cloud security companies preferred.



  





**Why Join Fortinet?** 




 Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI and cybersecurity technologies while engaging with leading enterprise customers and strategic digital transformation initiatives.

0565c58b.title: Pre-Sales Executive-Bengaluru/Gurgaon
0565c58b.description:
**Pre\-Sales Executive** 




*Utility Digital Transformation* 




  





**Company:** 
 BCITS
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 3 – 10 Years
 



**Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech (Electrical, Electronics, CS, or IT)
 



  





**ABOUT BCITS** 




  





 BCITS is a leading provider of utility\-focused digital transformation solutions for power, water, and smart utility sectors. Our expertise spans Smart Metering (AMI), Meter Data Management (MDM), Billing, GIS, Workforce Management, and Utility Cloud platforms. We partner with DISCOMs, government utilities, and AMISP organizations to drive large\-scale modernization programs across India.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 BCITS is on a strategic growth trajectory to become the leading Utility Digital Transformation partner across India and select international markets. The Pre\-Sales Executive will serve as the technical and commercial bridge between customer RFP requirements and BCITS’ bSmart product platform offerings including ORMS, RF\-Mesh, uHES, MDM, WFMS, GIS, CSOC, GTD, and AquaGrid along with full AMISP services.
 



  





 The incumbent will be responsible for driving higher bid win\-rates across large\-scale projects and converting tenders, RFPs, and customer requirements into compelling, compliant, and solution\-oriented proposals aligned with customer and business objectives.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* **Bid \& RFP Management:** 
 Track and manage tenders across KPPP, GeM, and other e\-Procurement portals for ESCOMs, KPTCL, BESCOM, and PFC/REC AMISP projects. Drive end\-to\-end RFP response management including eligibility assessment, technical and commercial documentation, EMD, PBG, and MAF submissions.
* **Solution Engineering:** 
 Design and configure end\-to\-end solutions across the BCITS bSmart platform including Billing/CIS, AMI (RF\-Mesh, Cellular HES, MDM), WFMS, GIS, and Cloud solutions aligned to customer RFP requirements across DBFOOT, Turnkey, OEM, and SI engagement models.
* **Costing \& Pricing:** 
 Prepare detailed BoQ, BoM, and commercial pricing models covering Pay\-per\-Meter, Pay\-per\-Consumer, Capex, Opex, and ATS structures. Collaborate with Finance teams on margin analysis, working capital planning, and PBG impact assessment.
* **Customer Engagement:** 
 Conduct product demonstrations, POCs, technical workshops, and pre\-bid discussions with DISCOM CGMs, IT Heads, and AMISP stakeholders. Address bidder queries, clarifications, and addenda responses within defined timelines.
* **Partner \& OEM Coordination:** 
 Manage consortium and subcontracting engagements with cloud providers, IT infrastructure partners, meter OEMs, telecom providers, and system integrators. Coordinate MAFs, technical compliance documents, and partner certifications.
* **Compliance \& Differentiation:** 
 Ensure adherence to SBD requirements, PFC AMISP guidelines, REC empanelment norms, CMMI L5, ISO 27001, and DPDP Act compliance. Develop win themes that effectively position BCITS’ 25\+ years of utility expertise and competitive differentiation.
* **Knowledge Management:** 
 Build and maintain a centralised repository of case studies, compliance matrices, datasheets, OEM certificates, past project credentials, pricing benchmarks, and proposal templates for future bid readiness.
* **Pipeline \& Reporting:** 
 Maintain bid pipeline and opportunity tracking within CRM systems. Support sales governance through pipeline reviews, forecasting, win/loss analysis, and reporting aligned to the FY revenue plan.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  




* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or Information Technology is mandatory. An MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Power Management will be preferred for Manager\-level roles.
* **Experience:** 
 3 –10 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Bid Management, or Solution Consulting within Utility, Power Distribution, Smart Metering, or IT System Integration domains. Exposure to ESCOM, DISCOM, RDSS, AMISP, Smart City, or PSU IT projects and bidding environments is highly preferred.
* **Domain Skills:** 
 Strong understanding of Smart Metering (AMI/AMR), HES, MDM, RF\-Mesh and Cellular Communication technologies, Billing \& CIS, GIS, Workforce Management Systems, Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure), and Cyber Security fundamentals.
* **Tools \& Platforms:** 
 Proficiency in MS Office (Advanced Excel and PowerPoint), MS Project, Visio, CRM platforms (Zoho / Salesforce), GeM, KPPP, and various e\-Procurement portals.



  





**WHY JOIN BCITS?** 




  




* Contribute to high\-impact digital transformation initiatives across India’s Power, Water, Public Sector, and Government domains.
* Collaborate with a team of 25\+ years of domain\-deep utility technology veterans.
* Be at the forefront of India’s RDSS and AMISP modernization drive.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives tied to bid wins.

c5fbfbba.title: Domain Pre Sales AP
c5fbfbba.description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre\-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions\-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Contribute**
* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C\-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.


**What We’re Seeking**
* Exceptional executive\-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C\-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior\-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real\-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network\-specific operating models.
* End\-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy\-policy

2d1ba674.description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on\-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross\-platform solutions
* Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions
* Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer\-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities
* Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one\-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy
* Promoting end\-to\-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever\-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
* (OT) \- Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap.


**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**
* 5\+ years experience in pre\-sales/sales engineering or graduate of Palo Alto Networks Academy Program
* Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.
* Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred
* Influencing and gaining buy\-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer\-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre\-sales role is ideal
* Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
* Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
* Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
* Understanding of sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi\-product solutions are preferred
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Proficient in English


**The Team**
 Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand\-in\-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.
   

  

 You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

ce3a404c.description:
Sr. Engineer \- Cloud Technologies N**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  

  

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  

  

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

**Lead Consultant – DevOps \& Cloud Engineer**

  

In this role, the DevOps \& Cloud Engineer is a specialized professional who designs, develops, and maintains robust, scalable search and indexing systems utilizing technologies like Apache SolrCloud, ZooKeeper, and associated backend services.

  

This role bridges the gap between complex data processing, distributed search infrastructure, and application development, ensuring that data is indexed efficiently, retrieved rapidly, and the search platform remains highly available, secure, and performant for critical business operations.

 **Responsibility:**

  

* Design, deploy, and maintain highly available Apache SolrCloud clusters in production environments.
* Configure and manage ZooKeeper clusters to support distributed SolrCloud operations.
* Develop and enhance RESTful APIs for search, indexing, and data retrieval services.
* Build scalable backend applications and microservices using Scala.
* Develop Python scripts for automation, monitoring, deployment, and operational tasks.
* Manage Solr collections, shards, replicas, indexing pipelines, and schema configurations.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot Solr, ZooKeeper, and application\-related issues.
* Optimize search relevancy, query response times, and indexing performance.
* Create and maintain Docker images and containerized deployments for applications and services.
* Administer Linux servers, including system monitoring, patching, security, and performance tuning.
* Automate routine operational activities using Shell and Python scripting.
* Perform root cause analysis and resolve production incidents in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Follow best practices for security, scalability, high availability, and system reliability.

 **Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business information systems (IS), computer science or related field, or equivalent\-related IT experience
* Work on real\-world projects and optimize search performance and API development using Scala.
* Administration using Linux and DevOps exposure

 **Skills**

  

* Apache Solr Cloud Administration and Development
* ZooKeeper Cluster Management
* REST API Development
* Scala Programming
* Python Scripting and Automation
* Linux System Administration
* MS SQL Database
* Docker Containerization

085c1979.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

This role combines technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to demonstrate how SolarWinds solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.
