Success in this role requires a consultative approach, the ability to understand customer business objectives, and the technical skills to architect and demonstrate effective solutions.

* Partner with Sales teams throughout the customer lifecycle to support new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, operational challenges, technical requirements, and success criteria.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations of SolarWinds Service Desk and Web Help Desk tailored to customer use cases and business outcomes.
* Design and support proof\-of\-concept (POC) and trial engagements, enabling customers to validate solution value through guided evaluation.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on IT Service Management best practices, workflows, automation, service delivery, and operational maturity.
* Develop technical strategies and solution recommendations that align with customer business goals.
* Respond to technical questions, RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.

* Maintain awareness of industry trends, market developments, competitive positioning, and emerging technologies within ITSM and Enterprise Service Management.
* Support enablement initiatives, internal training, partner activities, and field marketing programs as needed.

* Strong presentation and demonstration skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

Founded in 2009 as Semafone, Sycurio supports organizations in over 50 countries across five continents, partnering with leading brands worldwide. Backed by major investor Livingbridge, Sycurio continues to pioneer solutions that make payments secure and seamless

* Demo and asset improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of demonstration environments, technical collateral and standardized solution assets

**Experience Required**
* Five or more years of pre\-sales, sales engineering, solution consulting or partner solutions experience in enterprise SaaS or technology environments
* Strong expertise in at least one of the following domains: contact centers and CCaaS; telephony and IVR; CRM integrations; digital payments; or PCI\-compliant systems
* Experience supporting partner\-led sales motions with BPOs, GSIs, MSPs, consulting firms, OEMs or technology alliances
* Experience working with global service providers such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Concentrix, Presidio or comparable organizations is strongly preferred

* Working knowledge of API\-based architectures, cloud environments and system integrations; AWS experience is preferred
* Ability to produce clear high\-level designs, document requirements and explain data flows, dependencies and integration patterns
* Demonstrated success delivering customer presentations, technical workshops and product demonstrations to mixed technical and executive audiences
* Experience responding to RFIs, RFPs and enterprise tender requirements
* Excellent written and verbal English communication with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts
* Exposure to PCI DSS, payment security, omnichannel payments, fraud reduction or sensitive\-data protection is highly desirable


**Technical Strengths**
* REST APIs, webhooks and cloud\-based integration patterns
* Contact\-center platforms, telephony, IVR and external conferencing or call\-transfer architectures
* CRM, CCaaS and payment\-service\-provider ecosystems
* Security, compliance and sensitive\-data\-handling concepts
* Structured solution documentation, reusable architectures and commercially viable design decisions
* Chatbot design experience and understanding of programming languages, cloud functions and webhooks, API and system integration and dialog design


**What Success Looks Like**
* Partner\-led opportunities progress faster because technical requirements and risks are addressed early
* Partners can independently identify, position and initially qualify appropriate Sycurio use cases
* Solution designs are accurate, standardized, scalable and aligned with Sycurio product capabilities
* Customer demonstrations and workshops clearly connect technical capability to business outcomes
* Partner feedback is captured and converted into actionable input for Product and Engineering


**Why Join Sycurio**
* Help build a high\-priority global partner motion from a growing Bengaluru hub

* Join a well\-funded international business that combines entrepreneurial pace with the discipline of an established organization

3729c70f.title: Senior Lead Engineer – Cloud Platform, DevOps & Site Reliability
3729c70f.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
**General Summary:**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically strong **Senior Lead Engineer \- Cloud Platform, DevOps \& Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** to drive the architecture, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of mission\-critical cloud services within the IoT organization.


In this role, you will lead the design and operation of large\-scale distributed systems, drive modernization initiatives, influence architecture decisions, and establish engineering best practices across multiple teams. You will partner with development, quality engineering, product management, and operations teams to build highly available, secure, resilient, and scalable cloud\-native platforms.


The ideal candidate has deep expertise in cloud technologies, Kubernetes, observability, automation, infrastructure as code, incident management, and production operations, with a proven track record of leading complex projects and mentoring engineers.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for highly scalable cloud\-native platforms and services.
* Drive strategic initiatives focused on reliability, performance, security, automation, and operational excellence.
* Lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor and coach engineers across multiple teams, fostering engineering excellence and best practices.
* Partner with stakeholders to define long\-term platform and infrastructure roadmaps.

**Cloud \& Platform Engineering**

* Architect, develop, and operate cloud infrastructure across Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Define infrastructure standards and governance through Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Lead cloud migration, modernization, and platform optimization initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and operational requirements.
* Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through FinOps principles and resource governance.

**DevOps \& Automation**

* Drive CI/CD strategy and platform engineering initiatives across multiple products.
* Build and maintain secure, scalable, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Promote automation\-first approaches for infrastructure provisioning, remediation, testing, and operational workflows.
* Champion GitOps, configuration management, and infrastructure automation practices.

**Reliability, Performance \& Scalability**

* Lead capacity planning, scalability assessments, performance benchmarking, and load testing activities.
* Drive root cause analysis and preventive actions for production issues.
* Conduct chaos engineering exercises to improve system resilience.
* Establish performance and reliability standards across engineering teams.

**Collaboration \& Communication**

* Work closely with engineering leadership, architects, product teams, and customers to align technology solutions with business objectives.
* Communicate technical strategies, risks, operational status, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Influence organizational best practices for cloud operations, security, and software delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8\+ years of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE experience.
* 5\+ years of experience leading large\-scale cloud platform or infrastructure initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional engineering teams and driving technical strategy.

**Technical Requirements**

**Cloud Technologies**

* Expert\-level experience with Azure and/or AWS.
* Deep understanding of compute, networking, storage, identity, security, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience designing and operating enterprise\-scale cloud platforms.

**Containerization \& Platform Engineering**

* Strong expertise with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud\-native ecosystems.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
* Experience building multi\-cluster and multi\-region deployment architectures.

**Infrastructure as Code \& Automation**

* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, Pulumi, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation.
* Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages.
* Experience implementing GitOps using tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.

**CI/CD \& DevOps**

* Extensive experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, or similar platforms.
* Expertise in deployment automation, release management, and software delivery pipelines.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, DevSecOps, and shift\-left practices.

**Observability \& Reliability**

* Expertise in monitoring, logging, and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog.
* Experience defining and implementing SLI/SLO frameworks.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and operational excellence mindset.

**Systems \& Networking**

* Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, load balancing, CDN, network security, and distributed systems.
* Experience with large\-scale production environments supporting mission\-critical workloads.

**Databases \& Distributed Systems**

* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Knowledge of distributed systems design, scalability patterns, caching, messaging, and event\-driven architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in large\-scale SaaS, IoT, Telecom, CPS, or distributed cloud platforms.
* Experience building highly available global services supporting millions of users/devices.
* Knowledge of FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience with security compliance frameworks and cloud governance.
* Azure Solutions Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, AWS Professional, Kubernetes (CKA/CKS), or equivalent certifications.
* Experience driving platform modernization and engineering transformation initiatives.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor across the organization.
* Drive engineering excellence, innovation, and operational maturity.
* Influence architecture and technology strategy across multiple programs.
* Develop and mentor future technical leaders.
* Champion reliability, scalability, automation, and customer\-first engineering culture.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8 **\+ years** of Software Engineering or related experience.

**OR**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5 **\+ years** of Software Engineering or related experience.

**OR**

* PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and **5\+ years** of Software Engineering or related experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, Go, C\+\+, or similar.
* 5\+ years of experience designing and operating cloud\-native distributed systems.
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations.

**Overview**
* Blue Yonder is a leading AI\-driven Digital Supply Chain and Cognitive Planning Solutions company, enabling global enterprises to transform end\-to\-end supply chain operations through intelligent, autonomous, scalable, and cloud\-native planning platforms.
* Leveraging advanced AI, Machine Learning, Optimization, and Agentic AI, Blue Yonder empowers smarter, faster, and more resilient decision\-making across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Fulfillment, Logistics, and Manufacturing.
* We are seeking highly skilled Solution Architects / Sr. Solution Architects with deep expertise in Supply Chain Planning implementations, strong consulting and solutioning capabilities, and proven customer engagement experience.


**Scope**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementations of Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning solutions (ESP, DSP, IO, OP, S\&OP/IBP, Production Planning, Supply Planning). Architect scalable, high\-performance planning solutions aligned with customer business objectives and industry best practices.
* Drive solution lifecycle from requirements gathering, design, configuration, integration, SIT/UAT, Go\-live, and Hypercare. Provide thought leadership on supply chain transformation initiatives and AI\-enabled planning journeys.
* Mentor consultants and guide implementation teams across functional and solution architecture areas.
* Support integration with ERP, APS, MES, WMS, TMS, Data Lakes, and Cloud platforms.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and validate complex supply planning models (multi\-echelon, constrained planning, deployment, inventory optimization, sourcing prioritization, capacity planning, scenario modeling).
* Handle challenges involving solver behavior, planning trade\-offs, data quality, performance optimization, and scalability.
* Develop solution design documents, functional specifications, data mapping, and testing strategies.
* Communicate business cases to Product Management and Development for future product enhancements.
* Support customer success initiatives, driving adoption of advanced planning capabilities.
* Act as a trusted advisor, enabling faster deployments and improved customer adoption through AI\-enabled methodologies.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning implementations and consulting.
* Proven hands\-on implementation experience in BY ESP, Demand Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Order Promising, and Advanced Supply Chain Planning solutions.
* Strong implementation experience in similar planning platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, OMP, SAP APO / IBP, and Oracle Supply Chain Planning will be considered an added advantage.
* Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex global supply chain transformations across CPG, Hi\-Tech, Process Manufacturing, Automotive, and Industrial Manufacturing industries.
* Strong supply chain domain expertise is mandatory and non\-negotiable.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently drive solutioning discussions and architect scalable solutions for complex customer requirements.


**Good To Have**
* Experience in SQL Python
* Experience with ORACLE and SNOWFLAKE databases
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain data models
* Experience with cloud\-native planning architectures
* API and Integration architecture understanding
* BY Platform / Data Cloud / BYDM exposure


**AI / Digital Skills**
* Understanding of AI/ML\-driven planning capabilities in Supply Chain.
* Exposure to ML\-based forecasting and intelligent planning solutions.
* Knowledge or experience in Agentic AI, AI\-driven automation, or GenAI\-based implementation accelerators will be a strong advantage.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

96c00255.description:
NVIDIA’s Solution Architect team is looking for a AI\-focused Solution Architect with expertise in Large Language Model, generative AI, agentic AI. We work with the most exciting computing hardware and software, driving the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence. We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end\-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as Megatron\-LM, Megatron\-Bridge, AutoModel and PyTorch.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. c227258e.description:
**Overview**  

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager** for the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.


As a **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager** for the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, you will be managing the full spectrum of regulatory environmental requirements, including Federal, State, and local regulations with emphasis on air, water, waste management and water quality permitting, with a fundamental understanding of environmental management systems. Additionally, you will identify environmental aspects and ensure Microsoft data centers remain in full compliance, communicate these requirements to all stakeholders and senior management, and provide training online and/or in person.


This opportunity will allow you to actively participate in a dynamic, challenging, and exciting environment. You will be working independently in\-region and will represent Microsoft to our external and internal customers. You will have a great opportunity to continue learning new tools, work with other Environmental PMs across the globe, third\-party environmental consultants, and as such will grow and develop your career well beyond your established goals. This position requires you to work on location, in one of our data centers in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, with occasional travel to other locations.


Microsoft’s Cloud Operations \& Innovation (CO\+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager**, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO\+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity \& Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.


Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.


With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever\-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world\-class cloud provider.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities:**

* Manage environmental compliance program for operating sites and handover of construction projects to operations.
* Support operations personnel in completing regulatory obligations and addressing permit requirements.
* Interact with facility personnel, company management, legal counsel, environmental sustainability team, and other relevant internal stakeholders to communicate environmental requirements, identify compliance issues, act as a technical resource, and coordinate on key initiatives.
* Define and implement necessary training for facility operations personnel for managing environmental issues.
* Support site incident investigations.
* Interact with regulatory agency personnel on major environmental issues.
* Monitor development of legislative changes in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, analyze potential impacts on operations, and provide updates to the site personnel.
* Embody our culture and values.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in Environmental Health and Safety Worldwide Regulations
	+ OR equivalent experience.

**Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of combined experience in environmental permitting and compliance management in APAC.
* Experience with Enhesa, Regscan, EIA Tracker, Enablon, Intelex or similar tools.

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

817abeb6.title: Program Manager, Supply chain, JWO
817abeb6.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
  

  

We are optimizing the shopping experience for Amazon’s Customers in the Physical retail space. This role will be a key member of the program team located in Hyderabad supporting Just Walk Out (JWO) tech and business teams. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-energy and ever\-changing environment.  

  

A successful candidate will:  

* Have the ability to work independently in a broad array of environments.
* Manage cross\-functional project teams, planning and organizing, and executing complex projects across multiple organizations and stakeholders to enable the launch of new sites at scale.
* Build strong partnerships with operations leaders to understand improvement opportunities.
* Have the ability to work in fast\-paced environment.
* Confidence operating in a highly ambiguous and iterative business space.
* High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Willingness to challenge and influence senior leaders through data driven insights.
* Able to work with internal and external partners to drive long term solutions.

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
* Build relationships and partner across cross\-functional teams to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and partners to deliver on project goals. Coordinate a portfolio of programs from inception to delivery.
* Define and implement metrics to measure performance across procurement, operations and transportation logistics.
* Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading meetings to align on project requirements.
* Communicate program status updates to the stakeholders and senior leadership on a regular basis.
* Provide program insights and data driven recommendations to support strategic decisions.
* Communicate efficiently with internal and external partners to drive process improvements.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing service providers and vendors

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

89c352fa.title: Service Delivery Manager
89c352fa.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier
 **agentic platform for personalization** 
 .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the
 ***entire***
 customer journey.
   

  

* We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
* We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
* We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer\-first work marketers were always meant to do.


 And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —
 **Loomi** 
 — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.
   

  

**About The SDM Team**
 The Service Delivery Management team at Bloomreach is the engine behind every successful customer implementation. We don't just manage projects — we orchestrate complex, multi\-workstream implementations that bring Bloomreach's AI\-powered platform to life for the world's leading brands.
   

  

**What makes our SDM team different in 2026:**
* AI\-native operations — We use Von (our AI copilot), automated processes, and intelligent workflows to eliminate manual overhead and focus on high\-value delivery
* Agentic tooling — ClickUp automations, Slack\-integrated utilization tracking, and automated retrospective analysis are standard operating procedure
* Commercial ownership — SDMs own the services metrics for their projects, identify upsell opportunities, author/ review SOWs, and drive revenue through delivery excellence
* Cross\-pillar delivery — We implement across Marketing (Engagement), Search (Discovery), DataHub, and Loomi AI for Shopify (LAIS), often on the same project alongside Content platform


**The Role**
 As a Service Delivery Manager based in India, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery of Bloomreach implementation projects for customers across EMEA and APAC. You'll manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and serve as the primary delivery contact for customers — ensuring every project lands on time, on budget, and with measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This is not a traditional PM role. You'll be expected to leverage AI tools and automation to operate at a higher level — spending less time on status updates and more time on strategic delivery, risk mitigation, and commercial growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery \& Execution**
* Own the project plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, and critical path for 8–12 concurrent implementation projects
* Manage customer launches on the Bloomreach platform, including data migration, SDK integration, Event Streams / Item Collections setup, and go\-live readiness
* Facilitate customer meetings, articulate business requirements, and translate them into actionable implementation plans
* Provide proactive reporting — leveraging automated reporting tools (Von, ClickUp) rather than manual slide decks
* Own escalation management — identify risks early, communicate clearly, and drive resolution with the right stakeholders


**Commercial \& Strategic**
* Identify opportunities to sell additional services during project delivery — create Salesforce opportunities, helping in scoping and estimation
* Own the services metrics for your project portfolio — track utilization, manage scope, and ensure profitability
* Partner with Account Managers and CSMs to align delivery with the customer's broader success plan and renewal timeline


**AI\-First Operations**
* Use Von and other AI tools for meeting prep, status reporting, customer research, and project analysis
* Build and maintain automated workflows (ClickUp, Slack, Zapier) to streamline repetitive delivery tasks
* Contribute to the team's automation roadmap — propose and implement new ways to use AI in service delivery
* Use data and dashboards to drive project decisions, track delivery health, and identify patterns across your portfolio


**Collaboration**
* Work closely with Business Consultants (BCs), Solutions Consultants (SCs), AMs, and CSMs to ensure seamless handoffs and aligned delivery
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams on technical blockers, feature requests, and platform capabilities
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives like LAIS rollouts, DataHub migrations, and One Platform upgrades


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* 5–7 years of experience in project/program management within SaaS, martech, or digital services
* Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent implementation projects (10\+ simultaneously)
* Strong understanding of web technologies — APIs, SDKs, webhooks, data pipelines, frontend/backend architecture
* Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and comfort building automations within them
* Commercial awareness — experience with SOW review, services scoping, and revenue tracking
* Excellent communication skills — ability to run customer\-facing meetings, write clear status reports, and manage stakeholder expectations across timezones (EMEA/APAC overlap required)
* Comfort with AI tools — active user of AI assistants, automation platforms, or similar technology in a professional context


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with CDP/martech platforms (Bloomreach, Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC, Emarsys, or similar)
* Familiarity with Jinja templating, SQL, or scripting languages
* Experience working in a globally distributed team with EMEA/AMER stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ or services quoting processes


**What Success Looks Like**
**Timeframe**
**Milestone**
**30 days**
 Onboarded on Bloomreach platform, tools (Von, ClickUp, Slack workflows), and processes. Shadowed 2–3 active projects.
   

  

**60 days**
 Independently managing 4–6 projects. First automated status report generated. The first customer meeting led solo.
   

  

**90 days**
 Full portfolio of 8–12 projects. First services upsell opportunities identified. Contributing to the team automation roadmap.
   

  

**6 months**
 Recognized as a reliable delivery partner by AMs and CSMs. Delivering projects on time with \>90% customer satisfaction. At least one new automation or process improvement shipped.
   

  

**Why Bloomreach**
* AI\-first company — You'll work with cutting\-edge AI (Loomi) and be expected to use AI in your own work, not just deliver it to customers
* Global impact — Your projects will power personalized experiences for millions of consumers across the world's leading brands
* Growth trajectory — The India SDM function is new, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how it operates from the ground up
* Collaborative culture — You'll work with smart, passionate people across engineering, product, sales, and customer success


 More things you'll like about Bloomreach:
   

  

**Culture:**
* A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
* We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
* We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
* We work virtual\-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
* We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
* We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities \- every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer\*.
* The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4\.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4\.9/5


**Personal Development:**
* We have a People Development Program \- participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing \& updating competency maps for select functions.
* Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work\-related communications \& decision\-making challenges.\*
* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow\-up check\-ins.
* Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)\*


**Well\-being:**
* The Employee Assistance Program \-\- with counselors \-\- is available for non\-work\-related challenges.\*
* Subscription to Calm \- sleep and meditation app.\*
* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
* We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
* Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.\*


**Compensation:**
* Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.\*
* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.\*
* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
* We reward \& celebrate work anniversaries \-\- Bloomversaries!\*


*(\*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)*
**Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!**
*If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it \- we will be very grateful!*
*Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.*

bb557641.title: Service Delivery Program Manager
bb557641.description:
**Who We Are**
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award\-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting\-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people\-first culture.
   

  

 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end\-to\-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile \& Digital Marketing \| Enterprise AI \| Customer Care AI \& Technology \| Enterprise Technology Modernization
   

  

**Location \& Flexibility**
 Noida, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end\-to\-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi\-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large\-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud\-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and own the end\-to\-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision\-making processes.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.


**Cloud Migration Execution**
* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift \& shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero\-downtime or minimal\-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third\-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.


**Modernization \& Transformation**
* Champion cloud\-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re\-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud\-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud\-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).


**Financial \& Risk Management**
* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M\+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.


**Stakeholder Management \& Change Management**
* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of program/project management experience with 5\+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large\-scale migrations ($10M\+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments with 500\+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross\-functional teams of 20\+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation
* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers
* Understanding of networking (VPC,VPN, DirectConnect/Interconnect/ExpressRoute), IAM, and security in cloud
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes,CI/CD, Terraform/IaC, and DevOps toolchains
* Familiarity with migration tooling: AWS MGN, Google Migrate, Azure Migrate, Velostrata, CloudEndure, etc.
* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*
 We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
   

  

 For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Compensation Range: ₹45L \- ₹60L

68279e7d.title: Engagement Manager- HCM Implementation (US Shift)
68279e7d.description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)\- HYD based**
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
   

  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.


**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

cae4a985.description:

**Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?**
**About Our Team**
 Our Academic \& Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research \- turning insights into outcomes.

 This is a sales role to drive growth and strengthen customer value across our portfolio of data, analytics and SAAS solutions.
   

  

 This role brings together deep data and domain expertise with strong commercial acumen to engage senior stakeholders, shape strategic discussions, and lead complex, high\-value opportunities. The SEM will play a key role in driving new business growth, supporting renewal success, and enabling long\-term business growth across large, strategically important accounts.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

Partner and align with Account Managers as appropriate to maximize account success, while remaining accountable for driving opportunity creation and deal closure.
* Expand stakeholder networks by building multi\-level engagement and securing broad organizational support.
* Lead engagements where analytics, AI, and data\-driven insights are central to customer decision\-making.

 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. 5caa4563.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
5caa4563.description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high\-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.*
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
 You will own end\-to\-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the
 **packet core** 
 , the
 **signalling plane** 
 , and
 **billing \& settlement** 
 . You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on\-time technical delivery.
   

  

 This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch\-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the MNO technical onboarding program end\-to\-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
* Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP\-over\-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS\-over\-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
* Coordinate billing \& settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
* Program\-manage the multi\-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel\-run and rollback planning, and de\-risking the transition away from single\-supplier dependency.
* Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross\-functional launch\-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
* Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing\-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
* Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.


**Sound like you? You bring:**
 You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi\-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.
   

  

* 8\+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands\-on time in the signalling plane
* Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
+ NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
+ DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy \& topology
+ A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

* NB\-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control\-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel\-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
* Hands\-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per\-partner signalling readiness.
* Working understanding of billing \& settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57\), RAP (TD.32\), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
* Demonstrated track record shipping cross\-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
* Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.


**It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With**
* NTN, NB\-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
* SMS\-over\-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP\-via\-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control\-plane CIoT).
* Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming\-hub environments.
* Familiarity with BCE and next\-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance\-system integration for billing.
* Exposure to clearing\-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.


**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months)**
* A single, trusted onboarding program that partner\-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
* Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post\-launch surprise.
* The multi\-supplier roaming transition de\-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single\-supplier lock\-in surprises.
* Program\-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO Statement**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

956122b8.title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
956122b8.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.  

  

Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision\-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re\-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever\-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well\-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.  

  

We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of \~200\+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10\+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.  

  

We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly\-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self\-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self\-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities \-
  

  

* Define and manage cross\-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade\-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross\-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

  

A day in the life  

TFS has over 200\+ engineers, and 20\+ product \& program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.  

  

About the team  

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation \& management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with \~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
