da2e8ec1.title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
da2e8ec1.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect \& Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642\)**
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect \& Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end\-to\-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
   

  

 The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user\-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end\-to\-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API\-led, event\-driven, workflow\-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted\-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote\-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed\-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent\-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI\-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production\-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self\-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade\-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7\+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise\-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non\-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL\-aligned service management processes.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect\-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI\-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade\-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer\-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.


**What We Look For**
* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end\-to\-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross\-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long\-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director\-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

70023a45.title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
70023a45.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect \& Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642\)**
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect \& Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end\-to\-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
   

  

 The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user\-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end\-to\-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API\-led, event\-driven, workflow\-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted\-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote\-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed\-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent\-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI\-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production\-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self\-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade\-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7\+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise\-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non\-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL\-aligned service management processes.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect\-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI\-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade\-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer\-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.


**What We Look For**
* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end\-to\-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross\-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long\-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director\-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. This is an hands\-on solution architecture role**
****Description of the area****
****Job Responsibilities****
* Main responsibility: Owns all technical matters related to usage mediation (convergent mediation by DigitalRoute) and the provisioning of digital products (automatic tenant creation) in accordance to defined commercial models. Including all the integration across systems that support the end to end data flow
* Scope: Primary point of contact on all matters concerning mediation and digital product provisioning. Designs solutions that meet requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non\-Functional Requirements (NFR). Documents and evolves the architecture and ensures alignment with RDT architecture and governance.

Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.
* External partners: You will serve as the primary operational guide for external vendors, ensuring all delivery work aligns with our internal standards, project timelines, and quality expectations. You communicate requirements clearly, and offer ongoing technical and procedural direction. While external teams execute the hands\-on deliverables, you will monitor progress, unblock challenges
* Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers. Drive all discussions with digital product teams to ensure adoption of commercial backoffice standards and processes

Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies

Serve as a key escalation point to troubleshoot complex operational failures and establish preventative measures that maintain high system reliability and timely output.


**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Able to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support, design or write functional specifications to ensure correct implementation of end to end / cross application features independently.
* Use your expertise in Agile methods like SAFe and Scrum, along with excellent interpersonal skills, to work seamlessly with local, nearshore and offshore teams


****Education / Experience****

* Proven track record of maintaining solution roadmaps, assessing technology trends, and conducting vendor assessments
* Experience documenting and evolving architecture throughout the product lifecycle and aligning with enterprise architecture governance


****Technical Skills****
* Enterprise integration software and tools
* Hands\-on exposure to programming languages, ideally JavaScript or Python.
* Expertise in managing Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs) and establishing reference architectures and patterns


**Additional Qualifications**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing solutions and bring fresh perspectives
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus among diverse teams
* Learner and curious with willingness to take ownership of topics and conclude with solutions. This person will own issues end\-to\-end, ensuring they are fixed or that a well\-defined solution is assigned to another team

With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.  As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will act as a consultant for Cloud Migration Solution delivery, utilizing software architecture fundamentals and assets, tools, and the garage method for cloud. You will leverage your expertise in migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms to drive successful migrations.

 Master's Degree

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world.  Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Apache Airflow Platform Engineer to provide L2 operational support, platform administration, automation, and continuous improvement for enterprise workflow orchestration environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Airflow DAG development, platform operations, DevOps automation, cloud\-native infrastructure, and CI/CD implementation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 This role will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of the Airflow platform while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, and Application teams.
   

  

**Airflow Platform Operations**
* Provide L2/L3 support for Apache Airflow production environments.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to DAG execution, task failures, scheduling delays, and workflow dependencies.
* Support Airflow platform administration, configuration management, upgrades, and patching activities.
* Manage Airflow components including Schedulers, Webservers, Workers, Executors, Metadata Database, Variables, Connections, and Plugins.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring workflow and platform incidents.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Ensure platform availability, reliability, and performance through proactive monitoring and capacity planning.


**Airflow Development \& Orchestration**

* Optimize DAG performance, scheduling efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Implement best practices for workflow orchestration, dependency management, and fault tolerance.
* Support onboarding of new workflows and integrations into the orchestration platform.
* Review DAG code and enforce development standards across engineering teams.


**DevOps \& CI/CD Engineering**
* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Automate deployment, testing, validation, and release management processes for Airflow environments.

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience managing the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.

**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business tests. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

d7fca857.title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
d7fca857.description:
What do we do?
   

  

**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
 Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
   

  

 By combining information management expertise and in\-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
   

  

 What your day will look like
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for two
 **Cloud Application Modernisation \& Agentic Architects (f/m/d)** 
 to own the end\-to\-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission\-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
   

  

 This is not a design\-and\-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands\-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure \& Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP \& Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud\-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
   

  

**Time allocation (approximate):**
 \~50% hands\-on application refactoring \& migration \| \~25% project management, planning \& stakeholder coordination \| \~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance \& SRE \| \~10% observability, testing \& validation
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Refactoring \& Modernisation**
* Own the end\-to\-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
* Apply 12\-factor app principles, event\-driven architecture patterns, and cloud\-native design to legacy codebases
* Migrate workloads from on\-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP\-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
* Design for scalability and on\-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
* Use LLM\-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
* Track and report progress with precision \- this is a time\-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
* Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards


**Resilience \& Rollback**
* Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins \- you have crisis experience and you use it
* Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
* Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover


**Collaboration**
* Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
* Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
* Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post\-migration
* Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers


 What you need to fulfill the role
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 You have migrated complex, production applications from on\-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
   

  

* Proven on\-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
* Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
* Deep hands\-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
* Strong 12\-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
* Strong event\-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
* Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post\-mortems
* Proven focus on scalability and on\-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
* Proven hands\-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM\-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity


**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Skills)**
* Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
* FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post\-migration
* Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
* Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme


**Soft Skills**
* Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
* Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
* Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
* Crisis\-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
* Fact\-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative


**What Success Looks Like**
* Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
* Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major \+ 2 add\-on) — observable, scalable, cost\-attributed
* Month 6: 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
* Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application


 Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
   

  

**You're probably NOT a fit if**
* You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
* You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
* You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
* You treat project management as someone else's job
* You have not handled a production rollback under pressure


 What we offer
   

  

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid\-first working
* Continuous learning \& certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high\-ownership culture
* Learning programmes \| Career growth \| Leadership access


 At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
 **Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Thinkproject Academy \| Free English lessons \| Unlimited learning \| Headspace community access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events**
 We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
   

  

**Your Contact**
 Mehal Mehta
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:
   

  

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* A short write\-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on\-prem to cloud migration you have delivered \- what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application


 Working at thinkproject.com \-
 **think career. think ahead.**

4ae581b8.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened its online retail in July 1995 and today, stands as one of the world’s largest internet retailer. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. We operate retail websites in 20\+ countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history.  

Amazon’s Routing and Planning team is looking for an enthusiastic, customer obsessed Program Manager to manage projects, implement and improve metrics, work in collaboration with Amazon’s technology, product, business and operations teams to create solutions for our internal and external customers.  

To be successful in this role, you need a passion for making data driven decisions which will have direct impact on the customer experience. Some keys to your success are the ability to be an effective communicator to various audiences. The ability to remain flexible and adept to learning new tools and systems is instrumental your role on the team. Our environment is deadline driven, fast paced and requires you to be detail\-oriented and comfortable interacting or working with multiple teams (business and technical).  

The ideal candidate has a background of running large, cross\-functional projects. The candidate is as comfortable working on high\-level strategy and design, as they are rolling up their sleeves and working on implementation. They have demonstrated the ability to build customized logistics solutions, drive process improvement, standardize procedures and eliminate the root cause of defects within current systems. This job will require strong communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high pressure, and often ambiguous, work environment. Passion and drive for customer service is a must. The candidate must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Program manage the solution for last mile related problems from identification, scoping and sizing to creating long term solutions in partnership with tech, product, business and operations

  

* Define success criteria for programs and audits processes and create/ drive right metrics to track and influence program health

  

* Collaborate with multiple teams as a subject matter expert in last mile delivery domain and develop solutions that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor, data integrity and solves problem for the long term

  

* Identify, develop, manage, and execute analyses to uncover areas of opportunity and present written business recommendations

  

* Analyze and solve business problems at their root
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

30bc7597.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
30bc7597.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


As part of the Advanced Imaging Solutions (AIS) platform Software team at GE HealthCare, you will be responsible for wing\-to\-wing execution of platform programs across the different Imaging modalities in line with the roadmap of the GE Healthcare Imaging business.
  

  

This role requires you to work closely with technical teams and global stakeholders to drive synergies \& adoption of platform deliverables into Imaging product releases and ensure platform solutions are delivered on time, within scope and budget and with desired quality.
  

  

This role requires a strategic understanding of the business, customer needs, product technology and the purpose \& values of GE HealthCare to successfully deliver on the group priorities.  

  

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.**Job Description**
===================


In this role, you will:

* Collaborate with business and functional partners and technology leadership across GE Healthcare Imaging SW teams to drive technology discussion and strategy alignment with business needs and timelines.
* Lead multi\-generational project strategy aligned to deliver on the expected outcomes
* Lead end\-to\-end execution \& adoption of common platform releases across multiple modality programs and drive shared approach and outcomes\-based tracking
* Work with technical team comprising of members of separate organizations to coordinate day\-to\-day execution as per outlined plan
* Enable execution team with resolution of roadblocks and interdependencies. Partner with technical and functional teams external to the project to ensure their tasks are completed as required
* Manage project risks, scope changes and other non\-standard events throughout the life of the project
* Manage stakeholder communication and progress reporting at various levels of the organization including senior leadership and executives
* Ensure pre\-defined project management processes and practices are followed and quality of deliveries are verified as per stakeholder expectation and quality metrics are on track.
* Drive operational efficiencies through workflow automation across diverse data sources

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or Master’ s degree in Engineering with minimum of 10\+ years of relevant work experience and with hands on exposure to software development lifecycle required.

**Required Skills:**

* At least 6\+ years of program management experience in handling multiple teams within or across organization
* Experience in Healthcare domain would be an added advantage
* PMP, PMI\-ACP or equivalent certification would be an added advantage
* Strong understanding of Agile methodology. Experience in working with large global distributed teams and knowledge of multiple Agile Frameworks including SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, XP or equivalent.
* Proven experience using project management methodologies to deliver business value and drive significant change
* Strong leadership skills with ability to influence outcomes and organize teams to attain shared goals

**Desired Skills:**

* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills (both written and verbal) with all levels of organization
* Strong team player – collaborates well with others to solve problems and actively incorporates input from various sources
* Demonstrated customer focus – evaluates decisions through the eyes of the customer, builds strong customer relationships, creates processes with customer viewpoint and partners with customers to help shape their future initiatives
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously without compromising on quality standards.
* Creative problem solver and solution developer when presented with conflicting requirements, business demands and technical risks/issues.
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently towards timely completion of diverse assignments
* Knowledge of quality and regulatory requirements and practices for Software, preferably HealthCare
* Strong analytical and strong problem\-solving skills, enabling data\-driven decisions, anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve, creates actionable strategies and operational plans
* Be a change agent \- actively champions and drives change initiatives, process improvement
* Good understanding of business analytics and operational metrics (with focus on data storytelling)
* Proven experience in developing Power BI dashboards \- Skilled in automating data workflows across diverse data sources such as defect dashboard, Agile PI Planning dashboards etc.
* Ability to build and integrate chatbot capabilities including integrating Power BI with chatbot interfaces
* Proven experience in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions, with good technical expertise in Generative AI concepts and applications, and proficiency in tools such as GitHub Copilot and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams including senior leadership to gather, understand and translate requirements into effective solutions
* Strong track record of understanding and interest in current and emerging technologies demonstrated through training, job experience and / or industry activities
* PMP, SAFe, ScrumMaster or related Project Management certifications

**Inclusion and Diversity**


GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

cf7e16a5.title: Semiconductor Equipment – Program Manager
cf7e16a5.description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Key Responsibilities**  

**1\. Program \& Customer Management**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the FSE/SU support program.
* Act as the primary operational interface with the customer.
* Understand customer deployment requirements and translate them into resource plans.
* Establish governance mechanisms, reviews, dashboards and performance metrics.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution.


2\. **Workforce Planning \& Deployment**

* Develop manpower plans based on startup/project requirements.
* Manage a pool of experienced and developing FSE/SU engineers.
* Plan deployment across Taiwan, Japan, USA, Singapore and other locations as required.
* Optimize resource utilization through the Hub\-and\-Spoke model.
* Maintain deployment readiness including visa, travel, customer onboarding and site requirements.
* Develop backup / succession plans for critical resources.

  

3\. **Hiring \& Talent Development**

* Drive hiring of:
* Semiconductor startup experienced FSEs
* Mechanical/Electrical engineers
* Japanese bilingual engineers
* Mandarin bilingual engineers
* Work with recruitment teams to maintain a continuous talent pipeline.
* Define skill requirements and competency matrices for different FSE/SU roles.


4\. **Training \& Certification**

* Own the FSE/SU competency development roadmap.
* Coordinate foundational training through QG Nanomichi.
* Coordinate advanced semiconductor training through external organizations
* Plan customer/OEM OJT and certification activities.
* Establish competency assessment and deployment\-readiness gates.
* Develop a train\-the\-trainer model to scale capability.


5\. **Global Operations Management**

* Coordinate India and Malaysia hubs with global customer locations.
* Manage resource movement between different customer sites based on demand.
* Monitor deployment, utilization, productivity and resource availability.
* Ensure continuity of support during ramp\-up and peak startup periods.


6\. **Quality, EHS \& Compliance**

* Ensure FSE/SU activities comply with customer and site requirements.
* Establish appropriate quality and EHS processes for semiconductor fab environments.
* Track training, certifications and site clearances.
* Ensure risks are identified and mitigated before deployment.


7\. **Commercial \& Financial Management**

* Manage program financial performance, revenue and cost.
* Track utilization and billability of deployed resources.
* Manage travel, training and deployment costs.
* Identify opportunities for improving delivery efficiency while protecting program margins.
* Support commercial discussions, change requests and scope expansion.

**Key Performance Indicators KPI Areas**

* Resource Deployment readiness / fulfillment / Utilization
* FSE/SU utilization \& billability
* Startup / deployment milestones
* Quality
* Manage Customer escalations, first\-time\-right
* Training
* Certification \& competency achievements
* Workforce
* Attrition \& talent pipeline
* Financials
* Revenue, cost \& program margin
* Customer Satisfaction / SLA adherence

  

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**Required Experience**

* 10\+ years of experience in engineering services / semiconductor / equipment service environment.
* Experience managing FSE, startup or field engineering teams.
* Experience managing geographically distributed teams is preferred.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor equipment installation/startup/service operations.
* Experience working with OEM/customer engineering organizations.
* Experience in workforce planning, hiring and technical training.
* Strong program management and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing program financials, utilization and margins.

**Preferred Skills**

* Semiconductor equipment / fab experience
* Mechanical or Electrical engineering background
* Global resource deployment experience
* Customer\-facing program management
* Experience with Japan/Taiwan/US/Singapore operations
* Knowledge of visa/mobility and international deployment processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

 **Key Competencies**

* Customer Leadership \| Global Workforce Management \| FSE/SU Operations \| Resource Planning \| Training \& Competency Development \| Program Governance \| Financial Management \| Risk Management \| Stakeholder Management
* Build and operate a scalable, globally deployable FSE/SU organization that provides TEL with the right engineering capability at the right location and time, while maintaining delivery quality, customer satisfaction, utilization and QG program profitability.

 **Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field is typically required
* **Language Skill**
* English – Must have
* Japanese – Good to Have

 **Employment Type**

* Permanent Employee

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Manager in FAAS Managed Services, you will lead pre\-sales solutioning, large\-scale pursuits, and commercial strategy, enabling successful deal closure and supporting revenue growth across markets.
   

  

 You will act as a solution architect and pursuit leader, translating client requirements into scalable, outcome\-driven solutions, while ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
   

  

 This role requires strong expertise across F\&A solution design, RFX management, pricing strategy, stakeholder engagement, and client presentations, along with the ability to influence senior leadership and drive strategic deal outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse client artifacts, RFP documents, and stakeholders’ inputs to understand business requirements and challenges
* Translate client needs into comprehensive, outcome\-driven solution proposals aligned to EY capabilities
* Build effort estimation models (FTE), cost structures, and benefit cases to support proposals
* Lead participation in client workshops, discovery sessions, and FGDs, including solution shaping and cost discussions
* Ensure alignment between solution design, operational feasibility, and commercial viability
* Act as deal/pursuit owner, leading end\-to\-end responses for RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes
* Drive the full pursuit lifecycle including:
+ Opportunity assessment and qualification
+ Solution structuring and proposal development
+ Executive story lining and value articulation
+ Pricing and commercial modelling

* Coordinate effectively between internal and external stakeholders to enable successful deal closure
* Lead solution defence sessions, presenting EY’s differentiators and value propositions
* Support client meetings, orals, and demonstrations, including POC and solution walkthroughs
* Lead or support due diligence exercises where required
* Develop and implement commercial strategies aligned with deal objectives and growth targets
* Design and execute pricing approaches including:
+ Outcome\-based pricing models
+ Time \& Material (T\&M) pricing
+ Hybrid pricing structures

* Ensure pricing is competitive, profitable, and supported by strong business justification
* Align pricing with internal delivery capability, cost models, and margin expectations
* Support negotiation strategies and commercial structuring for complex engagements
* Support mitigation of challenges across existing engagements and ensure continuity
* Ensure seamless alignment between pre\-sales commitments and delivery execution capability
* Work closely with external auditors to support timely and successful completion of F\&A reconciliation audits (where applicable)
* Enable smooth transition from deal closure to implementation
* Collaborate with:
+ Onshore partners and account leadership
+ Sales and business development teams
+ Delivery teams for feasibility and costing
+ External stakeholders and client leadership

* Deliver compelling, tailored presentations to clients showcasing solution benefits and differentiation
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders to support pursuit success and long\-term growth
* Lead solution presentations, demos, and executive discussions at senior/partner levels
* Manage, mentor, and performance manage direct and indirect solutioning team members
* Build and develop a strong pipeline of pre\-sales and solutioning talent
* Drive knowledge sharing, capability building, and best practice standardization across teams


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in pre\-sales solutioning, bid management, and pursuit leadership
* Deep functional knowledge across F\&A processes (P2P, R2R, O2C, Treasury, Tax, Reconciliation)
* Proven ability to lead large, complex RFP and solution defence engagements
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in pricing strategy and financial modelling
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decision\-making


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience in managed services, consulting, or large transformation programs
* Exposure to global clients and multi\-region delivery models
* Experience in digital transformation, automation, or robotics initiatives

**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals with 12–15 years of experience in Finance \& Accounting, with exposure across multiple areas, strong commercial mindset, solution\-driven thinking, and leadership capabilities, who can drive high\-impact pursuits and influence outcomes. The ability to manage complexity, engage stakeholders, and deliver client\-centric solutions is critical in this role.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. 62f93c3e.title: Customer Engineer II, Platform, Google Cloud
62f93c3e.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience managing the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with Artificial Intelligence (AI), building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  

  

As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business tests. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

d445743f.title: Solution Engineer
d445743f.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data \& Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high\-quality agent \& customer experience.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Cross\-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor \& Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system\-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert\-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development \& Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands\-on Coding: Write and maintain ad\-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.


**Qualification /Personal Characteristics** 
**:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad\-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical \& Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross\-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands\-on approach.
* Organizational \& Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.


**Benefits**
 What’s in it for You?
   

  

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential, free support for personal or work\-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well\-being and performance.
* Term Life Insurance: Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed\-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.
* Mediclaim (Health Insurance): Extensive coverage for medical expenses to ensure you and your family get the care you need when it matters.
