1a50d056.title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
1a50d056.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect \& Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642\)**
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect \& Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end\-to\-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
   

  

 The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user\-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end\-to\-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API\-led, event\-driven, workflow\-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted\-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote\-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed\-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent\-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI\-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production\-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self\-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade\-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7\+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise\-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non\-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL\-aligned service management processes.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect\-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI\-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade\-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer\-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.


**What We Look For**
* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end\-to\-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross\-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long\-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director\-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

216251d1.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
216251d1.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

e508d62e.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
e508d62e.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

77f662fd.title: Senior Program Manager, Refunds CX, WW Refunds Experience
77f662fd.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


In the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.  

  

WW R\&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R\&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.  

  

Refunds Experience is a charter of WW R\&R that is dedicated to providing the best\-in\-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk \& avoid policy abuse.  

  

We are looking for a seasoned Program Leader who has a passion for working in cross\-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal \& written) in addition to proven program management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.  

  

Amazon is Earth’s most customer\-centric company and in WW R\&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

In this role, you will:  

Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund programs to improve customer trust  

Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer\-facing and financial impact  

Be a leader, required to collaborate cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design comprehensive, scalable and automated solutions to fulfil the returns policies customers avail and preserve CX.  

  

A day in the life  

You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new solution is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two competing solutions. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a program's exposure to failure modes.  

  

About the team  

WW Refunds CX team under the broader WW Returns CX (WW RCX) sub\-org, plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech \& Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use\-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end\-to\-end execution.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience in Reverse Logistics, transportation and/or retail operations
* Basic comfort with Gen AI tools, SQL query and data analysis
* Communicate effectively with technology teams
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, science or related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

06c8e763.description:
**Our Company**
 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Staff Technical Program Manager at Teradata, you will drive delivery of significant, multi\-team technical programs across Teradata's product portfolio, owning execution from kickoff through launch while building strong relationships with engineering, product, and business partners.
   

  

* Own planning, execution, and delivery tracking for complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and product areas.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone tracking dashboards.
* Facilitate cross\-team coordination and decision\-making to keep programs on track — running standups, program syncs, and steering reviews.
* Translate technical program status into crisp stakeholder updates for product leadership and senior engineering audiences.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks early; lead focused retrospectives to drive continuous process improvement.
* Coordinate launch readiness activities across engineering, QA, documentation, support, and go\-to\-market teams.
* Support data\-driven prioritization by maintaining program metrics and surfacing trade\-off analysis to product and engineering leadership.
* Apply foundational AI skills to explore and implement ways AI can enhance productivity, innovation, and impact across our workforce.


**WhoYou’ll Work With**
 You will work as an embedded delivery partner within Teradata's Product organization, collaborating daily with:
   

  

* Product Managers and Principal TPMs to align delivery timelines with roadmap commitments.
* Engineering managers, tech leads, and QA teams across Vantage platform, cloud services, and analytics product areas.
* Design, Technical Writing, Support, and Marketing teams to coordinate end\-to\-end feature delivery and launch readiness.
* Finance and TA partners on program\-level resourcing and onboarding coordination for growing engineering teams.


 Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* 6\+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or data analytics.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-team delivery programs involving engineering teams of 20 or more.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data systems, or SaaS product delivery cycles.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile delivery methodologies, sprint planning, and program\-level tracking tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills — able to run effective meetings, surface issues clearly, and write crisp status reports.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.


**What You'll Bring**
* Familiarity with data warehousing, SQL analytics, or cloud data infrastructure concepts.
* Experience coordinating programs that span US and international engineering teams (India experience a plus).
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar delivery management tools.
* Background in enterprise SaaS, B2B analytics, or open\-source data ecosystem delivery preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep complex programs tidy and stakeholders informed.
* Ability to build trust quickly with engineers and product managers; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than a process overhead.
* A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

 We are seeking a driven, strategic, technical Network Acquisition Manager with experience supporting a high\-growth technology business. This position will work within the Network Acquisition and Delivery team within OCI Networking and will independently manage the acquisition and delivery of key network infrastructure North America. A successful candidate will have a blend of business knowledge, vendor relationships, regional expertise and technical skills that enables them to deliver mission critical network infrastructure to support Oracle's growth in the regions mentioned.  At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer\-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world.
   

  

 Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future.
   

  

 You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you’ll belong and be encouraged.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Manage a vendor and a circuit delivery pipeline to deploy crucial network infrastructure on/before time for Oracle’s internal and external customers
   

  

 Leverage regional knowledge and vendor relationships to drive critical deliveries on time
   

  

 Work across teams to design and launch new processes, institute process improvements and automation, and ensure the achievement of process objectives.
   

  

 Abstract, organize, and structure process, objectives, and workflows.
   

  

 Create and automate reporting, including monthly business reviews (MBRs).
   

  

 Run programs independently, including critical projects, executive project reporting and execution.
   

  

 Manage both technical and non\-technical projects.
   

  

 Identify and remove blockers for Oracle teams in the region
   

  

**Key Qualifications**
 6\+ years of experience delivering network infrastructure in the Telecom, Datacenter, or Cloud Infrastructure industries.
   

  

 Experience working cross functional with engineering, operations, and capacity planning teams.
   

  

 The ability to document metrics and recommendations to internal technical leadership as well as VPs and SVPs
   

  

 Ability to work independently and propose solutions.
   

  

 Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
   

  

 Highly proficient in Jira, Excel, PowerPoint, and Confluence.
   

  

**Qualifications**

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

5b23f31f.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
5b23f31f.description:
**Company Description**
 Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
   

  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

 At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, genetics, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
