49dbc261.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud
49dbc261.description:
Role: Salesforce Solution Architect \- Marketing Cloud
 



 Experience: 5\+ Years
 



 Location: REMOTE
 



  





 JD:
 



 Core Responsibilities
 



 • Implement and govern end\-to\-end solution architecture aligned to approved business outcomes, platform standards, and security/compliance requirements • Lead client\-facing discovery, requirements workshops, and design sessions; translate requirements into clear functional and technical designs • Own solution documentation including solution design documents, architecture diagrams, data flows, integration specs, and configuration/workflow decisions • Define and review Salesforce data models, security model (profiles/permission sets/sharing), automation strategy (Flows), and programmatic approach (Apex/LWC) • Architect Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities (journeys, automations, personalization, email/SMS/push, consent and preference management) and Data Cloud data model and activation strategy • Design data architecture spanning Salesforce, Data Cloud, and Snowflake, including data ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, and activation for marketing and analytics use cases • Define integration architecture and patterns across Salesforce and external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, event\-driven patterns such as Platform Events and Change Data Capture) • Partner with MuleSoft and integration teams to design API\-led connectivity, error handling, retries, and monitoring; provide architectural oversight even when not building MuleSoft flows directly • Support presales solutioning and scoping, including high\-level estimates, delivery approach, assumptions, risks, and implementation roadmap • Provide technical leadership across onshore and offshore delivery teams through design reviews, build guidance, and quality gates • Support regulated life sciences delivery needs (validation readiness, auditability, change control, and release governance), including compliant handling of HCP/patient/customer data for marketing and analytics • Drive environment strategy, CI/CD governance, and deployment readiness (Git, SFDX, Copado/Gearset/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions or equivalent)
 



  





 Required Qualifications
 



  





 • 8\+ years of Salesforce platform experience with 3\+ years in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or Architecture role • Hands\-on experience architecting and/or implementing Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Engagement and/or Account Engagement) solutions, including journey design, data extensions, and personalization • Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, including data model design, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation • Hands\-on experience working with Snowflake as part of a broader data and analytics architecture, including data sharing/integration with Salesforce • Strong experience designing integrations (APIs and event\-driven patterns) and coordinating with middleware teams on MuleSoft or equivalent • Required industry experience: prior delivery experience within Pharma, Healthcare, or Life Sciences organizations, with an understanding of industry\-specific architecture, data, compliance, and marketing requirements • Strong hands\-on knowledge of core Salesforce platform capabilities, including data modeling, security architecture, and automation (Flows) • Working knowledge of programmatic development on Salesforce (Apex and Lightning Web Components) sufficient to make design tradeoffs and guide developers • Experience producing and maintaining solution documentation used by technical and non technical stakeholders • Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and driving implementation through requirements, build, test, and release • Strong client\-facing skills: facilitation, clear written communication, executive\-ready storytelling, and the ability to manage ambiguity without formal authority
 



  





 Required Salesforce Certifications
 



  





 • Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Consultant or Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Developer • Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (Administrator credential)
 



  





 Nice to Have
 



  





 • Life sciences or healthcare domain experience specific to commercial, medical affairs, or patient services marketing use cases • MuleSoft experience and/or certification: MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1 (Mule 4\) • Experience with Veeva (Vault, CRM) and/or IQVIA OCE ecosystems • Exposure to GxP\-regulated or validated environments (validation documentation, traceability, test evidence, audit readiness) • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Health Cloud, or Revenue Cloud is a plus but not a primary requirement for this role • Additional Salesforce certifications (optional): Data Architecture and Management Designer; Integration Architecture Designer; Identity and Access Management Designer; Salesforce Certified Technical Architect

f992e103.title: Service Delivery Manager - Offshore
f992e103.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner \& their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP \& their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
   

  





 The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
   

  





 The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP \& their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals \& ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
   

  





**Responsibilities**




 Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
   

  





 Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
   

  





 Provide guidance to the PSC \& MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
   

  





 Analyze customer’s business needs \& pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk \& various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues \& leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
   

  





 Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
   

  





 Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
   

  





 Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
   

  





 Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi\-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road\-map.
   

  





 Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC \& SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
   

  





 Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
   

  





 Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
   

  





 Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
   

  





 Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
   

  





 Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
   

  





 Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
   

  





 Identify and fulfill agreed\-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
   

  





 Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
   

  





 Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
   

  





 Maintain updated Action Trackers \& other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
   

  





 Prepare all customer\-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high\-quality standards.
   

  





 Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
   

  





 Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non\-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
   

  





 Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow\-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
   

  





 Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.



**Experience:**



* 15 \- 25 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting\-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts



**Key Skills and Attributes:**



* **Analytical Expertise:** 
 Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* **Transformation Experience:** 
 Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* **End User Computing (EUC) Mastery:** 
 Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* **Collaborative Aptitude:**

1ec68993.title: Program Manager – Assessment & Certification Development
1ec68993.description:
**Job Title: Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.
 



  





**www.eccouncil.org** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development to lead the end\-to\-end development and continuous improvement of professional certification assessments.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of assessment strategy, certification development, subject\-matter expertise, psychometrics, and program governance. The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, subject\-matter experts, psychometricians, and certification governance committees to ensure that our assessments accurately measure the knowledge, skills, and competencies required for professionals in the field.
 



 The role requires strong program management capability, assessment expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly governed certification environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end assessment and certification development lifecycle, from JTA and competency analysis through exam blueprinting, item development, validation, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Job Task Analysis (JTA) and ensure assessments are aligned to current industry roles, tasks, competencies, and professional practice.
* Develop and maintain exam blueprints, assessment specifications, competency models, and content domains in collaboration with SMEs and psychometric professionals.
* Lead item development, review, validation, and performance analysis, ensuring items meet quality, relevance, cognitive\-level, and technical standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, fairness, standard setting, item analysis, and assessment performance.
* Coordinate SME workshops, validation studies, and assessment reviews and translate findings into actionable assessment improvements.
* Ensure assessment development is well\-documented, evidence\-based, and aligned with certification governance and accreditation requirements.
* Manage multiple assessment\-development programs, including timelines, SMEs, stakeholders, risks, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with Certification Operations, Exam Security, Product, Technology, and other teams to ensure assessments are ready for secure and effective delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve the quality, scalability, efficiency, and defensibility of certification assessments.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* PhD or master’s degree in psychology, Assessment, Education, Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in professional certification, assessment/examination development, credentialing, or psychometrics.
* Proven experience managing high\-stakes professional certification or assessment programs.
* Strong knowledge of Job Task Analysis (JTA), Role Delineation/Job Practice Analysis, exam blueprinting, item development, content validation, and assessment governance.
* Strong working knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, item analysis, statistical evaluation, and standard setting.
* Experience working with SMEs, psychometricians, item writers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop and validate assessments.
* Strong program management, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience in an accredited or standards\-driven certification environment preferred.
* ISO/IEC 17024 knowledge is a strong plus.
* Experience in cybersecurity, IT, technology, or professional certification is an advantage.



  





**About Our Culture:** 




 EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
 



  





**Additional Information:** 




 EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
 



  





 EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist.
 



  





 To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work.
 



  





 If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.
 



  





 Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third\-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.
 



  





 Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.
 



 Please review our policy here: EC\-Council Privacy Policy\- User \& company \| Data Protection. Submission of your application will be considered as your acceptance of the terms stated above.

e4f1a01c.title: Product Delivery Manager - Moveworks
e4f1a01c.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
 The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high\-quality business outcomes.
   

  

 As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
   

  

 The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy \& Lifecycle Management:**
* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers


**Product backlog and Planning:**
* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long\-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).


**Delivery Management:**
* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go\-live


**Governance and Continuous improvement:**
* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.


**Innovation and Platform enablement:**
* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI\-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self\-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification


**What are we looking for?**
* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

9a4d06bd.title: AWS Pre-Sales Consultant
9a4d06bd.description:
AWS / Multi\-Cloud Presales Consultant
 



 Experience: 5–8 Years
 



 Location: Pune
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid / On\-site
 



  





 Job Summary:
 



 We are looking for an experienced AWS / Multi\-Cloud Presales Consultant to join our presales team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cloud presales, customer engagement, solution positioning, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development and technical presentations, with a strong understanding of AWS and exposure to other cloud platforms.
 



 The candidate should be able to understand customer business requirements, collaborate with sales and technical teams, and translate requirements into compelling cloud solutions and proposals.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Work closely with the Sales/BD team to understand customer requirements and identify appropriate AWS/cloud solutions.
 



 • Participate in customer discovery calls, requirement\-gathering sessions and technical discussions.
 



 • Prepare and present AWS and multi\-cloud solution proposals aligned with customer business needs.
 



 • Lead RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution presentations and demonstrations.
 



 • Develop solution approaches, scope, assumptions, effort estimates and BoM/commercial inputs in coordination with delivery teams.
 



 • Prepare AWS pricing and cost estimates, including TCO/business\-value considerations.
 



 • Conduct customer\-facing product/solution demos, presentations and workshops.
 



 • Articulate the business value and technical benefits of AWS, cloud migration, modernization and DevOps solutions.
 



 • Collaborate with AWS/cloud delivery teams to validate proposed solutions and ensure feasibility.
 



 • Support Sales teams throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification to proposal submission and closure.
 



 • Create compelling presentations, solution documents, capability decks and responses tailored to customer requirements.
 



 • Identify opportunities for upselling/cross\-selling AWS, DevOps, cloud migration and managed services.
 



 • Maintain knowledge of AWS services, cloud trends, competitive offerings and customer use cases.
 



 • Support account teams in responding to technical/commercial queries during the sales cycle.
 



 • Ensure smooth handover of won opportunities to the Delivery team.
 



  





 Mandatory Skills:
 



 • 5–8 years of experience in IT Presales / Solution Presales / Technical Presales / Cloud Presales.
 



 • Strong experience in AWS Presales.
 



 • Hands\-on experience in RFP/RFI/RFQ response preparation and proposal development.
 



 • Strong customer\-facing and presentation skills.
 



 • Experience in conducting technical presentations, solution demonstrations and workshops.
 



 • Good understanding of AWS services and cloud solutions.
 



 • Experience in preparing BoM, effort estimates, AWS pricing and commercial inputs.
 



 • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into appropriate technology solutions.
 



 • Strong coordination skills with Sales, Delivery and technical teams.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 



  





 Good to Have:
 



 • Exposure to Azure and/or GCP.
 



 • Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.
 



 • Experience in cloud migration and modernization offerings.
 



 • Experience working with an AWS Partner, Cloud Service Provider, IT Services company or System Integrator.
 



 • AWS certification would be an advantage.
 



 • Experience supporting enterprise customers across India, APAC, Middle East or US markets.

a41c26d0.title: Presales Team Lead
a41c26d0.company: SRS BUSINESS SOLUTIONS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
a41c26d0.description:
Position: Pre\-Sales Lead
 



 Experience: 8–12\+ years
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time – 5 Days Onsite
 



 Work timings: PST hours
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales Lead with strong expertise in RFP/RFI responses, proposal writing, and solution development, particularly for US State Government clients.
 



  





 The candidate will be responsible for leading end\-to\-end proposal activities, working closely with Sales, Solution Architects, SMEs, Delivery and other stakeholders to develop compelling, compliant and competitive proposals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end RFP/RFI response process for US State Government clients.
* Analyze RFP requirements, Statements of Work (SOW), evaluation criteria and compliance requirements.
* Develop and maintain RFP compliance matrices and response plans.
* Lead proposal writing including technical responses, executive summaries, solution overviews, methodologies and value propositions.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects and SMEs to develop appropriate technical solutions.
* Translate client requirements into clear and compelling proposal responses.
* Coordinate inputs from Sales, Delivery, Technology, Finance, Legal and other teams.
* Develop PowerPoint presentations, executive summaries and proposal collateral for client presentations.
* Review proposals for accuracy, consistency, compliance and overall quality before submission.
* Manage multiple proposals simultaneously while ensuring strict submission deadlines are met.
* Participate in proposal strategy discussions and identify differentiators/win themes.
* Support oral presentations, client demos and proposal defense sessions when required.
* Maintain a repository of reusable proposal content, case studies, credentials and solution material.
* Track proposal status, deadlines, dependencies and stakeholder deliverables.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8\+ years of experience in Pre\-Sales / Proposal Management / Bid Management.
* Strong hands\-on experience in RFP/RFI response and proposal writing.
* Mandatory experience supporting US State \& Local Government clients.
* Strong understanding of US government procurement and bidding processes.
* Excellent technical and business writing skills.
* Experience preparing technical proposals and solution responses.
* Ability to understand complex technical requirements and convert them into business\-focused responses.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Experience working with Sales, Solution Architects, SMEs and Delivery teams.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with US State/Local Government contracts and SLED proposals.
* Knowledge of RFP portals and government procurement platforms.
* Experience with IT services, staffing, application development, cloud, data, AI/ML or digital transformation proposals.
* Knowledge of proposal methodologies such as Shipley.
* Experience with tools such as Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint and CRM platforms.
* Experience handling large, complex and multi\-million\-dollar proposals.



  





  





**Ideal Candidate** 




  





 The ideal candidate should be a strong proposal writer and RFP response specialist who understands both technology and business requirements and has proven experience working on US State Government proposals. The person should be capable of independently leading an RFP from requirement analysis to client presentation.

591a8ee0.title: Solutions Architect - Public Sector
591a8ee0.description:
FEQ427R107
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data \& AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid role, based in Delhi.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
* You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role
* 8\+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
* Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
* Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
* Experience building distributed data systems
* Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Available to travel to customers in your region
* Nice to have: Databricks Certification


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

c81f5785.title: Forward Deployed Architect II
c81f5785.description:
**About Us** 





 HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180\+ agents that orchestrate end\-to\-end processes across Order\-to\-Cash, Close \& Reconciliation, Consolidation \& Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3\-6 month go\-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300\+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol\-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.
 



**Job Summary** 





 The Senior Consultant is responsible for delivering the HighRadius Cloud product implementations of Fortune 1000 clients. He/She will be owning solutioning for client engagements throughout the project life cycle. The Senior Consultant is also responsible for delivering the design for the project on time with high quality, value and inline with Client project objectives. This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the main point of contact for project design and work with Client SMEs and stakeholders and Client users across client organizations. The candidate must have strong solutioning skills, well organized, detail\-oriented, quality\-minded and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. He/She will be responsible for guiding the Consultant, Associate Consultant and Data Analyst to implement the design and achieve project objectives. . 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




* Perform blueprint design for one to many client projects for multiple HighRadius products. Gather business requirements, explore solution options, brainstorm solutions with internal team(s) and client team(s) wherever required to finalize design.
* Oversee consultant and through them Data Analyst and Associate Consultant to ensure solution is built per the agreed design.
* Ultimately accountable for project success by ensuring client achieves business value through a well defined solution design and holding the Consultant/Associate Consultant/Data Analyst accountable to outcome metrics.
* Keep the Delivery Manager and/or Program Director honest and up to date on any potential risks related to Solution design and/or Project value.
* Ability to produce actionable deliverables, influencing stakeholders to make informed design and decisions\- Act as voice of reason within HRC and client teams.



**Skill \& Experience Needed** 




* Bachelor's or Master’s Degree (preferably from a top reputed university).
* Strong solutioning, presentation and facilitation skills with small and large groups.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand Fortune 1000 client business complexities and solution those.
* Overall 6\+ years of professional services experience \- Combination of Solutioning and delivery management experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience as Solution Architect/Technology Business Analyst or equivalent role preferably in a fast\-paced consulting / professional services set\-up.
* Experience in following the established processes/standards/templates to achieve successful results.
* Experience with Accounts Payable related business process is desirable



**What You’ll Get** 




* Competitive salary.
* Fun\-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
* Equal employment opportunities.
* Opportunity to build with a pre\-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.

6bc3b4b7.title: Solutions Architect Sr. Manager - Power
6bc3b4b7.description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership**

* Lead the architecture and technical definition of electrical power infrastructure for complex data center and mission\-critical projects.
* Develop end\-to\-end electrical architectures covering:
* Utility power interfaces
* Medium\-voltage distribution
* Low\-voltage distribution
* Transformers
* Switchgear
* UPS systems
* Battery energy storage
* Generator systems
* Paralleling systems
* Automatic transfer systems
* Power distribution units
* Remote power panels
* Busway systems
* Rack\-level power distribution
* Define scalable and resilient power architectures based on customer capacity, redundancy and availability requirements.
* Lead electrical system sizing and capacity planning.
* Develop electrical conceptual designs and single\-line diagrams.
* Determine power distribution paths, equipment architecture and cable distribution concepts.
* Evaluate electrical infrastructure technologies and recommend the optimum architecture for technical performance, resilience, scalability and commercial value.
* Support analysis of electrical efficiency and data center power performance.

**Customer Engagement \& Solution Pursuit**

* Act as the senior power technical authority during strategic customer engagements.
* Engage directly with customer engineering, electrical, facilities and infrastructure teams.
* Lead technical workshops, solution presentations and architecture discussions.
* Understand customer power requirements, identify gaps and recommend optimized infrastructure solutions.
* Challenge traditional architectures where appropriate and introduce alternative solutions that improve availability, efficiency, scalability or total cost of ownership.
* Support strategic pursuits from early opportunity qualification through proposal development and customer presentations.

**Solution Development \& Proposal Support**

* Lead the creation, review and approval of electrical architectures, single\-line diagrams, conceptual designs, equipment selection, technical specifications, technical proposals, system sizing documentation and customer presentations.
* Work with estimating and commercial teams to develop BOMs and technically accurate quotations.
* Support cost, margin and commercial analysis.
* Evaluate and integrate third\-party electrical infrastructure components where required.
* Ensure proposed solutions comply with relevant local electrical codes, standards and regulatory requirements.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Partner closely with the Thermal Solutions Architect to develop integrated data center infrastructure solutions.
* Work with Engineering teams to translate customer requirements and conceptual architectures into executable solutions.
* Provide technical mentorship and leadership to solution architects and engineering teams.
* Support Sales teams with technical training and solution enablement.
* Provide market and customer insights to influence product and solution development.
* Participate in key customer meetings, industry forums, technical seminars and strategic events.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline.
* Typically 12–20\+ years of progressive experience in electrical power systems, mission\-critical infrastructure or data center power architecture.
* Demonstrated experience architecting complex electrical infrastructure solutions.
* Strong expertise in UPS systems, LV/MV distribution, switchgear, transformers, generator systems and mission\-critical power architectures.
* Strong understanding of redundancy and availability architectures, including N, N\+1 and 2N concepts.
* Experience working directly with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise or telecom customers.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to optimize solutions based on technical and business requirements.
* Excellent customer engagement, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with senior engineering stakeholders.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Experience in a data center OEM, electrical power OEM, EPC, electrical consultancy, hyperscaler or colocation provider.
* Experience in global data center projects.
* Experience in high\-density computing and AI data center power requirements.
* Experience integrating conventional power infrastructure with emerging technologies such as battery energy storage and alternative power architectures.
* Experience leading cross\-functional technical teams.

422ff388.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**NEC Software Solutions (India)**

On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.


We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.


We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.


For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india .


**About NEC Corporation**

NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.


NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.


For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.


**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

Working within the Health business, you will be responsible for defining the policies and standards that guide technology delivery, possessing significant experience in modern, cloud based technology standards and practices.


As Solution Architect you are accountable for providing architectural design and technology roadmaps for complex Health applications supporting high volume, mission critical products and services.


You'll work hand in hand with our Product Managers, Delivery and Technical Leads in order to influence and define a technology roadmap to meet both our commercial and technology aims.


Core aim of this role is to provide technical assurance to ensure successful deployment of NEC SWS Public Safety products into a given client whilst also protecting our commercial position.


To be successful in the role, we need someone who can mediate between people and explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, particularly someone who is confident in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. Someone who understands the evolutionary nature of technology delivery in an agile environment. As you may imagine, our stakeholder expectations are high, and we'll need you to facilitate discussions about high risk and complexity even within constrained timescales.


The Solution Architect will work with the project or programme manager and the wider architecture team to:


* ensure that scope of supply is correctly documented and maintained
* technical project risks are identified and managed
* ensure that any non\-functional requirements from a customer are agreed and documented
* ensure Impact assessments are practical, have well defined scope and implementation and use existing products and technologies wherever possible
* Deliver/Manage High Level Designs for solutions.
* Deliver documentation including diagrams, dataflows, and solution working detail
* identify opportunities for selling additional product capability.

**Candidates will have awareness of the following items:**

* + C\+\+
* + C\#
* + SQL Server
* + Windows platforms
* + Domains / AD
* + Authentication \& Authorisation methods inc. OAuth
* Development Patterns

**Candidates will have good practical knowledge of some or all of the following items:**

* + Data \& Database Management
* + Messaging/Message Brokers/Buses including RabbitMQ
* + Common API frameworks including REST, SOAP
* + Well\-Architected Frameworks
* + Technology evolutions \& roadmaps
* + Cloud Solutions – AWS/Azure/OCI
* + Networking \& communication of solutions \& components
* + Security aspects of solutions, integrations \& connectivity

**Candidates will have In Depth knowledge of some or all of the following items:**

* Architectural Patterns and their uses
* Integration Patterns
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* Has worked with UK clients and team (Preferred)
* Has working experience of the onshore – offshore model
Has experience of commercial awareness in aspects such as revenue recognition and margin management  
*

 Key Competencies

**Job Title:** 
 Solution Architect / Functional Architect \- Cloud
   

  

**Department** 
 : IT
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Wealth Management (WM) \- Strategy and Architecture
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 As a member of the IS Architecture team, you will be in charge of helping projects define their Solution Architecture while migrating the Information System of Wealth Management into BNPP group Cloud platform. You will review their proposals with Enterprise Architects as well as Engineering/Production teams and Security teams to ensure that solutions proposed are aligned and compliant with BNPP policies and BNPP Cloud offering.
   

  

 You will be assigned to a fixed set of IT Divisions/Departments (2 or 3\) for which you will manage the solutioning for Cloud migration and BAU evolutions of the applications under their management. In addition, you may be assigned to specific transversal projects for which you will do the solutioning end\-to\-end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain the Division/Department architecture reference documentation all along the changes brought by projects:
* IT system diagrams (Division level, or per sub\-block)
* Application referential (with the help of Application Owners)
* Division level principles and related non\-conformities and remediation plans
* Obsolescence KPIs
* Lead the Cloud solution architecture on the projects they are assigned to:
* Supporting the Project Manager/Business Analysts during solution ideation, design, and implementation
* Collaborating with application teams and Business Analysts/Tech leads of impacted applications to design solutions consistent from a functional and technical point of view
* Ensuring the alignment of projects with our architecture principles and IT standards
* Ensuring the solution is optimized for running on our IBM Private Cloud
* Support project managers, Business analysts and technical leads along the architecture validation process by:
* Leading the build of a consistent architecture documentation
* Presenting their projects in architecture validation committee
* Being the reference point on a set of applications for support/evolution activities
* Supporting the architecture process till the go\-live

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits

* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

**About Position:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Architect with 8 to 12 years of expertise in designing and delivering enterprise\-scale applications using .NET, React, and Azure AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in solution architecture, cloud\-native application development, AI integration, and modern enterprise platforms. This role requires a blend of technical leadership, hands\-on development expertise, and architectural governance to build secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled business solutions.
 



  




* **Role: Architect**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design and architect enterprise\-scale applications using .NET, React, and Azure technologies.
* Define scalable, secure, and high\-performance application architectures aligned with business requirements.
* Lead the development and integration of AI\-powered capabilities using Azure AI Services and Generative AI solutions.

* Create solution architecture documents, technical specifications, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Contribute to innovation initiatives involving Azure AI, Generative AI, and intelligent enterprise applications.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 8 to 12 years of experience in enterprise application development and solution architecture.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and C\#.
* Extensive experience with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and modern frontend development frameworks.
* Strong expertise in Azure cloud services and cloud\-native application architectures.
* Experience building scalable microservices and distributed application solutions.
* Hands\-on experience integrating Azure AI Services, OpenAI, Cognitive Services, or Generative AI solutions into enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of API design, integration architecture, and service\-oriented development.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of cloud security, identity management, governance, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
* Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, design principles, and engineering best practices.
* Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Ability to evaluate complex business requirements and design practical, scalable solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience delivering production\-grade enterprise solutions with high availability and security requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, presentation, and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile and cross\-functional delivery environments.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents



  





**Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:** 




  





 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
 



  




* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment



  





**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent \- persistent.com/careers**

3f6c77bb.title: Senior Azure Cloud Administrator
3f6c77bb.description:
About Us

Surbhi Electronet Private Limited (SEPL) is a leading IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Datacenter, Networking, and Cybersecurity solutions provider delivering technology solutions across Government, PSU, Education, Enterprise, and Smart City projects. We are looking for an experienced Azure professional to join our Cloud \& IT Infrastructure team and contribute to the successful delivery and management of Microsoft Azure environments for our customers.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated **Senior Azure Cloud Administrator** with 5\-7 years of experience in Microsoft Azure administration, deployment, and support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing Azure infrastructure projects, ensuring high availability and security of cloud environments, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting customer cloud transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

✅ Deploy, configure, and manage Microsoft Azure infrastructure for customer projects.  
✅ Configure and administer Azure Virtual Machines, Storage, Networking, NSGs, VPN Gateways, Backup, and Recovery solutions.  
✅ Manage Azure Entra ID, RBAC, subscriptions, and access control policies.  
✅ Monitor cloud environments for availability, performance, and security.  
✅ Troubleshoot Azure infrastructure, networking, and connectivity issues.  
✅ Provide L2/L3 support and handle critical customer escalations.  
✅ Implement Azure Backup and Disaster Recovery solutions.  
✅ Identify opportunities for cloud performance enhancement and cost optimization.  
✅ Coordinate with customers, OEMs, consultants, and internal teams during project execution.  
✅ Support tendering and pre\-sales teams with technical inputs, BOQs, and solution sizing.  
✅ Maintain project documentation, architecture diagrams, and deployment records.  
✅ Guide and support junior cloud engineers.

Required Skills

* 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure Virtual Machines, Storage, Networking, NSG, VPN Gateway, Backup, and Recovery.
* Experience with Azure Entra ID, RBAC, and Identity \& Access Management.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Routing, Firewalls, and Hybrid Connectivity.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows Server and Linux Server administration.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with Azure Monitoring and Cost Management.
* Excellent customer interaction, communication, and coordination skills.
* Experience working on Government, PSU, Enterprise, or large infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Qualifications

* B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA or equivalent qualification in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.

Preferred Certifications

* Microsoft AZ\-104: Azure Administrator Associate
* Microsoft AZ\-305: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Microsoft AZ\-500: Azure Security Engineer Associate

Why Join SEPL?

* Work on large\-scale Government and Enterprise cloud projects.
* Exposure to advanced Azure infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.
* Opportunity to work with leading OEMs and technology partners.
* Professional growth in cloud infrastructure, security, and project delivery.
* Collaborative and technology\-driven work environment.

Apply Now

If you are passionate about Microsoft Azure and looking to work on impactful Government and Enterprise projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply with your updated resume and relevant Azure certifications.**

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

e18bd1be.description:
**About Us**



HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180\+ agents that orchestrate end\-to\-end processes across Order\-to\-Cash, Close \& Reconciliation, Consolidation \& Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3\-6 month go\-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300\+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol\-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.


**Job Summary**



The Senior Consultant is responsible for delivering the HighRadius Cloud product implementations of Fortune 1000 clients. He/She will be owning solutioning for client engagements throughout the project life cycle. The Senior Consultant is also responsible for delivering the design for the project on time with high quality, value and inline with Client project objectives. This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the main point of contact for project design and work with Client SMEs and stakeholders and Client users across client organizations. The candidate must have strong solutioning skills, well organized, detail\-oriented, quality\-minded and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. He/She will be responsible for guiding the Consultant, Associate Consultant and Data Analyst to implement the design and achieve project objectives. .


**Key Responsibilities**


* Perform blueprint design for one to many client projects for multiple HighRadius products. Gather business requirements, explore solution options, brainstorm solutions with internal team(s) and client team(s) wherever required to finalize design.
* Oversee consultant and through them Data Analyst and Associate Consultant to ensure solution is built per the agreed design.
* Ultimately accountable for project success by ensuring client achieves business value through a well defined solution design and holding the Consultant/Associate Consultant/Data Analyst accountable to outcome metrics.
* Keep the Delivery Manager and/or Program Director honest and up to date on any potential risks related to Solution design and/or Project value.
* Ability to produce actionable deliverables, influencing stakeholders to make informed design and decisions\- Act as voice of reason within HRC and client teams.


**Skill \& Experience Needed**


* Bachelor's or Master's Degree (preferably from a top reputed university).
* Strong solutioning, presentation and facilitation skills with small and large groups.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand Fortune 1000 client business complexities and solution those.
* Overall 6\+ years of professional services experience \- Combination of Solutioning and delivery management experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience as Solution Architect/Technology Business Analyst or equivalent role preferably in a fast\-paced consulting / professional services set\-up.
* Experience in following the established processes/standards/templates to achieve successful results.
* Experience with Accounts Payable related business process is desirable

**What You'll Get**


* Competitive salary.
* Fun\-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
* Equal employment opportunities.
* Opportunity to build with a pre\-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

 We are SAP Platinum partner. Presently, our team consists of over 5000\+ skilled professionals spread across 21 countries spanning Europe, Asia, United Kingdom, South America and North America.
 



  





**What Makes You Successful at delaware India?**

 **6 Cs** 
 :
 


* **Consulting Mindset:** 
 Proactive, accountable, and able to build trusted client relationships.
* **Communication:** 
 Clear, transparent, and confident in engaging with business and technical stakeholders.

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to troubleshoot and diagnose complex technical problems related to SAP FICO functionality, configuration, and integration.

 As a consultant, you will have the opportunity to continuously enhance your skills by staying updated with the latest SAP technologies and trends. This commitment to ongoing learning ensures that you can provide. the most innovative and effective solutions to our clients.
 



  





**We are looking for following skills in our new colleague.** 




  




* Significant experience (8\+ years) as an SAP FICO Consultant with hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation in cloud\-based projects.
* Strong experience in providing ongoing support for SAP S/4HANA FICO modules, including troubleshooting issues, resolving user problems, and performing system enhancements.

* Stay updated on the latest SAP FICO features, tools, and public cloud trends.
* Hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA FICO configuration, customization, and deployment in a Public Cloud environment
* Finance consultant responsible for supporting S/4 HANA Public Cloud Implementation, focusing on configuring and optimizing Finance to ensure seamless integration and efficient business operations.
* SAP S/4HANA certification in FICO is a plus.



  





**Let’s Meet Up** 




  





 Come have a chat with us and tell us all about your skills, talents and previous experience. Make sure to connect with us if you have any questions whatsoever. Apply now and hopefully we’ll get to meet each other real soon!
