81937e6f.title: Delivery Manager - SyncOS
81937e6f.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. Botsync is a Singapore\-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. Founded in 2017, we design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots \- including our MAG series \- that handle material movement at scale, so humans can focus on higher\-value work.


Alongside our hardware, we've built syncOS, the industry's first no\-code, vendor\-agnostic orchestration and fleet management platform that coordinates robots, industrial systems, and workflows across modern facilities \- turning weeks\-long deployments into hours, without halting production or calling in specialists.


Today we're still that young, passionate team \- just with more like\-minded people who've joined us along the way. We're all obsessed with one thing: making robotics and automation simpler, faster to adapt, and more reliable on real factory floors.


If you love robots, hate inefficiency, and want to build things that actually run in production \- you'll fit right in.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own SyncOS customer engagements end to end, from scope alignment and implementation planning through testing, acceptance, and production go\-live.
* Align customers and internal teams on outcomes, scope, acceptance criteria, responsibilities, and timelines before execution begins.
* Lead customer communication on delivery progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and changes.
* Translate each engagement into an execution plan covering SyncOS configuration, integrations, engineering work, testing, and deployment.
* Manage scope, milestones, engineering capacity, dependencies, and risks across multiple active engagements.
* Maintain credible delivery commitments, surface threats early, and drive recovery decisions when plans move off track.
* Develop practical knowledge of SyncOS architecture, workflows, integration points, and deployment constraints.
* Partner with Engineering and Solutions to challenge assumptions and distinguish configuration, integration, and product\-development work.
* Assess the effort and timeline impact of new requirements before they enter execution, keeping customer and internal commitments aligned.
* Escalate trade\-offs between customer needs, product capability, engineering capacity, and delivery commitments when required.
* Build consistent practices for planning, status reporting, risk management, implementation readiness, and handover.
* Capture recurring implementation friction and work with Product and Engineering to standardize, automate, or productize solutions.

  

**Requirements** **Essential:**

* 6\-9 years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, solutions, technical program management, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* Proven ownership of multiple enterprise software implementations from scope definition through production go\-live.
* Experience delivering integration\-heavy software involving multiple systems, dependencies, and customer\-specific constraints.
* Ability to build enough technical depth to challenge estimates, identify dependencies, and contribute meaningfully to implementation discussions.
* Strong scope and change management without compromising customer relationships or delivery commitments.
* Confidence working directly with customers when projects are ambiguous, dependencies fail, or commitments are at risk.
* Experience coordinating engineering capacity across concurrent engagements and making explicit sequencing and prioritization trade\-offs.
* Clear communication with technical teams and senior customer stakeholders, supported by delivery plans grounded in underlying work and dependencies.

 **Highly desirable:**

* Exposure to industrial automation, robotics, warehouse automation, manufacturing software, workflow orchestration, integration, or low\-code platforms.
* Experience integrating WMS, MES, ERP, PLCs, automation equipment, or customer APIs in live operational environments, with evidence of standardizing repeated delivery work.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

9e7d709f.title: Implementation Engagement Manager
9e7d709f.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high\-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry\-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.
   

  

 Are you an energetic and customer\-focused
 **Project or Program Manager** 
 ? Are you action\-oriented and proactive by nature? Can you quickly decompose complex concepts and explain them in a way that makes sense to technical and non\-technical audiences? If so, we want to speak to you!
   

  

**Black Duck** 
 , a repeated leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Application Security, is seeking an experienced Project / Engagement Manager to help our Implementation and Services Team drive customer onboarding and adoption. We’re looking for someone to help take our business to the next level of excellence in delivery and customer delight!
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Black Duck Technical Services team is dedicated to supporting our customers in developing their AppSec vision and achieving their goals quickly. We accomplish this through the delivery of exemplary product implementations and adoption\-focused services that are tailored to their specific needs. Our services are designed to help customers of all sizes and types, from Startup’s to global organizations, build secure, high\-quality software faster and maximize the value of their Black Duck tools.
   

  

**A Day in Your Life** 
  

  

 In this role, you'll be responsible for the planning and successful implementation of Black Duck solutions to help the world’s leading technology companies meet their software security goals.
   

  

* Project Management: You’ll serve as project lead and own all functional aspects of the engagement. This includes requirements gathering and translating the scope of work into a project plan containing milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical path, and RACI.
* Delivery: You’ll coordinate people (vertical, horizontally) and processes to ensure projects are delivered on\-time, on\-track, and within budget to consistently produce high quality outcomes.
* Communication: You’ll establish and maintain relationships at all levels of the customer organization including project team members, executive sponsors and key stakeholders.
* Status Reporting: You’ll develop status reports and communicate clear, accurate, and timely updates regarding project health and progress
* Risk Management: You’ll diagnose implementation challenges/risks, develop contingency plans, and implement changes to drive risk mitigation.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You’ll lead cross\-functional teams (collocated and remote) to ensure stakeholders (Sales, TAMs, CSMs, Tech Support, SEs, etc.) are aligned and informed.
* Accountability: You’ll set clear expectations with internal and external team members and hold them accountable for deadlines and project deliverables.
* Process Improvement: You’ll document lessons learned and recommend process and methodology improvements to improve execution on future projects.


**About You**
 You’ll have:
   

  

* At least 5 years of experience in a client\-facing professional services, consulting, or project management role.
* Proactive, thorough, and transparent in communication \- people rarely need to follow up with you.
* Process driven and have a strong desire to create, implement, and iterate on processes that lead to a standardized and positive customer experience.
* Exceptional EQ, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Experience working in a global environment and supporting customers in different time\-zones.
* Experience with mixed onshore/offshore delivery models.
* Proven ability to lead projects for both SaaS and On\-prem solutions.
* Willingness to work flexible hours to support North America and EMEA customer engagements.


 You May Have:
   

  

* A track record of managing onboarding / adoption focused professional services and customer success engagements for complex products.
* Familiarity with the DevOps and Application Security space
* PMP, PRINCE2 Foundation/PRINCE2 Practitioner, or other project management certification.
* Experience with PSA and Project Management tools, preferably with one or more of the following: Salesforce, TeamWork, Certinia, Confluence, Jira


**Your Education:**
* A bachelors or masters degree


*Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.*

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

8aacebdc.title: Program Manager – Certification Development
8aacebdc.description:
**Job Title: Program Manager – Certification Development****Location: Remote**  

EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide. **www.eccouncil.org** **Role Overview:**
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager – Assessment \& Certification Development to lead the end\-to\-end development and continuous improvement of professional certification assessments.  

This role sits at the intersection of assessment strategy, certification development, subject\-matter expertise, psychometrics, and program governance. The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, subject\-matter experts, psychometricians, and certification governance committees to ensure that our assessments accurately measure the knowledge, skills, and competencies required for professionals in the field.  

The role requires strong program management capability, assessment expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly governed certification environment. **Key Responsibilities:*** Lead the end\-to\-end assessment and certification development lifecycle, from JTA and competency analysis through exam blueprinting, item development, validation, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Job Task Analysis (JTA) and ensure assessments are aligned to current industry roles, tasks, competencies, and professional practice.
* Develop and maintain exam blueprints, assessment specifications, competency models, and content domains in collaboration with SMEs and psychometric professionals.
* Lead item development, review, validation, and performance analysis, ensuring items meet quality, relevance, cognitive\-level, and technical standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, fairness, standard setting, item analysis, and assessment performance.
* Coordinate SME workshops, validation studies, and assessment reviews and translate findings into actionable assessment improvements.
* Ensure assessment development is well\-documented, evidence\-based, and aligned with certification governance and accreditation requirements.
* Manage multiple assessment\-development programs, including timelines, SMEs, stakeholders, risks, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with Certification Operations, Exam Security, Product, Technology, and other teams to ensure assessments are ready for secure and effective delivery.
Identify opportunities to improve the quality, scalability, efficiency, and defensibility of certification assessments.  
* 

  

**What We're Looking For:*** PhD or master’s degree in psychology, Assessment, Education, Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in professional certification, assessment/examination development, credentialing, or psychometrics.
* Proven experience managing high\-stakes professional certification or assessment programs.
* Strong knowledge of Job Task Analysis (JTA), Role Delineation/Job Practice Analysis, exam blueprinting, item development, content validation, and assessment governance.
* Strong working knowledge of psychometric principles, including validity, reliability, item analysis, statistical evaluation, and standard setting.
* Experience working with SMEs, psychometricians, item writers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop and validate assessments.
* Strong program management, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience in an accredited or standards\-driven certification environment preferred.
* ISO/IEC 17024 knowledge is a strong plus.
Experience in cybersecurity, IT, technology, or professional certification is an advantage.  
* 

  

**About Our Culture:**
EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community. **Additional Information:**
EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.  

EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist.  

To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work.  

If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.  

Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third\-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.  

Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.  

Please review our policy here: EC\-Council Privacy Policy\- User \& company \| Data Protection. Submission of your application will be considered as your acceptance of the terms stated above.

5cb3a843.title: Business Program Manager
5cb3a843.description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.  

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare. **Role Overview**
We are looking for a **Business Program Manager –** Retail Digital Transformation \& GenAI who can translate complex business challenges into scalable technology solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of the retail domain, preferably within the Fashion and Lifestyle sector, along with experience in digital transformation and technology\-led product development.
You will own the product vision and requirements, analyse existing business processes, identify gaps, and work with cross\-functional teams to develop and roll out effective solutions. You will also use Generative AI tools to improve product discovery, requirement analysis, prototyping, and overall execution. **What will you do at Fynd?****Product Strategy and Ownership*** Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for assigned retail technology solutions.
* Understand business objectives and convert them into clear product requirements and priorities.
* Create detailed product requirement documents, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritise product features based on business impact, customer needs, technical feasibility, and available resources.
* Define measurable success metrics and track product performance after launch.
* Ensure that product initiatives are aligned with the company’s overall business and technology strategy.

**Business Process and Gap Analysis*** Understand and document existing retail and operational processes.
* Break down complex business processes and identify inefficiencies, gaps, and automation opportunities.
* Identify business requirements and scenarios that may not be clearly articulated by stakeholders.
* Recommend technology\-led solutions to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
* Work closely with business teams to validate requirements and ensure that proposed solutions address the actual problem.
* Develop a strong understanding of retail, fashion and lifestyle, e\-commerce, supply chain, inventory, and omnichannel operations.

**Product Development and Delivery*** Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and Business teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product development from requirement gathering and solution design to testing and production rollout.
* Coordinate product testing, User Acceptance Testing, issue resolution, and launch readiness.
* Ensure that all business and functional requirements are validated before product rollout.
* Manage dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines across multiple stakeholders.
* Support business teams during implementation and ensure smooth product adoption.
* Monitor post\-launch performance and drive continuous product improvements.

**Generative AI and Technical Understanding*** Use Generative AI tools for research, requirement analysis, prototyping, documentation, and problem\-solving.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into products and business workflows.
* Work with technical teams to assess the feasibility and scalability of AI\-led solutions.
* Have a good understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, system architecture, and technology dependencies.
* Stay updated on developments in Generative AI, retail technology, and digital transformation.
* Experiment with new AI tools and approaches to improve product development speed and quality.

**Stakeholder Management*** Collaborate with senior business leaders, customers, Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Conduct requirement\-gathering workshops and product demonstrations.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, dependencies, and progress clearly to stakeholders.
* Handle conflicting requirements and provide constructive pushback when required.
* Manage stakeholder expectations while maintaining focus on product and business outcomes.
* Present product updates, risks, recommendations, and performance metrics to senior leadership.

 **Some Specific Requirements*** 4–8 years of experience in Product Management, Digital Transformation, Business Transformation, or a similar role.
* Strong experience in owning technology products from discovery and requirement gathering through launch and adoption.
* Experience in retail technology, e\-commerce, Fashion and Lifestyle, omnichannel commerce, supply chain, or related domains.
* Strong hands\-on exposure to Generative AI tools and their application in product development and business operations.
* Experience creating product roadmaps, PRDs, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on experience managing product testing, UAT, implementation, and rollout.
* Ability to analyse complex business processes and identify unarticulated requirements or operational gaps.
* Good understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology systems.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, handle pressure, and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to challenge assumptions and provide informed pushback.
* A proactive, articulate, and ownership\-driven approach to work.

**Good to Have*** Experience working with enterprise retail or Fashion and Lifestyle brands.
* Experience leading large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Order Management Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, inventory management, marketplaces, or store operations.
* Experience using AI tools to build prototypes, automate workflows, or support product decision\-making.
* Prior experience working in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.

 **What do we offer?** **Growth**
At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**
We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.* Regular community engagement and team\-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**
Your well\-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents **Work Environment**
We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.  

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

48b7dfb8.title: Advisory Solutions Architect
48b7dfb8.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre\-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
   

  

 MongoDB Pre\-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you do at MongoDB:
   

  

 In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
   

  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimization strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self\-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account\-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members. Show thought leadership through publication of articles, public speaking sessions or panels
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends


 What you will learn:
   

  

 MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:
   

  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full\-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly


 Market\-Relevant Technologies:
   

  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes


 Modern Architecture Design:
   

  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space


 Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:
   

  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling


 Industry Insights:
   

  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries


 As an ideal candidate, you will have:
   

  

* Ideally, 12\+ years of related experience in a customer facing role, minimum 7 years of pre\-sales experience while navigating complex enterprise software sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C\+\+, Java, C\#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on\-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Presented at industry conferences, published articles, papers or blog posts sharing expertise and showing thought leadership
* Demonstrated ability to drive effective collaboration with Sales Leadership at the Regional Director level to proactively identify strategies driving growth across multiple Sales Reps / Accounts or Industry Verticals
* Demonstrated strong understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Master’s degree or equivalent work experience


 You may also have:
   

  

* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Experience in SRE practices
* Proven ability to up\-level the broader organization \- for example by sharing best practices or creating reusable assets
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

05d2ad7d.description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for
 **domain\-first, systems\-oriented engineers** 
 who understand how real\-world systems (in renewable energy
 **,** 
 automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI\-driven workflows using DevRev.
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
 **trusted advisor** 
 , combining
 **domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem\-solving** 
 to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
   

  

 You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
 **real\-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real\-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI\-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end\-to\-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real\-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Domain Expertise**
* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real\-world data (signals, logs, time\-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes


**Engineering Depth**
* Strong system\-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log\-stream analysis, etc.)


**Problem Solving \& Use Case Thinking**
* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end\-to\-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real\-world signals


**AI \& Tools**
* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

e98655ec.title: Solution Architect - Shared Services
e98655ec.description:
**Job ID** R.0061427 **Primary location** Bengaluru, Karnataka **Date posted** 09/11/2026 **Worker type** Regular **Workplace flexibility** Remote \- Nationwide Save


Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.


Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


**Job Summary**
===============


As a Solution Architect at Empower, you will be a hands\-on technical leader and solution\-shaping architecture contributor supporting Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO. You will partner with business leaders, Business and Enterprise Architects, product owners, cybersecurity, engineering, operations, data, and vendor teams to translate business outcomes, regulatory obligations, and operational needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective end\-to\-end solutions.


The role spans SaaS platforms, cloud services, applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure, with particular emphasis on ServiceNow and AWS. You will guide initiatives from discovery through implementation, define target\-state and reference architectures, document decisions and trade\-offs, and establish reusable patterns and guardrails. You will also support the broader shared\-services technology landscape, including Atlassian Jira and Confluence, Palantir Foundry, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, while ensuring solutions are supportable, observable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.


**Responsibilities**
====================


* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for moderately to highly complex initiatives across Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, and the Office of the CIO, connecting business capabilities and processes to application, integration, data, security, and technology designs.
* Lead discovery and translate functional and nonfunctional requirements \- including security, privacy, records retention, auditability, availability, recovery, performance, scalability, supportability, and cost \- into practical architecture options and recommendations.
* Create and maintain architecture deliverables such as current\-state and target\-state views, context and logical diagrams, deployment models, data flows, integration designs, nonfunctional requirements, architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and transition plans.
* Serve as a ServiceNow architecture lead, defining scalable platform and solution designs across workflows, the platform data model, CSDM and CMDB, integrations, identity and security, custom applications, environment strategy, performance, upgradeability, and platform governance. Evaluate fit\-to\-platform and minimize unnecessary customization.
* Design AWS solutions aligned with AWS Well\-Architected principles across identity and access management, networking, compute, storage, databases, integration, observability, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Define and guide infrastructure automation using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform, including reusable templates and modules, source control, automated validation, environment promotion, secrets handling, policy guardrails, and stack, state, and drift management.

9a130ef2.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
9a130ef2.description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for an On\-Site Technical Account Manager (L2\) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

  

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root\-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI\-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre\-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post\-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure\-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance\-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before\-and\-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior\-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration\-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on\-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service\-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

  

### **WHAT YOU HAVE**

  

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high\-availability, resilience and distributed\-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre\-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root\-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance\-tuning, capacity\-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root\-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge\-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

  

### **About Hazelcast**


The world's largest leading companies trust Hazelcast and its unified real\-time data platform to take instant action on streaming data. With a stream processing engine and fast data store integrated into a single solution, businesses can simplify real\-time architectures for next\-gen applications and AI/ML departments to drive new revenue, mitigate risk, and operate efficiently \- at a low TCO.
  

  

To learn more about Hazelcast, or to join our community of CXOs, architects, and developers at brands such as HSBC, JPMorgan Chase, Volvo, New York Life, Domino's, and others, visit hazelcast.com  

  

**Equal Opportunities at Hazelcast**  

  

We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, races, religions, gender, sexual identities, abilities, and personal circumstances, in a spirit of inclusivity and belonging.We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, and believe we see strength in diversity.  

  

If you require any accommodation to assist you in the interview process, please submit this with your application.We offer competitive salaries with a flexible, empathetic and highly collaborative working environment.  

  

If you are motivated by the prospect of a career with a forward\-thinking tech company, we'd love to hear from you.

You’ll work closely with service desk teams, infrastructure engineers, and digital workplace specialists to identify automation opportunities, build playbooks, and continuously enhance system performance and user experience. Beyond technical delivery, the role emphasizes data\-driven decision\-making, agile collaboration, and end\-user experience improvement. In essence, this role is about bridging IT operations and automation engineering—turning reactive support into proactive, self\-healing systems that reduce tickets, improve MTTR, and enhance digital experience across the enterprise.
Responsibilities:
* Be a part of a global engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and deploying self\-healing and automation solutions.
* Design and implement automated solutions using SysTrack Selfheal to resolve IT incidents and service requests efficiently.

* Develop and maintain playbooks for self\-healing actions, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness.
* Integrate SysTrack Selfheal with existing IT infrastructure and monitoring tools.
* Analyse incident and service request data to identify opportunities for automation.
* Collaborate with the Service Desk team to identify and prioritize automation initiatives.
* Continuously monitor and improve the performance of self\-healing automation.
* Provide technical support to the Service Desk team on SysTrack Selfheal functionalities.
* Stay up to date on the latest advancements in SysTrack Selfheal, automation best practices, and other relevant ITSM/ITOM tools.
* Agile software development practices for customizations to the platform and applications.
* Implement ITSM modules, workflow customization, ticketing process automation, report development, dashboard creation, and system configurations.
* Deliver a high level of knowledge and customer service within the ITSM Suite.
* Organize and prioritize development efforts, interface with vendors and management, and potentially coordinate the efforts of additional administrators.
* Consider dependencies, relationships, and integration points to ensure proper solution integration with other systems when applicable.
* Effectively manage and execute high\-level tasks assigned via user stories.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Total 11\+ years of experience in IT Operations/Service Management/Service Desk /End User Computing arena:
	+ 5\+ years of working knowledge of Selfheal or Digital Experience (DEX) monitoring tools, like Systrack, Nexthink, Riverbed, Aptean, etc.
	+ 8\+ years of experience in IT Process Automation using tools like UiPath, Automation Anywhere, etc.
	+ 5\+ Years of experience working on the ServiceNow Platform (ITSM, Process Mining, etc.)

* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

b16677dc.title: Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant
b16677dc.description:
**Req ID:** 
 386529
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 We are looking for Senior Azure Platform Engineers to join a newly formed Azure squad within a cloud platform engineering service we are delivering for a leading UK financial services organisation.
   

  

 You will be a founding member of a five\-person squad, working in two\-week sprints under a UK\-based Engineering Lead and alongside an established AWS squad. The team builds the client's Azure platform as a set of reusable, versioned products — landing zones, Terraform modules, policy baselines, standard images and CI/CD pipelines — consumed by engineering teams across the organisation through a self\-service internal developer platform. As a senior engineer you will take ownership of significant platform components, set the engineering bar for the squad, and help establish its standards and ways of working from day one.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform engineering: Design and build Azure landing zone components — subscription vending, networking, identity integration, policy baselines and guardrails — as reusable Terraform modules.
* Component ownership: Own significant platform products end\-to\-end: design, build, test, documentation and release management.
* CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure delivery, with security scanning, policy checks, testing and cost controls embedded as quality gates.
* Azure Local and hybrid: Contribute to the engineering of Azure Local capability and hybrid automation, extending the platform model into the client's private cloud estate.
* Standard images: Build and maintain pipelines for hardened compute standard images (build, test, publication).
* Self\-service products: Package platform capabilities for consumption as self\-service golden paths through the Port.io developer portal catalogue.
* Engineering standards: Help establish squad conventions — code review discipline, module structure, testing standards and documentation — and uphold them through peer review.
* Mentoring: Support and coach the squad's mid\-level engineers; contribute to design discussions with the Engineering Lead and Platform Architect.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years: in infrastructure, cloud or DevOps engineering, of which 8\+ years hands\-on Azure engineering.
* Azure platform depth: Strong experience with enterprise Azure — management groups, subscription design, Azure Policy, networking (hub\-spoke or vWAN), Entra ID and security baselines.
* Terraform: Advanced, production Terraform experience: writing reusable modules, managing state, versioning and testing infrastructure code.
* CI/CD: Hands\-on experience building infrastructure pipelines with GitHub Actions or an equivalent platform (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI) with willingness to standardise on GitHub Actions.
* Engineering discipline: Strong Git workflow, code review and documentation habits; experience working in sprint\-based agile teams.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working in a distributed team with UK\-based technical leadership and client stakeholders; clear written and spoken English.


**Technologies \& Tools**
 The Azure squad operates a modern, standardised toolchain:
   

  

* Core: Azure, Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI), Azure Arc, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions.
* Policy and security: Azure Policy, Wiz and Checkov IaC scanning, OPA policy\-as\-code.
* Pipeline quality: tflint, terraform\-docs, Infracost, Terratest.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions for standard workflows; Temporal for complex, long\-running orchestration.
* Consumption: Port.io internal developer portal as the self\-service consumption route for Azure and private cloud products.
* Standard images: Image pipeline tooling for compute standard images (build, hardening, testing, publication).


**Desirable**
* Microsoft certifications (AZ\-104 Azure Administrator, AZ\-305 Azure Solutions Architect, AZ\-400 DevOps Engineer).
* Azure Local / Azure Stack HCI or Azure Arc experience.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code (OPA, Sentinel) and IaC security scanning (Checkov, Wiz, tfsec).
* Exposure to internal developer portals (Port.io, Backstage) or platform engineering models.
* Experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tooling.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

 Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
   

  

***NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.***

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. **Company Description**
**NEC Software Solutions (India)**
 On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.
   

  

 We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.
   

  

 We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.
   

  

 For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.
   

  

**About NEC Corporation**
 NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.
   

  

 NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.
   

  

 For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 Working within the Health business, you will be responsible for defining the policies and standards that guide technology delivery, possessing significant experience in modern, cloud based technology standards and practices.
   

  

 As Solution Architect you are accountable for providing architectural design and technology roadmaps for complex Health applications supporting high volume, mission critical products and services.
   

  

 You'll work hand in hand with our Product Managers, Delivery and Technical Leads in order to influence and define a technology roadmap to meet both our commercial and technology aims.
   

  

 Core aim of this role is to provide technical assurance to ensure successful deployment of NEC SWS Public Safety products into a given client whilst also protecting our commercial position.
   

  

 To be successful in the role, we need someone who can mediate between people and explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, particularly someone who is confident in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. Someone who understands the evolutionary nature of technology delivery in an agile environment. As you may imagine, our stakeholder expectations are high, and we'll need you to facilitate discussions about high risk and complexity even within constrained timescales.
   

  

 The Solution Architect will work with the project or programme manager and the wider architecture team to:
   

  

* ensure that scope of supply is correctly documented and maintained
* technical project risks are identified and managed
* ensure that any non\-functional requirements from a customer are agreed and documented
* ensure Impact assessments are practical, have well defined scope and implementation and use existing products and technologies wherever possible
* Deliver/Manage High Level Designs for solutions.
* Deliver documentation including diagrams, dataflows, and solution working detail
* identify opportunities for selling additional product capability.


**Candidates will have awareness of the following items:**
* 
* C\+\+
* 
* C\#
* 
* SQL Server
* 
* Windows platforms
* 
* Domains / AD
* 
* Authentication \& Authorisation methods inc. OAuth
* Development Patterns


**Candidates will have good practical knowledge of some or all of the following items:**
* 
* Data \& Database Management
* 
* Messaging/Message Brokers/Buses including RabbitMQ
* 
* Common API frameworks including REST, SOAP
* 
* Well\-Architected Frameworks
* 
* Technology evolutions \& roadmaps
* 
* Cloud Solutions – AWS/Azure/OCI
* 
* Networking \& communication of solutions \& components
* 
* Security aspects of solutions, integrations \& connectivity


**Candidates will have In Depth knowledge of some or all of the following items:**
* Architectural Patterns and their uses
* Integration Patterns


**Additional Information**
* Has worked with UK clients and team (Preferred)
* Has working experience of the onshore – offshore model
* Has experience of commercial awareness in aspects such as revenue recognition and margin management

88da2c46.title: Technical Account Manager
88da2c46.description:
**Technical Account Manager**

**Location:** Hybrid \- Mumbai

 **Position Summary:**


Bentley Systems seeks a dynamic Technical Account Manager (TAM) to collaborate closely with the Account Manager (AM) in driving goals through effectively managing the technical relationship and strategy for Bentley's most strategic accounts. As a global leader in infrastructure software, Bentley Systems provides cutting\-edge solutions that empower users in infrastructure projects.


The TAM defines the technical account strategy by combining the appropriate sales methodology, deep industry, and technical background to align with sales initiatives while advocating for the customer within Bentley by partnering with sales, product, user success, consulting, and marketing to provide a clear understanding of the customer's environment, challenges, and requirements. The TAM fosters long\-term partnerships and expansion with customers and net new customer acquisition within each customer's ecosystem. The TAM aligns the customer's business projects and technical goals with Bentley's vision, mission, and strategy.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with Account Managers and users to develop technical account strategies and compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate with Account Managers to run discovery sessions, identify user value, gather requirements, and with support for Solution Engineering colleagues, propose tailored infrastructure software solutions.
* Document the technical roadmap for the account plan and contribute to account reviews.
* Cultivate strong relationships with key technical stakeholders within assigned account(s), fostering trust as a go\-to subject matter expert resource with credibility and a positive reputation.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product Management, Enterprise Success and Marketing to align technical and business requirements, share user insights, identify product enhancement opportunities, new go\-to\-market solutions and contribute to the continuous improvement of Bentley's software offerings.
* Engage with partners as an extension of the Bentley sales organization.
* Deliver and coordinate technical presentations, demonstrations and showcasing the value and functionality of Bentley’s software solutions.
* Coordinate a response to technical questions, concerns, and objections raised by accounts, while highlighting the benefits and competitive advantages of the company's solutions.
* Contribute to compelling technical proposals, documentation, and responses to RFPs working with AE and SA.
Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to provide informed recommendations and insights to the sales team and accounts.  
* 

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Technology, or a related field, preferably structural and offshore infrastructure\-related background.
* 7\+ years of technical sales experience in the infrastructure industry, with additional knowledge or experience in the Engineering, Construction, or Design industry.
* Knowledge of SACS, STAAD and Plant Design tools will be beneficial
* Experience deploying new technology into a workforce to inspire innovation, change, and efficiency.
* Deep knowledge of Bentley Systems solutions
* Travel requirement up to 50%.

 **What we offer**

* A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.
* An exciting career as an integral part of a world\-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction \- watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.

**Group Function** \- The Intelligent Automation department, serves as the Center of Excellence within the Customer Experience \& Digital division, driving automation projects at FAB. The department promotes, enables, and facilitates Robotic Process Automation (RPA) by establishing standards for selecting the right processes for automation and building scalable solutions using reusable components. **Role Purpose:** The Intelligent Automation Specialist is responsible for guiding and working with a team of developers and testers to independently implement automation solutions. This role requires the ability to analyse business processes, suggest improvements, and develop RPA solutions. The Specialist should be able to break down processes, estimate the time required for each step, and participate in the preparation of project analysis and solution design documents.

  

The Specialist is expected to support other team members in completing projects on schedule while adhering to engineering processes such as code reviews, source control, unit testing, use case analysis, and defect management. They should also provide support and guidance to business stakeholders by answering technical questions and resolving issues based on defined and agreed\-upon SLAs.

  

The ideal candidate will support the Tech Lead in creating and refining a tailored framework that provides an optimal platform for the rapid and repeatable delivery of automated processes within the company.

**Job Description**

**Senior Technical Project Manager \- Supply Digital Technology**

**Job Purpose / Overview**


This role exists to provide senior technical project management leadership for the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology portfolio, ensuring critical Supply DT initiatives are delivered with quality, pace, strong governance and clear business value.


The role will drive the delivery of digital and technology projects across key Supply capabilities, including Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Planning capabilities such as Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 solutions.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will coordinate business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendor and delivery teams to move initiatives from concept through design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefit realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Supply Digital Technology projects across Food \& Nutrition, covering data foundations, planning, manufacturing and analytics capabilities.
* Manage project delivery across the full lifecycle, including demand shaping, business case support, concept and initiation, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, project closure and transition to support.
* Drive delivery of Supply DT initiatives such as Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Blue Yonder planning enhancements, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 capabilities, ensuring each initiative has clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and success measures.
* Coordinate internal teams, third\-party vendors, system integrators, data partners and business stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budget and to expected quality standards.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency maps, governance materials, financial tracking and status reporting for senior DT and business stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives and Supply pain points into actionable delivery plans, working closely with Supply leaders, Business Partners, Product Owners, Data teams, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO and functional SMEs.
* Ensure technical delivery activities are aligned with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, integration, service introduction and operational support standards.
* Partner with Supply business stakeholders to support business readiness, UAT planning, deployment preparation, adoption tracking and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating where required and driving clear decisions through appropriate governance forums.
* Support vendor and partner management, including input to Statements of Work, delivery plans, resource models, deliverable acceptance and performance management.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, controlled and suitable for transition to support teams, including business process documentation, technical design artefacts, testing evidence, cutover plans and operational handover materials.
* Work with Finance and PMO stakeholders to support budget planning, capitalization requirements, cost tracking, forecast updates and benefits realization.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery ways of working, including stronger use of PMX, agile/hybrid delivery methods, lessons learned, reusable templates and project governance discipline.
* Build strong relationships across global and regional Supply teams to ensure delivery plans reflect business priorities, local deployment realities and global template requirements.
* Act as a senior delivery leader within the Supply DT team, providing coaching, structure and delivery discipline to project teams, vendors and junior project resources where required

 **Context and Scope**

  

The role operates within the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology team, partnering closely with Supply business leaders, regional business partners, functional SMEs, DT delivery teams, Data \& AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO, Finance, PMO and external vendors.


The portfolio includes initiatives that enable Supply Chain visibility, planning effectiveness, data\-driven decision making, factory performance improvement and digital adoption across Food \& Nutrition. These include data and analytics foundations through Thema, planning capabilities involving Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing capabilities such as connected worker, factory data, operational visibility and predictive insights.


The role must balance strategic ambition with practical delivery constraints, ensuring projects are planned realistically, governed effectively and delivered in a way that creates sustainable business value. The role will work across regions and functions, often influencing without direct authority and managing delivery through a combination of internal resources, vendors, contractors and cross\-functional teams.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will be expected to operate comfortably with senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve delivery blockers, and bring structure to complex initiatives that span process, data, technology, integration and change

 **Job Specifications / Qualifications**

**Education \& Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM or equivalent is preferred.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe or hybrid delivery certification is desirable.
* Additional knowledge or certification in Supply Chain planning, data platforms, manufacturing systems or cloud/data technologies would be advantageous

**Knowledge / Experience**


Required:

* Experience delivering technology projects, with significant experience in digital transformation, Supply Chain, manufacturing, planning, data or enterprise technology environments.
* Proven experience as a senior Project Manager, Technical Project Manager, Delivery Manager or equivalent role leading cross\-functional technology delivery.
* Strong experience managing full project lifecycle delivery, including planning, governance, budget tracking, RAID management, stakeholder reporting, testing, deployment, hypercare and transition to support.
* Experience delivering projects involving complex stakeholder groups across business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendors and operations.
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain processes, ideally including planning, S\&OP, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, data and analytics.
* Experience working with or around planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, SAP planning capabilities or equivalent enterprise Supply Chain systems.
* Experience with data and analytics delivery, including data platforms, dashboards, reporting solutions, data governance, data quality and Power BI or equivalent analytics tools.
* Experience delivering manufacturing, Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, connected worker, factory data, automation or operational technology initiatives is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage third\-party vendors, system integrators and delivery partners, including delivery governance, SoW input, milestone tracking and deliverable acceptance.
* Strong financial discipline, including budget tracking, forecasting, capitalization awareness and benefits realization.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical delivery topics into clear business\-facing updates and senior stakeholder messages.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, prioritization and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to work globally across cultures, time zones and business functions.

 **Preferred Experience**

* Experience working in Food, CPG, FMCG or manufacturing environments.
* Experience with DT delivery methods, PMX, ServiceNow, GDO transition, cybersecurity review and enterprise architecture governance.
* Experience with Supply Chain, Thema, DNA 2\.0, Power BI, Blue Yonder or Smart Manufacturing capabilities.
* Experience managing projects with both business change and technical delivery components
