The Books Risk Management (BRM) Automation team is seeking a Program Manager II to drive automation programs that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and enhance the customer experience across Amazon's Books business.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high\-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments.
* Lead deep dives into operational issues, quality defects, and high\-severity escalations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms.
* Build business cases, define success metrics, and measure realized benefits including productivity gains, quality improvements, and operational leverage.
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Drive end\-to\-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
* Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

**Job Description:**
 SCRG is seeking an experienced Test Technical Program Manager to support consumer hardware manufacturing and factory test operations in Noida.This role will lead test readiness and execution across the full production line, working closely with Contract Manufacturers, fixture vendors, suppliers, and cross\-functional engineering teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Manage factory test stations from concept through sustaining and act as the primary point of contact for internal teams, CMs, and fixture vendors.
* Drive overall test readiness, identify risks, and communicate status across cross\-functional teams.
* Coordinate manufacturing test strategy across SMT, sub\-assembly, and FATP.
* Drive test yield, retest rate, and operational improvements across the production line.
* Manage test\-related SOPs, fixture readiness, cycle time, UPH, line balancing, and test engineering deliverables.
* Coordinate test framework software releases, fixture bring\-up, qualification, data collection solutions, and ongoing audits.
* Work with suppliers and engineering teams on process flow, equipment/fixture design, process controls, test infrastructure, reporting, and validation plans.
* Provide onsite support during development and sustaining builds.
* Act as the primary onsite technical contact for the CM and drive rapid resolution of line\-down issues.
* Track and audit implementation of ECOs and Change Requests, ensuring hardware, fixture, and software cut\-ins are executed without impacting throughput or yield.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years of industry experience.
* Strong experience in Manufacturing Test and Program Management.
* Familiarity with manufacturing data analysis, including Gauge R\&R, CPK, or Six Sigma.
* Ability to work primarily onsite in Noida and travel domestically as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience in Manufacturing Test Engineering and program management.
* Experience building and launching consumer electronics products.
* Strong track record leading cross\-functional teams to achieve quality, yield, cost, and NPI objectives.
* Experience with hardware testing, system bring\-up, and design validation.
* Proven experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and failure analysis.
* Experience managing functional engineering teams and working with international OEM partners.
* Ability to calculate and estimate test UPH for capacity planning, line balancing, and equipment scaling.
* Strong English communication, plus Hindi preferred.

The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost\-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof\-of\-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost\-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud\-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof\-of\-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.

* Cloud Architecture – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solution and System Architecture
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Data Pipeline Design
* System Integration and API Architecture
* Enterprise Application Architecture
* Analytics and AI/ML Platform Architecture
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Management / MLOps
* CI/CD, Build Automation, and Version Control
* Security, Governance, and Compliance in Architecture Design
* Architecture Documentation, Design Patterns, and Reference Architectures
* Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and influencing skills

* Experience with cost optimization and performance engineering.
* Experience architecting and integrating complex enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Experience designing AI/ML\-enabled solutions and modern analytics platforms.

* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI\-driven decision systems.
* Experience with IoT and connected product ecosystems.
* Experience with modern cloud\-native application and data platform architectures.

**Experience**

* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions.

**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
 **a hands\-on senior technical architect** 
 on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
   

  

 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
   

  

 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
   

  

 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Customer\-facing: 20\-40% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.

1ebac3cf.title: Chief Architect
1ebac3cf.description:

* PAH\-Public Spaces, Airports \& Health

**Skills**

#### **Knowledge \& Posting Location**


Architectural Design

Bachelor of Architecture (BArch)
  
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Job Description: Architecture Lead / Chief Architect**
========================================================


**Position:** Architecture Lead / Chief Architect
  

**Experience:** 15 to 18 years
  

**Project Exposure:** Public spaces, high\-rise buildings, large\-scale commercial, institutional, mixed\-use, civic, and infrastructure\-related developments


**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for an experienced and design\-driven Architecture Lead / Chief Architect to lead architectural design, planning, coordination, and delivery for large\-scale public space and high\-rise building projects. The role requires strong capability in master planning, concept development, façade design coordination, digitalisation initiatives, BIM\-enabled workflows, PPVC and precast project coordination, design management, multidisciplinary coordination, client presentations, stakeholder engagement, collaboration with international consultants, and team leadership. The candidate should be able to drive design excellence, improve digital design processes, manage complex project interfaces, and ensure timely delivery of technically sound, cost\-effective, buildable, and high\-quality architectural solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Lead architectural design and planning for public spaces, high\-rise buildings, mixed\-use developments, commercial, institutional, and large\-scale building projects.
* Develop and guide master planning, site planning, zoning, circulation, massing, built\-form, spatial organization, and architectural design strategies.
* Drive projects from concept design through schematic design, design development, tender documentation, construction documentation, and site coordination stages.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of architects, senior architects, BIM teams, consultants, and design coordinators to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Prepare, review, and present design concepts, technical proposals, design narratives, reports, drawings, and presentation material for clients and senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, façade, landscape, interiors, sustainability, fire and life safety, BIM, planning, contracts, procurement, and execution teams.
* Coordinate façade design intent, façade systems, materials, performance requirements, interfaces, mock\-ups, and technical details in collaboration with façade consultants and specialist vendors.
* Collaborate with international design consultants, specialist architects, façade experts, and global technical teams to align design intent, local requirements, execution feasibility, and project deliverables.
* Ensure integrated design coordination across disciplines and resolve design clashes, interface issues, technical queries, and constructability challenges.
* Manage client interactions, consultant workshops, stakeholder review meetings, design presentations, and approval processes.
* Drive design decisions with focus on functionality, aesthetics, statutory compliance, constructability, cost effectiveness, value engineering, and project timelines.
* Review architectural drawings, BIM models, specifications, material proposals, design calculations, area statements, and technical deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure compliance with applicable local building regulations, statutory norms, NBC provisions, accessibility requirements, fire safety norms, and project\-specific design standards.
* Support business development and tender\-stage submissions through design inputs, technical write\-ups, concept presentations, scope definition, and design strategy.
* Monitor design progress, identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive closure of design deliverables in line with project milestones.
* Drive digitalisation initiatives including BIM\-based design coordination, model\-based reviews, digital collaboration platforms, design automation, standardization of workflows, and improved information management across project teams.
* Coordinate architectural design requirements for PPVC, precast, modular construction, DfMA approaches, lifting and installation constraints, module planning, interface details, tolerance coordination, and site execution requirements.
* Promote innovation, digital design workflows, BIM\-based coordination, standardization, sustainable design principles, and best practices across the architecture team.
**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture; Master’s degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Planning, or related field will be an added advantage.
* 15 to 18 years of professional experience in architectural design, design management, and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Strong project experience in public spaces, high\-rise buildings, large\-scale commercial, institutional, civic, transport, mixed\-use, hospitality, or infrastructure\-related developments.
* Proven experience in leading architecture teams and managing complex design deliverables across multiple project stages.
* Experience in client\-facing roles, design reviews, consultant coordination, stakeholder management, and senior\-level presentations.
* Experience in façade design coordination, façade consultant reviews, building envelope integration, material finalization, performance coordination, and interface resolution for high\-rise and large\-scale projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work with international consultants, overseas design offices, global specialist teams, and multidisciplinary stakeholders across different work cultures, time zones, and project delivery standards.
* Hands\-on experience in digitalisation of design delivery, BIM\-led coordination, digital review workflows, common data environments, design dashboards, and technology\-enabled project coordination.
* Project experience in PPVC, precast, modular, prefabricated, or DfMA\-based building systems, including early\-stage design planning, coordination with specialist vendors, production constraints, transportation, erection sequence, and interface resolution.
* Good understanding of statutory approval processes, building codes, planning norms, construction detailing, project specifications, and quality standards.
**Technical Skills**
--------------------


* Strong knowledge of architectural design development, master planning, spatial planning, façade design, façade systems, building envelope coordination, material selection, performance requirements, and construction detailing.
* Ability to review and coordinate architectural drawings, BIM models, technical specifications, design reports, and consultant deliverables.
* Working knowledge of BIM workflows, Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud, common data environments, digital review platforms, design coordination dashboards, SketchUp, Rhino, or equivalent design and coordination platforms.
* Good understanding of high\-rise building planning, core design, vertical transportation, podium planning, basement planning, public interface, security zoning, and service integration.
* Understanding of PPVC, precast, modular construction, DfMA principles, prefabrication detailing, module coordination, tolerance requirements, lifting provisions, joint detailing, and coordination with manufacturing and site execution teams.
* Knowledge of sustainable design, passive design strategies, green building requirements, universal accessibility, and fire and life safety coordination.
**Leadership and Core Competencies**
------------------------------------


* Strong design leadership with the ability to guide teams and drive results across complex projects.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve design conflicts, and take timely decisions under project pressure.
* Strong coordination mindset with experience working across internal teams, clients, consultants, contractors, and execution teams.
* Outcome\-oriented approach with focus on quality, timelines, cost optimization, value engineering, and client satisfaction.
* Ability to mentor architects, build team capability, review design output, and establish design standards and workflows.
* Ability to lead digital transformation, promote BIM adoption, improve design productivity, and guide teams in PPVC, precast, modular, and industrialised construction coordination workflows.
* Strategic thinking with ability to contribute to business development, technical proposals, and design\-led project wins.
**Expected Deliverables**
-------------------------


* Architectural concepts, master plans, design reports, design narratives, presentations, and technical proposal inputs.
* Coordinated architectural drawings, BIM models, schedules, specifications, and design documentation across project stages.
* Coordinated façade design inputs, façade consultant comments, system interface details, material boards, mock\-up review inputs, and building envelope coordination outputs.
* Digital coordination outputs, BIM review trackers, design dashboards, model\-based issue logs, common data environment updates, and standardized digital workflow documents.
* PPVC, precast, and modular construction coordination outputs including module planning inputs, interface details, tolerance coordination notes, vendor coordination comments, and buildability review inputs.
* Design review comments, coordination trackers, RFI responses, stakeholder meeting inputs, and closure of design issues.
* Approved client presentation material, consultant coordination outputs, and milestone\-based design submissions.
* Integrated, buildable, compliant, cost\-effective, and high\-quality architectural design solutions aligned with project goals.

1f5d883b.title: Cloud  Architect
1f5d883b.description:
**Job Summary**
 Cloud architect role responsible for designing and optimizing secure scalable and resilient solutions on AWS using services such as container orchestration managed caching messaging and API management while ensuring strong governance and cost efficiency for enterprise clients in a hybrid work model with a focus on operational excellence and compliance alignment
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design robust cloud reference architectures that leverage container orchestration managed caching distributed messaging and secure API exposure to deliver reliable and scalable business platforms that align with enterprise standards and long term technology strategy
* Implement and optimize container based workloads using managed orchestration and serverless container services to ensure consistent application deployment high availability and efficient resource utilization across multiple environments
* Configure and manage managed caching services to reduce application latency optimize data retrieval patterns and improve overall system responsiveness while maintaining cost effectiveness and operational stability
* Architect and integrate asynchronous messaging patterns using managed message queuing services to decouple application components increase fault tolerance and support high throughput transaction processing in complex distributed systems
* Design and govern API management solutions that provide secure controlled and observable access to backend services while enforcing usage policies request throttling and analytics to support partner and internal integration ecosystems
* Utilize advisory tooling to continuously assess cost security performance and service limits providing actionable recommendations that improve reliability reduce operational risk and maintain budget alignment for cloud workloads
* Configure and maintain configuration management services to track resource changes enforce configuration policies and support compliance reporting across multiple accounts and environments for regulated and enterprise clients

Excellent written communication, editing, and document formatting skills (MS Word, Power Point, Excel etc). Good understanding of data engineering, analytics and cloud technologies.

 Latest Technology: You will get to work on the most advanced technologies like machine learning and artificial intelligence.
   

  

 Global Exposure: We work for leading global brands. You will get exposure to global markets while working with international clients.
   

  

 Learning \& Development: We partner with a host of the biggest learning platforms. You will be encouraged to learn and grow.

With this attitude, we can make significant progress in areas that we know very little about today. Here, you’ll work with people with a collective passion to explore the limitless potential of data to solve complex problems.

Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

 Are you an experienced consulting professional seeking an exciting new challenge? If you thrive in a fast\-paced, project\-based environment, are accustomed to juggling multiple projects at once and enjoy wearing multiple hats, we have the opportunity for you! * Proficiency with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

e07b4495.title: Platform Architect
e07b4495.description:
**Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Platform Architect** to define and drive the architecture of a modern, cloud\-native platform supporting scalable, secure, and resilient applications.


The role requires strong expertise in **containerization, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Redis, multi\-tenant architecture, and cross\-region deployment**. Microsoft Azure experience is preferred.


The Platform Architect will work closely with engineering, DevOps/SRE, security, and product teams to establish platform standards, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture and technical direction for the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient **microservices\-based architectures**.
* Establish standards for containerized workloads and Kubernetes deployments.
* Define cloud architecture using Azure services and cloud\-native design principles.
* Design secure and scalable **multi\-tenant architectures**, including tenant isolation and resource segregation.
* Define **multi\-region deployment**, failover, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies.
* Design caching and distributed state\-management solutions using **Redis**.
* Establish standards for service communication, API design, asynchronous messaging, retries, resiliency, and fault handling.
* Define platform security patterns including identity, access control, secrets management, and workload isolation.
* Define observability standards for logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health.
* Guide Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD, and automated platform deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and drive resolution of architectural risks and technical debt.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, design documentation, and architecture decisions.
* Mentor engineering teams on cloud\-native and distributed\-system design practices.


**Core Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

**Containerization**

* Strong experience with Docker/OCI containers.
* Understanding of container lifecycle, security, networking, and image optimization.

**Kubernetes**

* Strong hands\-on architectural knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Experience with:
* + Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Ingress
	+ ConfigMaps and Secrets
	+ Autoscaling and resource management
	+ Persistent storage
	+ RBAC and network policies
	+ Cluster and workload high availability
* Experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)** preferred.

**Microservices \& Distributed Systems**

* Strong understanding of:
* + REST APIs and service\-to\-service communication
	+ Event\-driven and asynchronous architectures
	+ API gateways
	+ Service decomposition
	+ Resiliency patterns
	+ Distributed transactions
	+ Eventual consistency
	+ Idempotency
	+ Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

**Cloud Architecture**

* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Familiarity with relevant Azure services such as:
* + AKS
	+ Azure Container Registry
	+ Azure Front Door / Application Gateway
	+ Virtual Networks and Private Link
	+ Microsoft Entra ID
	+ Managed Identities
	+ Key Vault
	+ Azure Monitor / Application Insights
	+ Azure Storage
	+ Azure SQL or equivalent databases
	+ Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs
	+ Azure Managed Redis

**Redis**

* Experience designing Redis for:
* + Distributed caching
	+ Session or transient state
	+ High availability
	+ Replication and clustering
	+ Cache invalidation
	+ Performance optimization

**Multi\-Tenant Architecture**

* Experience designing SaaS or shared platforms with:
* + Tenant isolation
	+ Identity and authorization boundaries
	+ Data and resource segregation
	+ Tenant provisioning
	+ Noisy\-neighbor mitigation
	+ Tenant\-level monitoring and configuration

**Multi\-Region Architecture**

* Experience designing:
* + Regional deployment patterns
	+ Active\-active and active\-passive architectures
	+ Traffic routing
	+ Disaster recovery
	+ Regional failover
	+ Data replication
	+ RTO/RPO strategies

**Preferred Skills**


Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Helm and GitOps
* Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs
* OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana
* API Management and service mesh
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Zero\-trust and cloud security
* SRE and reliability engineering practices


**Experience**

* Typically **10\+ years of software or platform engineering experience**.
* At least **4–6 years of experience in cloud\-native and distributed\-system architecture**.
* Proven experience architecting production platforms using Kubernetes and microservices.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient systems.


**Key Architecture Competencies**


The candidate should be able to evaluate architectural trade\-offs such as:

* Shared vs dedicated tenant infrastructure
* Shared Kubernetes clusters vs tenant\-specific clusters
* Database\-per\-tenant vs shared database models
* Stateless vs stateful services
* Synchronous APIs vs asynchronous messaging
* Active\-active vs active\-passive regional deployments
* Managed cloud services vs self\-managed components
* Security and isolation vs infrastructure cost

fe12a526.title: Principal Cloud Services Architect
fe12a526.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Principal Cloud Services Architect at NTT DATA, your expertise will shine as you create complex, innovative cloud solutions that meet and exceed client expectations. You will engage closely with our clients and sales/delivery teams, blending solution design with pre\-sales activities to drive value co\-creation. Leveraging your skills, you will help design secure, multi\-year Managed Services solutions and play a pivotal role in their implementation.  

  

Each day, you'll design advanced managed service solutions that integrate seamless technology and service design across the cloud domain. Your role includes leading the Managed Service offering's design, testing and validating new features, and enhancing existing service offers. You will interface with delivery and r\&d teams to ensure our solutions are innovative, competitive, and secure.  

  

You will map client requirements against a set of service elements and architectures, leading the full solution development process. You will facilitate workshops, analyze client architecture, and present solutions that highlight cost savings and growth opportunities. Your work will involve everything from defining service elements and ensuring compliance and risk mitigation to developing robust transition documents and roadmaps.  

  

Not only will you design these cutting\-edge solutions, but you'll also remain engaged post\-implementation, ensuring smooth transitions and participating in renewals where necessary. You'll mentor sales teams, coach colleagues, and act as an advisor, sharing insights and driving our commitment to excellence. Your expertise will help shape the future of digital transformation for some of the most innovative global organizations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Extensive understanding of cloud technologies, networking, security, and system administration.
* Advanced grasp of multi\-cloud technologies, cloud\-native workflows, and legacy\-to\-cloud migrations.
* Applied experience with Azure, GCP, and AWS infrastructure architectures.
* Deep knowledge of Managed Services delivery models.
* Strong ability to work with costing models, collaborating closely with sales and finance.
* Proficiency in communicating the value of our solutions to stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to facilitate workshops to gather requirements and present solutions.
* Collaborative mindset, thriving in team environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/systems or a related field.
**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working **About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune


Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with


unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as


established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each


year in R\&D.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 **Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**


NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

Perform engineering services to support existing Authorized User solutions and develop new solutions within the Project infrastructure, including macOS devices, operating systems, application packages, support processes, selfservice Mac solutions, and BYOD solutions.
  
Design, build, and maintain all Authorized User solution software images and configuration profiles in compliance with Project standards and requirements.

Partner with product and client experience teams to resolve issues, improve service quality, and ensure alignment with Projects technology roadmap and strategic priorities.

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Program Manager to lead and scale our Alternate Delivery Models portfolio as part of our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program in India. This is a high\-impact role at the forefront of our India expansion, responsible for end\-to\-end program management across innovative delivery channels including drone delivery, electric vehicle fleets, and micro\-mobility solutions.  

The ideal candidate brings 5–7 years of program management experience, a strong operational mindset, and a passion for building scalable, cost\-effective last\-mile delivery solutions from the ground up.

The Alternate Delivery Models team operates under the DSP program and is chartered with reimagining last\-mile delivery across India. You will work cross\-functionally with operations, technology, finance, fleet management, and external partners to drive innovation and operational excellence.

5dc3f783.description:
**Thornton Tomasetti** applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.


Our **Restoration \& Renewal** practice investigates existing buildings’ envelope problems and provides evidence\-based solutions. We access the exterior building envelope to perform observations utilizing the boom lift and suspended scaffold access. We prepare drawings and specifications for the required roof and façade repairs and provide technical support during the bid and construction phases, with frequent site visits to review the quality of work and conformance with contract documents, as well as special inspections. We assist property managers, building owners, and design professionals with a wide range of engineering and architectural issues. The majority of our projects involve historic buildings and structures, but we also assist with contemporary buildings.

**Your Role**


As an Architect in our Restoration \& Renewal Practice, you will support the evaluation and rehabilitation of existing buildings and building envelope systems. Working alongside architects and engineers, you will help identify deficiencies, develop repair solutions, and prepare technical documentation for renovation, adaptive reuse, and historic preservation projects. This role offers the opportunity to build technical expertise in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist in evaluating building envelopes, interiors, and architectural systems, including historic materials and assemblies.
* Support assessments of system performance, code compliance, and feasibility of renovation.
* Support the preparation of condition assessment reports, repair drawings, specifications, and construction documents for existing buildings.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop practical and constructible solutions.
* Build your professional network and engage with the firm’s culture by practicing leadership behaviors such as trust\-building and effective communication.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture; Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience with Revit, AutoCAD, or architectural detailing tools is a plus, but not required.
* Familiarity with building envelopes and architectural system design principles.
* Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and eagerness to learn.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, geographically distributed team environment.
* A detail\-oriented approach and the ability to apply architectural concepts carefully, with sensitivity to historic contexts.

**Project Role :** Security Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Security Operations  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

The Network Security Management Lead is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, management, and continuous improvement of the organization s network security infrastructure. This role ensures robust protection of network boundaries, internal segments, cloud environments, and critical assets while leading a team of network security engineers. The Lead also collaborates closely with SOC, Cloud, IT, and Architecture teams to strengthen overall cyber resilience.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Network Security Operations \& Management
* Lead day\-to\-day management of network security devices including firewalls, VPNs, IPS/IDS, proxies, WAFs, DDoS systems, and segmentation solutions.
* Ensure continuous availability, performance, and health of network security infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for support, patching, and upgrades.
* Review firewall policies, NAT rules, URL filtering, IPS signatures, and ensure optimal configurations.
* Security Architecture \& Design
* Develop and implement secure network architecture aligned with best practices.
* Drive Zero Trust segmentation, secure hybrid/cloud connectivity, and micro\-segmentation initiatives.
* Participate in solution design reviews and assess network security impact of new projects.
* Ensure alignment of network security controls with overall cybersecurity strategy.
* Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Collaboration
* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of network security engineers.
* Allocate resources, manage workloads, and ensure SLA/OLA compliance.
* Work closely with SOC, IR, threat hunting, and IT/network teams for coordinated defense.
* Present network security posture, risks, and improvements to leadership.
* Incident Response \& Threat Mitigation
* Act as SME during network\-related security incidents.
* Support SOC and IR teams with packet analysis, firewall log analysis, and malicious traffic investigation.
* Implement immediate containment controls during active threats (e.g., blocking IPs, disabling routes, isolating segments).
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Policy, Governance \& Compliance
* Maintain network security standards, hardening guidelines, and baseline configurations.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, NIST, PCI\-DSS, and internal risk/audit requirements.
* Conduct periodic firewall rule audits, recertifications, and access reviews.
* Maintain complete and updated documentation: topology diagrams, policies, runbooks, inventory.
* Continuous Improvement \& Innovation
* Identify opportunities to automate network security processes through SOAR/Scripting/API automation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies such as SASE, ZTNA, SD\-WAN, and cloud\-native firewalls.
* Drive initiatives to improve threat visibility and reduce attack surface.

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Expertise with network security platforms (any combination):
* Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/Firepower, , Zscaler, Prisma Access, Akamai, Cloud Azure WAF.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Palo Alto NG FW, Palo Alto IPS/IDS, Panorama


Prisma Access/ GlobalProtect VPN  

* Azure WAF
* Azure Bastion hosts (AVD)
* MIST AP (Important)
* Firewall policy design \& optimization
* IPS/IDS, proxy, URL filtering, DNS security
* VPN/IPSec/SSL/Remote Access
* Network segmentation \& micro\-segmentation
* Cloud network security (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Strong knowledge of network protocols: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, SD\-WAN.
* Familiarity with packet capture tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) and traffic analysis.
* Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell, Bash) is added advantage.
* Leadership \& Soft Skills
* Team management and mentoring experience.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Preferred certifications:
* CCNP Security / CCIE Security
* PCNSE (Palo Alto)
* CISSP
* Cloud Security certifications (AZ\-500, AWS Security, GCP Security

  

  

Additional Information:

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world.  Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **SAP FI Functional Architect** 
 to lead the design, solutioning, and delivery of SAP Finance solutions for large\-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs. The candidate will be responsible for defining the overall Finance solution architecture, driving business process design, managing integrations with upstream and downstream modules, and ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP Financial Accounting, SAP S/4HANA Finance, global finance processes, solution design, stakeholder management, and implementation governance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead SAP FI solution architecture for SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Design end\-to\-end Finance processes aligned to business requirements and SAP best practices.
* Define Finance target\-state architecture, including enterprise structure and financial reporting framework.
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis and recommend optimal SAP standard solutions.
* Drive SAP Activate methodology deliverables across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.


**SAP FI Functional Areas**
* General Ledger (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Asset Accounting (AA)
* Bank Accounting and Cash Management
* Closing Cockpit and Financial Close Processes
* Tax Configuration
* Intercompany Accounting
* Document Splitting
* Parallel Accounting
* New GL / Universal Journal (ACDOCA)


**SAP S/4HANA Finance**
* Lead SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation initiatives.
* Design Universal Journal architecture.
* Define migration strategy from ECC FI to S/4HANA Finance.
* Support Finance simplification item assessment and readiness activities.
* Evaluate and recommend SAP best practices and innovations.


**Integration Management**
* Drive integration design with:
+ SAP CO
+ SAP MM
+ SAP SD
+ SAP Project Systems (PS)
+ SAP EPPM
+ SAP Treasury
+ SAP SuccessFactors Payroll
+ SAP Ariba
+ Third\-party banking and tax systems


**Data Migration \& Testing**
* Support Finance data migration strategy and execution.
* Define migration scope for master and transactional data.
* Lead data validation and reconciliation activities.
* Support SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Cutover activities.
* Ensure audit readiness and financial data integrity.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Work closely with CFO organization, Finance Controllers, Accounting teams, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops and design sessions.
* Present solution options and recommendations to leadership teams.
* Manage client escalations and issue resolution.


**Governance \& Delivery**
* Review functional specifications and development objects.
* Guide offshore delivery teams.
* Ensure compliance with project governance and quality standards.
* Support cutover planning, hypercare, and stabilization activities.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* SAP FI Configuration and Design
* General Ledger
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Asset Accounting
* Bank Accounting
* Tax Management
* Financial Closing \& Reporting
* Intercompany Accounting
* SAP S/4HANA Finance


**Technical \& Integration Knowledge**
* SAP Fiori Applications
* SAP BTP Integration Awareness
* SAP Central Finance (Preferred)
* SAP Group Reporting (Preferred)
* SAP Data Migration Cockpit
* SAP Integration Suite
* Understanding of ABAP Enhancements and Interfaces


**Business Knowledge**
* Financial Accounting
* Corporate Finance
* Management Reporting
* Compliance and Audit Requirements
* IFRS / US GAAP Knowledge
* Internal Controls and Financial Governance


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field.
* CA / CMA / CPA qualification is an added advantage.
* SAP FI/FIN certification preferred.
* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification preferred.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ Years hands\-on experience in SAP Finance (FI) with at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementation programs
* Experience in large\-scale global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Experience in Manufacturing, Aerospace, MRO, Oil \& Gas, Utilities, Retail, or Consumer Products industries.
* Experience leading global template design and rollout programs.
* Experience working with multinational clients and distributed teams.
* Exposure to SAP RISE and Cloud transformation programs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

180243b9.title: AVP, Solution Architect (L11)
180243b9.description:
**Title: AVP, Solution Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards. The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year. Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Assistant Vice President, Solution Architect craves working in a hands\-on system design and architecture environment and leads by example to make sure time sensitive projects get done on time and to specifications. To be successful in this role, deep expertise in solution, Cloud Native Apps Architecture, event\-driven architecture, building resilient batch applications and the ability to influence and lead a team are musts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Influence many agile development teams through all phases of the Agile development life cycle through SAFe
* Implement new technologies and assist developers as they migrate to new technologies
* Architect applications across the full stack, experience in PCF, AWS, Cloud Native Application Architecture, Microservices ecosystem, Spring Batch Apps using Spring Cloud Data Flow, J2EE, Spring Java, and RESTful APIs are a must.
* Design data models to support complex business processes
* Drive a CI/CD strategy using our Jenkins, Bitbucket, and uDeploy stack.
* Influence and collaborate with software developers, UX designers, product managers, application architects, and customer application experts to create amazing apps.
* Mentor and influence all levels of the team: in this role, you will have the opportunity to influence up and down the chain of command
* Ensure compliance with architecture, security and technology standards set by Synchrony Financial
* Assist in crafting and maintaining the future state technology architectural strategy, along with our application of modernization and migration roadmap.
* Participate in Agile scrums consisting of cross\-functional teams
* Participate and Contribute towards Engineering Community of Practices (CoPs)
* Lead Agile sprints as the technical expert, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming sessions, and sprint reviews
* Ensure application code quality through development, test, and QA
* Participate in addressing root cause analyses, incident reports and provide direction in problem resolution
* Ability to analyze production defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause, and implement fixes
* Passionate about the latest technologies, open\-source projects and languages
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support periodically throughout the year
* Identify ways to increase efficiency and improve system performance
* Work with third party vendors to develop software and/or integrate their software into the company's products


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related degree with modern application development experience, around 7 years of experience in Technology, 5\+ years in API development using Java and 2 years in Technical Lead driving product solutions in Enterprise Communications
* Strong Technical Expertise in Java, Spring Projects – Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud Data Flow, S3 Bucket, Git, Maven, Gradle and REST
* Strong Experience in developing microservices with 12\-factor app methodology
* Strong Experience with Scaled Agile framework and familiarity with tools like JIRA Align
* Strong Experience with Agile application development and familiarity with tools like JIRA
* Strong Experience with continuous integration environments and using tools like Jenkins
* Strong Experience writing unit and integration tests and familiarity with frameworks like Junit, Mockito, Spring Test.
* Strong Experience with Caching Systems – Redis/Gemfire.
* Strong desire to develop high quality code with the ability to review and leverage quality check tools like Sonar, PMD, etc.
* Strong Experience in designing API’s using SOLID principles, Java and microservice design patterns with business acumen.
* Strong Experience in designing and developing Event\-Driven Applications using Kafka.
* Strong Experience in security frameworks/libraries like AES, JWT and oAuth2\.0 Frameworks
* Familiarity with Behavior Driven Development and API Test Automation
* Excellence in technical communication with technical and non\-technical peers
* Strong experience with Pivotal Cloud Foundry and AWS
* Experience using Splunk for production support and Dashboard building.
* Strong experience in using Monitoring Tools like New Relic and NSQL.
* Experience with Database Architecture, Modeling, and familiarity with MySQL \& Oracle Databases and NoSQL Databases
* Strong cross\-functional team player with the ability to work seamlessly across a matrix organization and partner with global development companies


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior experience working with US Payment networks (ACH, Wire, or related payment processing systems) is desired
* Desire to work in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to influence clients, team members, management, and external groups
* Good to have knowledge on AI Assisted Development


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or related degree with modern application development experience, around 7 years of experience in Technology, 5\+ years in API development using Java and 2 years in Technical Lead driving product solutions in Enterprise Communications.
   

  

**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L09\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible
* L09\+ Employees can apply

* Develop a comprehensive project plan, including timelines, resource allocation, and budget management.
* Work closely with end\-user customers to understand their requirements and ensure the center meets their needs.

* Drive the accelerated delivery of system enhancements required for the operational system, ensuring it keeps abreast of technological advancements and new operational requirements.

* Proven experience as a Program Manager, particularly in establishing and managing large\-scale software development centers or similar operations.
* Strong leadership and team\-building skills, with a track record of recruiting and managing high\-performing teams.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders.

* Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager – AI/ML
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–12 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced Manager to lead AI/ML and Generative AI consulting engagements, drive enterprise AI transformation programs, and manage end\-to\-end delivery of AI solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with leadership, stakeholder management, business development, and solution strategy capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead AI strategy, assessment, and transformation engagements for enterprise clients across multiple industries.
* Define AI vision, adoption roadmaps, governance frameworks, and operating models aligned with business objectives.
* Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI/ML and Generative AI programs, from discovery and use\-case identification through implementation and value realization.
* Provide leadership in designing scalable AI architectures including machine learning platforms, GenAI ecosystems, AI Agents, and enterprise knowledge solutions.
* Drive AI modernization initiatives involving analytics transformation, intelligent automation, copilots, and domain\-specific AI applications.
* Manage delivery teams comprising data scientists, ML engineers, AI engineers, architects, and developers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership by presenting AI strategies, business cases, operating models, and transformation roadmaps.
* Ensure solution quality, governance compliance, risk management, and successful program execution.
* Support business development activities including proposal creation, solution estimation, client presentations, and AI capability demonstrations.
* Mentor team members and establish best practices across AI engineering, MLOps, Responsible AI, and solution delivery.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 7–12 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, analytics, and digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale AI/ML transformation initiatives and enterprise AI/ML solution deployments.
* Strong expertise in:
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* AI Agent frameworks and autonomous workflows
* Data Science, Advanced Analytics, and Predictive Modeling
* Cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI, AWS AI, or Google Cloud AI
* MLOps, AI governance, and production AI operations
* Demonstrated experience in AI strategy, assessment methodologies, and transformation planning.
* Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams and delivering multiple concurrent engagements.
* Strong understanding of Responsible AI, model governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to translate business challenges into AI\-driven solutions with measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent executive\-level communication, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
* Strong experience in estimation, solutioning, account growth, and practice development initiatives.


**Good to Have**
* Advanced certifications in AI, Data Science, Cloud AI, or Enterprise Architecture.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, and enterprise GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to industry\-specific AI transformation programs
* Thought leadership through whitepapers, accelerators, reusable assets, AI frameworks, or innovation initiatives.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

e3d62e30.title: Senior Director – Research Solutions
e3d62e30.description:
**Build our future together:**



Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.



At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a **Senior Director, Research Solutions** to join our Research Digital \& Technology organization. In this leadership role, you will be responsible for building and scaling Research technology capabilities within our Global Capability Center while serving as a strategic partner to Research and Technology leaders worldwide. You will lead the delivery of innovative digital, data, AI, scientific computing, bioinformatics, and laboratory technology solutions that accelerate scientific discovery and preclinical research. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of digital transformation in Research through technology innovation, organizational growth, operational excellence, and close collaboration with global scientific teams.


**When \& Where:**



Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)


**Discover your role:**


* Lead and scale the Research Digital \& Technology organization within the India Global Capability Center, fostering a high\-performance, inclusive, and innovation\-driven culture.
* Build and expand Research technology capabilities through strategic hiring, onboarding, talent development, succession planning, and organizational design.
* Partner with Research and Technology leadership teams to define and implement business\-aligned digital strategies that accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of scientific applications, laboratory automation, bioinformatics platforms, data engineering, AI/ML capabilities, and cloud\-native solutions supporting Research functions.
* Drive operational excellence through Agile delivery, engineering standard methodologies, platform reliability, performance metrics, observability, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and maintain secure, compliant, and scalable engineering standards across the software development and data lifecycles, ensuring high\-quality, auditable solutions.
* Drive adoption of advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning capabilities by implementing platforms and solutions that enhance scientific productivity and research outcomes.
* Act as a strategic advisor by translating complex scientific and research challenges into scalable digital, data, and technology solutions.
* Lead vendor, partner, and delivery ecosystem management while building sustainable internal engineering capabilities within the GCC.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership and multi\-functional stakeholders across global regions, driving alignment, transparency, and informed decision\-making.


**This role requires:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Significant leadership experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or other research\-intensive environments.
* Deep understanding of scientific research processes, including biology, genetics/genomics, bioinformatics, lab automation, imaging, and research data management.
* Experience leading large\-scale technology organizations spanning software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, bioinformatics, and scientific computing subject areas.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud technologies, distributed systems, research data platforms, APIs, integration architecture, and engineering standard methodologies.
* Experience establishing engineering and data governance standards across secure SDLC, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure automation, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience building and scaling Global Capability Center (GCC) organizations and leading geographically distributed engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience enabling AI/ML innovation, research analytics, and scientific computing capabilities through scalable platforms and engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, and data protection controls supporting sensitive scientific and research data.
* Proven ability to influence senior collaborators and operate effectively within complex global matrix organizations.
* Strong organizational leadership, critical thinking, change management, problem\-solving, and executive communication skills.
* Advanced degree or equivalent experience such as MS, MBA, PhD, or related scientific/technical qualification preferred.
* Experience leading enterprise digital transformation initiatives supporting Research, Preclinical Development, or Scientific Discovery organizations.
* Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and collaborating with scientific, technology, data, architecture, security, and product teams.
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled platforms, and digital capabilities supporting the research and innovation lifecycle.

  

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.



Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working\-at\-regeneron/total\-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.  



  

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.
