e0992b9c.title: Sr. Program Manager, Customer Programs
e0992b9c.description:
**Job Summary**
 The Senior Program Manager (P5\) is responsible for leading complex, high\-value NVIDIA customer programs across the full product lifecycle, from opportunity assessment through production and ongoing customer engagement. This role serves as a direct interface between Jabil and NVIDIA, ensuring alignment across engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, manufacturing, and executive leadership teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will drive program execution, manage customer relationships, coordinate global cross\-functional teams, and ensure delivery against aggressive schedule, cost, quality, and business objectives. This position requires strong leadership, technical aptitude, executive communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced hyperscale and AI infrastructure environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer \& Business Leadership**
* Serve as the primary program management lead for assigned NVIDIA programs, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
* Lead program management activities spanning opportunity assessment, customer onboarding, program launch, execution, and production support.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customer stakeholders, business unit leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Align customer priorities with organizational objectives to drive successful business outcomes.


**Program Governance \& Portfolio Management**
* Establish and maintain program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting structures.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple initiatives.
* Provide executive\-level visibility through regular status reporting, business reviews, and strategic updates.
* Ensure alignment, accountability, and continuity throughout the customer lifecycle.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Coordinate activities across engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, procurement, finance, and business unit teams.
* Facilitate decision\-making and drive resolution of issues impacting customer commitments.
* Lead cross\-functional reviews to assess readiness, remove barriers, and maintain execution momentum.
* Influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization to achieve program objectives without direct authority.


**Risk Management \& Business Execution**
* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, and business impacts.
* Lead escalation management and recovery planning for schedule, quality, cost, and delivery challenges.
* Drive mitigation plans and ensure timely communication of critical issues and decisions.
* Monitor program performance against objectives and implement corrective actions when necessary.


**Executive Communication**
* Prepare and deliver executive reviews, customer presentations, and business updates.
* Translate complex operational and technical information into concise, actionable business insights.
* Provide leadership with visibility into program performance, resource requirements, risks, and strategic opportunities.
* Facilitate communication between customer leadership and internal executive stakeholders.


**Success Measures**
* Achievement of program milestones, customer commitments, and business objectives.
* Strong customer relationships and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Effective management of risks, escalations, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Executive confidence in program visibility, governance, and reporting.


**Job Qualifications**
**KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS**
* Ability to lead complex cross\-functional programs involving engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing organizations.
* Ability to identify risks, drive issue resolution, and influence decisions across multiple organizations without direct authority.
* Strong customer engagement, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Advanced analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Advanced PC skills, including Microsoft Office and enterprise systems.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Management, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 7\-10 years of experience in Program Management, Customer Program Management, NPI, Operations, Engineering, or related business leadership roles.
* PMP Certification preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading customer\-facing programs involving cross\-functional teams, executive stakeholders, and technically complex products or solutions
* Experience supporting technology, cloud, AI infrastructure, networking, semiconductor, or manufacturing environments preferred.
* Or equivalent combination of education, experience, and/or training.


 , BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e\-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e\-mail with a jabil.com e\-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e\-mail. 0ff847b6.title: Lead Application Engineer I – ELV Systems’ Presales Engineering
0ff847b6.description:
**What You Will Do**
 The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end\-to\-end presales engineering activities of Fire and Security opportunities within India from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit\-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno\-Commercial activities of the projects covering various ELV systems such as Fire Alarm System, CCTV Surveillance \& Security System, Access Control System, Public Address System, Parking Management System, Structured Cabling System, network Infrastructure, Building Management Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D\&E and OPS approval for booking
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick\-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs \& subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno\-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet \& assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.


**What We Look For**
* BE (Electrical / Electronics / Electronics \& Communication)
* Must have 11\+ years of relevant experience in ELV Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of ELV \& ICT Systems (Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control, PAVA, Intrusion Detection Systems, Intercom Systems, Gate Barriers, Car parking system, Structured Cabling, Network Switches, etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have India projects' presales and estimation experience on various verticals.
* Design know\-how of the ELV \& ICT Systems.
* Capable of understanding ELV Systems specifications and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high\-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must have a strong network with the 3rd party vendors in India.
* Must be a quick learner \& keen on problem\-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.


**Preferred**
* Work experience in all leading access control products (e.g., Software House, Lenel, HID, Suprema, Bosch, Honeywell, etc.)
* Work experience in all leading CCTV products (e.g., American Dynamics, Milestone, Genetec, Pelco, Axis, etc.)
* Knowledge of Fire Alarm Systems products such as Notifier, Simplex, and EST (Edward).
* PAVA, Structured Cabling and Network infrastructure know\-how is a must.
* Knowledge of ACAD, Visio, and Excel.
* Security and fire alarm systems' product certifications will be added advantage.


 Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou.

3778f9e1.title: Solution Engineer - GCC (FSI)
3778f9e1.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 We are looking for world\-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting\-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 The Solution Engineer will work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof\-of\-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
   

  

***This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
 The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking \- quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories \& case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake


**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands\-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large\-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre\-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.


**ADDED BONUS FOR:**
* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience \- Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?
   

  

 For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

4100ba9b.title: Presales Solution Architect – Digital Workplace Services
4100ba9b.description:
**Role Description**
 The Presales Solution Architect for Digital Workplace Services will play a critical role in shaping technology and managed service solutions that enable modern, productive and user\-centric workplace environments. The role will partner closely with sales, practice, delivery, engineering, commercial teams, technology partners and clients to understand business requirements, develop tailored solutions and articulate the value of Digital Workplace Services. The solution scope may include Service Desk, Field Services, Modern Endpoint Management, Device Lifecycle Services, Microsoft 365 and Collaboration, Workplace AI and Automation. The ideal candidate will be a Digital Workplace generalist with broad solutioning experience across multiple workplace service areas and deeper expertise in one or more domains. The candidate should combine technical understanding, managed services solutioning, commercial awareness, strong documentation capability and confident client\-facing communication skills. Key Responsibilities Solution Design and Architecture Lead the design of end\-to\-end Digital Workplace solutions spanning Service Desk, Field Services, VIP support, endpoint management, device lifecycle services, Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, Digital Employee Experience, digital adoption and workplace automation. Translate customer business, operational and technical requirements into scalable, supportable and cost\-effective solution architectures. Design integrated operating models covering service scope, support tiers, delivery locations, coverage windows, staffing, governance, service levels and enabling technology platforms. Coordinate inputs from domain specialists, delivery teams, technology vendors and service partners to create a cohesive end\-to\-end solution. Develop solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, service descriptions, service catalogues, operating models and transformation roadmaps. Define solution assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, risks, customer responsibilities and third\-party responsibilities. Ensure proposed solutions are aligned with customer objectives, operational requirements and delivery capabilities. Presales and Bid Support Work with sales and account teams to qualify opportunities and define appropriate Digital Workplace solution strategies. Lead or contribute to RFP, RFI and proposal responses. Conduct customer discovery workshops, requirements sessions, assessments and solution walkthroughs. Develop high\-quality solution proposals, response documents, PowerPoint presentations, bid\-orals decks, executive narratives and supporting solution artefacts. Build value propositions, business cases, ROI and TCO models, transformation benefits and competitive differentiators. Lead or support bid\-orals presentations, solution walkthroughs and client solution\-defence sessions. Respond to technical, operational and commercial challenges relating to the proposed solution. Support customer due diligence, clarification sessions and commercial negotiations. Create detailed effort estimates across transition, transformation, engineering, service management and business\-as\-usual operations. Define service levels, KPIs, OLAs, XLAs, governance structures and reporting requirements. Provide resource models, effort estimates, technology requirements and commercial inputs. Work with pricing, finance, delivery and partner teams to validate solution cost, feasibility and competitiveness. Support the development of pricing models, including resource\-based, transaction\-based, per\-user, per\-device and outcome\-based constructs where applicable. Participate in internal solution reviews, risk reviews and commercial approval processes. Ensure proposed commitments are measurable, deliverable and commercially viable. Field Services and Partner Solutioning Work with global, regional and local field\-service partners to develop onsite support, scheduled visit and dispatch\-based service models. Validate partner coverage, delivery capability, service hours, language support, logistics capability and regional constraints. Obtain and validate partner effort, pricing, lead\-time and service\-level inputs. Define scope boundaries, hand\-offs, escalation paths, service responsibilities and governance requirements for partner\-delivered services. Integrate partner\-delivered field services into the overall Digital Workplace operating model and commercial solution. Support partner selection, benchmarking and solution\-risk assessment where required. Customer Engagement Present and articulate Digital Workplace capabilities, solution options and transformation roadmaps to senior and executive stakeholders. Facilitate customer workshops and consultative discussions across business, technology and operational stakeholders. Conduct demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept planning and solution walkthroughs where applicable. Serve as a trusted advisor on workplace technologies, managed service models, employee experience and workplace transformation. Translate technical and operational concepts into clear business outcomes and measurable value. Defend solution assumptions, design decisions, operating models, service levels, effort estimates and commercial constructs in front of customers. Collaboration and Delivery Enablement Work closely with service delivery, engineering, transition, operations and practice teams to ensure solution feasibility and accuracy. Engage product vendors, OEMs and service partners where third\-party capabilities form part of the solution. Develop and review Statements of Work, service descriptions, responsibility matrices, assumptions, dependencies and contractual solution commitments. Ensure alignment between the proposed solution, contractual scope, pricing model and delivery approach. Practice and Capability Development Contribute to the development of reusable solution assets, reference architectures, estimators, service descriptions, accelerators and proposal content. Share knowledge, market insights and solution lessons across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams. cde2af94.title: Solution Consultant
cde2af94.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

Are you an experienced consulting professional seeking an exciting new challenge? If you thrive in a fast\-paced, project\-based environment, are accustomed to juggling multiple projects at once and enjoy wearing multiple hats, we have the opportunity for you! We are looking for a Solution Consultant I who will belong to an amazing team of Professional Services practitioners committed to laying the foundation for our client’s successful sales enablement journey. We are searching for a candidate that is willing to work PST hours.
Who you are::
* 2\-3 years of previous experience working as an implementation delivery consultant or similar type role
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Solid client\-facing experience with the ability to influence and manage expectations
* Ability to understand a client’s existing repositories and use\-cases to help guide the client through implementation
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving expertise
* Ability to architect solutions based on customer requirements using the capabilities of Seismic
* Proficiency with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels
* Prior experience with SaaS a plus

* A chameleon – part Consultant, part Business Analyst, part Project Manager
* Comfortable not always having all the answers, but know where or how to find them
* Possess a strong sense of ownership and takes pride in all that you do
* Comfortable in dynamic environments with changing priorities
* Skilled at managing multiple responsibilities while striving to exceed expectations
* Displays a sense of humor and humility during those challenging times

What you'll be doing::
* Consult with the client to understand and document the business and content related problems
* Leverage sales enablement best practices to guide the client through the implementation of a Seismic solution that solves the problems
* Enable the organization for the change management required to drive successful outcomes
* Provide support and ongoing services for existing clients in accordance with SLAs
* Assist with conducting on\-site and virtual training with clients as necessary
* Project manage engagements as needed

We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
   

  

 We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Collaborate with the sales leadership to understand customer requirements and enable technical solutions deployment based on customer needs.
* Develop an in\-depth understanding of Ema’s technology and underlying architectures
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to the specific needs of potential customers, showcasing key features and benefits.
* Work closely with customers to execute successful PoCs, demonstrating the feasibility and value of Ema in their environment.
* Position yourself as a Trusted Advisor to key customer stakeholders with a focus on achieving their desired Business Outcomes.
* Collaborate with customers to design and architect solutions that align with their business goals, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
* Drive project teams towards common goals of accelerating the adoption of Ema’s solutions.

* Help take Ema’s solution from POC to production.
* Understand customers cloud/on\-prem environment and their unique needs for deploying Ema’s solutions. Work with our engineering team to translate customer needs into a productionizable solution that fits into Ema’s deployment models.
* Manage the customer’s problem through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer challenges on Ema’s platform. Create repeatable processes. Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution architectures, integration guides, and best practices.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and product to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Ema.


**Ideally, You'd Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years experience as a Solutions Architect/Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineer or in a similar technical pre\-sales role.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS solutions and cloud technologies.
* Solid experience with solution design, architecture, and integration.
* Familiarity with relevant programming languages and technologies.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.

ebd03683.title: Solution Engineering - Cloud Infrastructure
ebd03683.description:
**Overview**
 Are you curious, enthusiastic about infrastructure, and ready to solve complex challenges in the AI era? Join us as a
 **Cloud \& AI Solution Engineer \- Infrastructure** 
 focused on the
 **Azure Platform** 
 for
 **commercial customers** 
 at Microsoft.
   

  

 In this technical sales role, you will help customers design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures that support their modernization goals. Using Azure’s IaaS and PaaS services, you will guide organizations through migration, modernization, optimization, and innovation—translating technical capabilities into significant business outcomes.
   

  

 You will collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions that enhance agility, reduce costs, and unlock value through AI\-powered infrastructure.
   

  

 As a Cloud \& AI Digital Solution Engineer for the Azure Platform, you will play a key role in helping customers modernize their infrastructure and unlock the full value of Microsoft’s cloud. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient architectures that support AI workloads and business\-critical applications.
   

  

 You bring deep expertise in migrating core workloads—including Windows, SQL Server, Linux, PostgreSQL, and Oracle—to Azure. Beyond migration, you lead customers through modernization using the 6R strategy, containerization best practices, and Azure\-native services like AKS and Arc, while exploring how AI and intelligent agents can accelerate legacy transformation.
   

  

 You also apply strong networking knowledge to design hybrid and cloud\-native solutions, including virtual networks, VPNs, and secure routing architectures that meet enterprise performance and compliance needs. You complement this with trusted partner solutions like NetApp, VMware, RedHat, and SAP to ensure a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.
   

  

 As you join the team, You will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise with access to a wide range of Microsoft learning resources—including support for earning industry\-recognized certifications across Azure infrastructure, security, and AI.
   

  

 With a solid understanding of Azure security services and compliance frameworks you will help customers meet regulatory requirements and build Cloud environments that are ready for the future.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive technical sales by using technical demos, proofs of concept, and technical architecture accelerators to influence solution design and enable deployments.
* Lead architecture sessions and technical workshops to accelerate Azure adoption.
* Build trusted relationships with platforms leads to co\-design secure, scalable solutions.
* Resolve technical blockers by collaborating with engineering and sharing customer insights.
* Maintain expertise in cloud migration (Windows, SQL, Linux, PostgreSQL, app workloads), resiliency, security, and compliance.
* Deepen knowledge of enterprise apps (SAP, Oracle) and Azure VMware Solution (AVS).
* Represent Microsoft in customer forums and technical communities through thought leadership.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4\+ years technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3\+ year(s) technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR equivalent experience

* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure, including migration of workloads such as Windows, SQL, Linux, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience designing or selling solutions involving hybrid networking, secure connectivity, or network performance optimization in enterprise environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Platform, and containerization strategies.
* Strong understanding of Azure services, including security, compliance, and hybrid cloud scenarios.
* Ability to engage technical and business stakeholders to design and deploy scalable, secure cloud solutions.


* 6\+ years technical pre\-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience
+ OR equivalent experience

* 4\+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructure, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, and ISVs like NetApp, VMware, and RedHat.
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, and Public Sector compliance standards.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

1d49fd0b.description:
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**
 As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

 We are a
 **Great Place To Work\-Certified** 
 organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy


**What You Will Do**
 As a Technical Chillers expert, this role will be focused on Solution Development with complete accountability of Pre\-Sales life cycle support. Drive the overall process of Application Engineering and ensure our customer receive the best solution as per requirements
   

  

* Enterprise Accounts Ownership: Work in close collaboration with our lead Account Managers \& clients as the primary contact for technical support and Pre\-Sales Engineering for Chillers. You will directly work with our enterprise clients, such as Vantage, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Keppel, Air trunk, Micron, and others, right from the Pre\-tendering phase all the way to Project handover.
* Value Engineering: Engage actively in offering the optimized solutions using available products to provide best techno commercial offering. Work closely with Chiller factories and Global Products Team on special quotes and complex technical compliance. Conduct thorough sweet spot analysis to ensure our specifications are included in the early stages of BOD projects.
* Basis of Design: Work closely with the BOD/Sales team to understand the Project needs and provide technical chiller solutions/specifications. By doing so, we aim to ensure that our offerings are well\-integrated from the initial stages, leveraging our expertise to contribute to winning the project.
* Global Exposure: \- The candidate will work closely with the Regional Sales Team on Chillers Pre\-Sales Engineering for local projects across the APAC region, covering countries like Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, India, Korea, Taiwan, Philippines and Australia.
* Mentorship: Guiding and coaching team members to enhance their skills through knowledge sharing.
* Field product management support: \- Collaborate with a cross\-functional team, including Life Cycle Solutions, Sales, Global Products and Factory teams, to analyze trends, work on identifying product and solution gaps related to vertical market needs and provide insights and recommendations of new features to enhance products


**What We Look For**
* BE/ME Mechanical or equivalent.
* Demonstrate a high level of knowledge of Chillers – Screw, Scroll \& Centrifugal.
* A solid understanding of the principles of large refrigeration systems and associated equipment is required.
* Preference will be given to individuals having technical expertise in Chillers.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Chillers product selection process, preparing selections, specifications review and quotations.
* Ability to perform successfully in a multifunctional\-team\-work environment and be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Must be a quick learner \& should have a keen eye for problem solving
* Proficient in written and verbal communication
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills
* People management experience would be an added advantage.


 Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou.

To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.
   

  

 Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.
   

  

 This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.
   

  

 We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.
   

  

 This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.
   

  

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**
* Collaborate closely with Snowflake's Partner, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams to promote and implement optimal solutions with our partners.
* Design and deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to upskill partner teams on Snowflake architecture and best practices based on joint business goals.
* Co\-develop industry\-specific solutions and accelerators with partners (e.g., data migration frameworks, industry data models, Power of N motions). Aligning Snowflake's products to maximise impact on their service offerings.
* Present at Snowflake and Partner events, lead hackathons, and drive Snowflake awareness and adoption within partner organisations.
* Partner closely on strategic customer engagements, collaborating with partners to define use cases, deliver compelling presentations, execute successful Proofs of Concept (POCs), and ensure positive outcomes.
* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.
* Advocate for partner and customer needs with Snowflake product teams.


**OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**
* Have 10\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators, Regional System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers and Technology Partners within the region.
* Developed data domain thought leadership within a partner community.
* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.
* Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals (cloud DW experience preferred)
* Experience with Snowflake Technology Partners that specialise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Collaboration and Cyber Security.
* Hands\-on technical experience with DevOps and CI/CD processes and tools, such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Google Cloud Build.
* Strong experience with major cloud platforms and tooling, especially Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
* Experience using Big Data or Cloud integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?
   

  

 For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

dd2eb028.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Generative AI
dd2eb028.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting\-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG\-based workflows.  

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre\-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language\-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG\-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.

 **What we need to see:**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In\-depth understanding of state\-of\-the\-art language models, including but not limited to GPT\-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

 **Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 338d4cc1.title: Forward Deployed Architect
338d4cc1.description:
Are you passionate about designing AI systems that solve real customer challenges?
 





 Do you enjoy working hands\-on with customers to turn complex business problems into scalable, production\-ready AI solutions?
 





 Are you excited by the opportunity to shape agentic AI architectures that deliver measurable business impact?
 




  
 




 At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the value of AI, cloud, and data through practical, scalable, and outcome\-focused solutions. We are looking for a Forward Deployed Architect \- Agentic AI to lead the technical architecture behind production\-grade AI systems deployed in real customer environments.
 




  
 




 As a Forward Deployed Architect, you will work at the intersection of customer context, systems architecture, and applied AI. You will lead customer engagements from problem discovery through solution design, deployment, and iteration, ensuring AI solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes.
 




  
 




**Your key responsibilities:** 




* Leading customer engagements from discovery through architecture design, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Translating complex business challenges into practical agentic AI architectures, including multi\-step workflows, tool use, and external system integrations.
* Designing production\-grade AI systems, including data flows, system boundaries, monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
* Defining architecture patterns and technical standards for integrating models, agents, and AI workflows into customer environments.
* Guiding prototypes into scalable, reliable, and maintainable production solutions while balancing speed, quality, and business value.
* Mentoring engineers and architects, sharing best practices, and raising delivery standards across AI projects.


**Job Requirements** 
* Strong experience architecting and delivering AI, ML, or software systems in production environments.
* Hands\-on technical expertise in Python or comparable programming languages such as Go, Rust, or similar.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, iteration, and production reliability.
* Strong software architecture fundamentals across distributed systems, data modeling, integration patterns, and system design.
* Excellent customer\-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs and business value clearly.

 Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

caab1c24.title: Sales System Architect
caab1c24.description:
**Ready to join the future of innovation in IT at NXP?**
 Do you love to collaborate with the business to translate their strategy into solid IT solutions?
   

  

 Do you have the experience to be a sparring partner for both IT and Business colleagues?
   

  

 Do you thrive in a role with a lot of room for your own ideas and innovation?
   

  

 Do you want to make an impact on both our business and our customers?
   

  

 Do you get excited by the prospect to be part of an international diverse company?
   

  

 Then we are looking for you in the role of Sales IT System Architect.
   

  

 The System Architect is the glue between Sales and IT. You will be responsible for understanding the needs of the Sales organization on a strategic and operational level and translating those into sound solutions. Tasks will include business requirement gathering, architecting, designing and \-in some instances\- implementing solutions. You will be working in an Agile and DevOps way, together in a supporting environment, with continuous focus on development and coaching.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Work together with the Sales team to understand and analyze their requirements, and propose (IT) solution directions, in line with the NXP enterprise architecture
* Team up with internal and external resources to implement solutions and provide architectural oversight
* Collaborate with other architects within the company to deliver end\-to\-end solutions that are transformational leveraging AI/ML
* Help define the architectural roadmap and strategy for the team to create future\-proof solutions
* Create and maintain architectural documents for applications within the team’s portfolio
* Build PoCs when needed and apply code when required


**Your team**
 NXP IT is well recognized as a modern IT organization with a DevOps way of working. We are a diversified team with high energy, an open collaboration environment and eagerness for continuous improvement.
   

  

 Within Sales and Marketing IT we focus on internal and external applications to support the Customer journey. We collaborate with our business teams daily on strategic improvements and with vendor partners to deliver easy\-to\-use applications leveraging SaaS, cloud services and custom development where needed.
   

  

**To be successful in this role you have**

* 5\+ years’ experience in Information Technology (Consultancy, Project or Development) in the Sales and Marketing domain

* Knowledge and experience in the following areas:
+ Required: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Agentforce, DataCloud, AI/ML
+ Preferred: Eloqua, Xactly, Gen AI

+ Experience with Continuous Integration tools and processes
+ Knowledge of how to leverage Business Intelligence/Analytics


**Furthermore, you are**
* able to collaborate and partner with business and IT in defining, preparing and executing projects and change programs
* able to get your point across to your juniors, peers and management in IT as well as business

41289d1b.title: Oracle fusion cloud hcm functional senior consultant
41289d1b.description:
Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Senior Consultant
   

  

 Location: Hitech City, Hyderabad (On\-site)
   

  

 Company: Apps Tek Corp
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Apps Tek Corp is seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Senior Consultant with 8–12 years of hands\-on experience to join our growing Oracle Enterprise Applications practice.
   

  

 This role is designed for a senior Oracle HCM professional who can understand customer HR challenges, lead consulting and discovery engagements, design practical Oracle HCM solutions, support pre\-sales activities, and guide implementation teams through successful delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable engaging directly with HR business leaders, HRIT stakeholders and client executives to understand business challenges, challenge existing processes, recommend Oracle best practices and translate business requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion HCM solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Consulting \& Problem Solving
   

  

 Engage directly with customers to understand HR strategy, workforce challenges, process gaps and transformation priorities. Conduct current\-state assessments and identify opportunities for process standardization, simplification and optimization. Translate HR business challenges into practical Oracle Fusion HCM solution options. Challenge requirements where appropriate and recommend Oracle standard capabilities and best practices. Define future\-state HR processes and solution approaches aligned with business objectives. Help customers evaluate solution alternatives based on business value, complexity and implementation considerations.
   

  

 Solutioning \& Pre\-Sales
   

  

 Partner with sales and account teams during prospect and customer engagements. Lead discovery sessions, solution workshops and requirements discussions. Develop solution concepts, scope assumptions, implementation approaches and roadmaps. Deliver compelling Oracle Fusion HCM demonstrations based on customer business scenarios. Support RFP/RFI responses, proposals, estimates and customer presentations. Communicate the business value and expected outcomes of proposed HCM solutions.
   

  

 Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architecture
   

  

 Design and guide end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion HCM solutions. Perform enterprise structures, workforce structures and security\-related setups. Lead functional solution design and configuration across key HCM modules: Core HR: Enterprise structures, workforce structures, person/employment management and position management. Absence Management: Accrual plans, qualification plans, absence recording and compliance rules. Payroll: Element entries, payroll definitions, salary basis, costing and statutory requirements. Talent Management: Goal Management, Performance Management, Talent Review and Succession Planning. Recruiting / ORC: Job requisitions, candidate selection, career sites and onboarding.
   

  

 Workshops \& Delivery Assurance
   

  

 Lead client discovery sessions, Conference Room Pilots (CRPs), solution workshops and UAT cycles. Review functional designs, configuration decisions and test scenarios. Prepare and review Functional Design Documents, configuration workbooks and user documentation. Guide implementation teams through complex functional issues. Support post\-go\-live stabilization, enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 Integrations, Reporting \& Data
   

  

 Provide functional guidance to technical teams on HCM integrations, reporting and data migration. Work with teams using HCM Data Loader (HDL), HCM Extracts and spreadsheets. Provide functional guidance on Fast Formulas, OTBI and BI Publisher reporting. Work with integration teams on Oracle and external system integrations.
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Contribute to building Apps Tek's Oracle HCM consulting practice. Develop reusable solution patterns, templates, accelerators and assessment frameworks. Support creation of customer\-facing solution collateral and demonstrations. Mentor HCM consultants and contribute to delivery methodologies and best practices. Identify opportunities to expand Oracle HCM capabilities within existing and new customer accounts.
   

  

 Oracle Transformation \& AI Activation
   

  

 Stay aware of Oracle's evolving automation, analytics and AI capabilities relevant to HCM. Identify practical opportunities where automation or AI can improve selected HR processes and employee experiences. Support customer discussions around AI activation where there is a clear business use case. Collaborate with Apps Tek's broader AI and technology teams when appropriate.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 8–12 years of experience in Oracle HCM. Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations. Core HR expertise is mandatory. Strong expertise across at least 2–3 additional modules such as Absence Management, Payroll, Talent Management or Oracle Recruiting Cloud. Proven experience in solution architecture, consulting and pre\-sales solutioning. Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR processes such as Hire\-to\-Retire, workforce management, payroll, talent and recruiting. Proven ability to understand customer business problems and translate them into practical Oracle solutions. Experience conducting client workshops, demonstrations and solution presentations. Strong technical\-functional understanding of HDL, Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts and OTBI / BI Publisher. Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and stakeholder management skills. Experience working with global HR implementations and statutory/compliance requirements. Experience working with US or global enterprise customers is preferred. Oracle Fusion HCM certification is preferred. Exposure to Oracle automation, analytics or AI capabilities is an advantage. Industry experience in Manufacturing, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Financial Services, Energy \& Utilities or other complex enterprise environments is preferred.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customers see you as a trusted advisor, not simply an Oracle functional consultant. You understand the HR problem before designing the technology solution. You can independently lead discovery, solutioning and executive discussions. You contribute to winning Oracle HCM opportunities. You provide strong functional direction to delivery teams. You help build reusable Apps Tek Oracle HCM consulting assets. You identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and selective AI activation.

Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

 Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle databases, Exadata, high\-availability architectures, cloud security, and modern data platforms. Experience with Azure data services and AI\-enabled solutions will be an added advantage.

a7fbdd93.title: Director, Technical Consulting— Marketing Cloud Next
a7fbdd93.description:
**Description**
****ROLE OVERVIEW****
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Marketing Cloud Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. In addition The Director — Marketing Cloud Next is an execution\-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end\-to\-end migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Marketing Cloud Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will combine deep Marketing Cloud Next platform expertise with advanced data migration methodologies to ensure that subscriber data, consent records, journeys, content and preference data are migrated with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to people leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Marketing Cloud migration projects, contributing hands\-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Design the subscriber and audience data migration strategy, including data extension schema, subscriber key mapping, suppression list migration, consent record preservation (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL) and historical send data handling.
* Architect the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation for unified customer profile design, identity resolution rules, data stream ingestion from source systems, and audience segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Own the journey migration blueprint — mapping legacy automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends from source platforms to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder, including decision splits, wait steps and exit criteria.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping and reconciliation strategies for all subscriber objects, data extensions and consent tables.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform Depth: Advanced expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder / Audience Builder.
* Data Cloud / CDP: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile modelling, segmentation and activation to MC Next.
* Subscriber Data Architecture: Deep understanding of subscriber data model, data extensions, sendable vs non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression logic and list management at scale.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — consent record migration, preference centre design, suppression list management and compliance\-aligned data handling.
* Email Deliverability: Strong understanding of sender reputation, IP warm\-up strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and deliverability validation post\-migration.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in executing high\-volume subscriber migrations — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping and reconciliation for marketing data objects.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP Marketing Cloud APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging patterns.
* AMPscript / SSJS: Proficiency in dynamic content scripting for migrated email templates — ensuring legacy personalisation logic is recreated accurately in MC Next.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 8\+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating high\-volume subscriber databases (10M\+ records) with zero consent data loss
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others
* Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* CTA
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, LINE, Push and SMS channel migration in addition to email
* Familiarity with marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Understanding of Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

 **Transformation Delivery Manager**

 This role serves as the single point of accountability for delivery excellence, commercial performance, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes across a portfolio of transformation initiatives. The Transformation Delivery Manager will be responsible for driving complex digital transformation programs from strategy through execution while ensuring predictable delivery, contractual compliance, margin achievement, and customer success.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in program delivery, fixed bid project management, transformation leadership, customer engagement, financial governance, and operational excellence. This role requires extensive experience managing multi\-million\-dollar fixed bid engagements, distributed global teams, and large\-scale product/platform implementations.

c457a8db.title: Program Manager - Operations, Andhra Pradesh
c457a8db.description:
**About Mitti Labs**

Mitti Labs is a climate\-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.


Backed by NASA\-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net\-zero goals through verified, high\-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.


Our customers \- including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri\-businesses \- trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40\+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.

**Role Description**  

  

Mitti Labs is currently working with 10,000 farmers across different regions in AP. We need a strong state lead or project lead to manage the execution of carbon process\-related and input sales related tasks in our project regions across the State.


Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100\. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.


Some of your objectives will include:


* Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre\-defined roadmap
* Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
* Continually training, re\-training, and supporting the field agent force
* Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?


We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**  

  

1\. External Partner Operations Management

* Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
* Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
* Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
* Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc.
* Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner’s teams (at managerial and operational levels)
* Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks


2\. Internal Communications

* Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R\&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
* Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
* Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
* Offer support on Science Ops, R\&D ops, agronomic demos, etc.


3\. Operational Execution and Leadership

* Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on\-ground execution
* Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
* Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
* Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
* Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
* Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
* Build marketing material in coordination with on\-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
* Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs \+ Video walkthroughs

  

**Requirements**  

Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:

* Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
* Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
* Experience in Agri Project Management
